Once compost has been processed at the bottom of the bin, players must wield their compost bucket before interacting and filling it with compost.

item_246.lead: The cooking range can be used to create more complex dishes than can be made on the campfire or grill. It functions like the stone range, but can craft a wider variety of recipes when unlocked at level 16 Cooking. It requires a roof above it to function.

item_247.lead: The crafting table can be used to create and repair tools, weapons, ammo, armour, and capes. It does not have any indoor/outdoor restrictions and can be placed without a foundation.

item_248.lead: A crate is a tier 1 constructed object that does not have restrictions to build indoors/outdoors and does not require a foundation to build. The crate is the smallest storage container for up to 16 item slots. To craft or process an item without having the required items in their inventory, players must have the required items in their crate and check the "Linked" checkbox in the crate interface. This will allow players to craft up to a 12-metre radius away from the crate.

item_249.lead: The Nightmare Crucible is a combat activity found within the Umbral Sands region of Ashenfall. It is meant to act akin to 's and 's in where the player fights against all of the toughest enemies Ashenfall has to offer thus far.

item_253.lead: A fancy rug is a decoration that is unlocked after crafting rough cloth for the first time. [[File:Fancy Rug (placed).png|thumb|right|A fancy rug placed after creation.]]

item_254.lead: The fishing barrel is a storage container that can hold up to 48 raw fish. It becomes available once players reach level 34 in the Fishing skill.

item_255.lead: The fletching bench can be used to create and repair bows, crossbows, and ammo. it can be placed without a foundation but must have a roof to use. Players must receive flax in their inventory to unlock the fletching bench.

item_256.lead: Square foundations are constructed objects that are not required to have a roof or a stable foundation. Note that the square foundation has eight points of contact: four at the corners and four on the bottom of each vertical beam. Players can only build up to six square foundations, either stacked on top of each other or side by side, without a stable foundation in between (or at the bottom of the stack). The square foundation is 4 metres long on both sides (which includes the frame surrounding the tile).

item_257.lead: Buildings can be created by opening the Build Menu (hotkey: B). These allow players to create their bases, houses, and structures. For guidance on how to create and stabilise structures, see Buildings/Mechanics for more details.

item_258.lead: This page talks about the base furnace. If you want to see the one capable of smelting higher mateerials, please see blast furnace. The furnace is a facility used to process ores into bars. It requires charcoal to operate, which can be obtained using the kiln. Its operation can be greatly sped up by casting Superheat on it. In order for the furnace to function, it must not have a roof above it. Despite the description stating that it can also fire clay, it cannot do so at this time.

item_259.lead: [[File:Gold Medal.png|thumb|The icon for the Gold Medal in the building menu.]] Gold medal is a decorative trophy that players can build once they have completed all available Agility courses at gold record times.

item_260.lead: A green chandelier is a constructed object that can be built only indoors, and requires the player to place it under a horizontally flat foundation (e.g., square tile, square foundation, etc.)

item_261.lead: Green standing torch is a type of furniture that is created by learning the PLAN: green standing torch recipe.

item_262.lead: Green standing torch is a type of furniture that is created by learning the PLAN: green standing torch recipe.

item_263.lead: Green wall-mounted torch is a type of furniture that is created by learning the PLAN: green wall-mounted torch recipe.

item_264.lead: Green wall-mounted torch is a type of furniture that is created by learning the PLAN: green wall-mounted torch recipe.

item_265.lead: A grill can be built using 12 ash logs, 4 stone, 2 leather, and 6 fire runes after unlocking the Grill Master perk at 26 Cooking. It can be used to cook basic foods, but unlike the campfire, it does not require fuel to use. Cooking with a grill may result in burnt food, depending on the type of food and the player's Cooking level.

item_266.lead: The grindstone can be used to grind stone, sandstone, and granite. Both ground stone and sandstone are required to build power level 2 house parts. It processes very slowly, so it is recommended to keep it filled while doing other tasks, or to fill it just before sleeping, to process a whole stack of stone instantly. It must not have a roof above it to function.

item_267.lead: The imbuing barrel is a facility used to slowly process potions into super potions. It requires wild anima to operate, which can primarily be obtained by smelting 4 anima-infused bark in the kiln. 1 wild anima will process 6 potions in 12 minutes. Its operation can be greatly sped up by casting Superheat on it, which can also save on fuel.

item_268.lead: The iron chest is a large storage container for up to 64 item slots. Players can unlock the recipe for the large chest after receiving an iron bar in their inventory. Players must have the required items in their chest and check the "Linked" checkbox in the chest interface to craft or process an item without having the required items in their inventory. This will allow players to craft within a 32-metre radius from the chest.

item_269.lead: The jeweler's bench is a buildable object where players can create jewellery with several gems. Players will need a silver bar in their inventory for the first time to unlock the bench. [[File:Jeweler's Bench interface.png|thumb|right|The Jeweler's Bench interface.]]

item_271.lead: The kiln is used to burn various logs into charcoal, swamp tar into adhesive, and to fire clay items. It processes somewhat slowly, so it is recommended to keep it filled whilst doing other tasks. Its operation can be greatly sped up by casting Superheat on it. Players must receive clay in their inventory to unlock the recipe for building the kiln.

item_273.lead: A large water barrel is a buildable object unlocked at level 46 Farming. which can hold either clean or dirty water (only from watering cans and not the drinks), but players cannot mix the two types of water inside the barrel.

item_274.lead: A lodestone is a platform that allows the player to travel if another lodestone is placed elsewhere. When the first lodestone is built, the inactive lodestone in the Temple starting area becomes active as well. Teleporting between two lodestones costs a varied amount of law runes, depending on the distance of the target lodestone and the weight of the player.

item_275.lead: The loom can be used to create rough cloth and wool cloth. It can be upgraded with the loom harness to be used to make padded cloth. It requires a roof above it to function.

item_276.lead: A loom harness is a production upgrade for the loom that adds an extra slot, enabling the production of padded cloth or other woven cloths. To function, the harness must be placed within 9 metres of a loom. Each harness can only support a single loom; if placed between two, only the closest loom will receive the additional slot.

item_277.lead: Lumber storage is a large storage container for storing lumber. Only logs and planks can be stored inside, and it can hold up to 48 item slots. If the lumber storage is placed within three metres of the receiving end of a sawmill, the sawmill will automatically deposit planks into it. Players can also build multiple sawmills with the sawing end within two metres, and have the processed planks go into the same storage. Players gain the ability to build lumber storage by reaching level 67 Woodcutting, and gaining the feat lumber storage.

item_279.lead: A Moon Garou armchair is a type of furniture. Players can place decorations and can also sit on top of the chair.

item_280.lead: The Moon Garou bed is a buildable piece of furniture used to sleep, rest, and set the player's respawn point in the world. If used at night, players will skip to daytime and regain their "Rest" meter, but if used during the day, players will lie in place and slowly regain their rest meter over time. The bed requires 8 yew planks and 4 desert cloths to craft, and must be under a roof and mostly enclosed with walls to be used.

item_285.lead: Moon Garou table 01 is a type of furniture. Players can place decorations on top of the table.

item_286.lead: Moon Garou table 02 is a type of furniture. Players can place decorations on top of the table.

item_287.lead: The mystic forge is a crafting station that allows for the creation of staves, other weapons, and more powerful capes, and uses ascension cores in ascending masterwork weapons and vestige armour. This replaces some of the functionality of the smithing anvil and crafting table.

item_288.lead: An oak chair is a type of furniture that is unlocked after creating oak planks. Players can place decorations and can also sit on top of the chair.

item_289.lead: The oak chest is a large storage container for up to 48 item slots. Players can unlock the creation of the large chest after receiving oak logs for the first time. To craft or process an item without having the required items in their inventory, players must have the required items in their chest and check the "Linked" checkbox in the chest interface. This will allow players to craft up to a 12-metre radius away from the chest.

item_290.lead: The oak farming plot can be used to grow plants with seeds through the Farming skill. To obtain this plot recipe, collect oak logs.

item_291.lead: An oak shelf is a tier 2 decoration. It can only be built on Creative Mode worlds.

item_292.lead: An oak table is a tier 2 type of furniture.

item_293.lead: An oak window box is a tier 2 decoration. It can only be built on Creative Mode worlds.

item_294.lead: Ore & stone storage is a storage container for storing stones and ore, unlocked at 62 Mining. Unlike the lumber storage that will automatically pickup planks from a sawmill, the ore & stone storage will not automatically pick up ores and stone processed from a kiln, furnace, grindstone, stonecutter, or blast furnace. The ore & stone storage has the same capacity as an oak chest and less capacity than an iron chest, despite it both taking up more space and being made from materials available later in a player's progression.

item_295.lead: A pan rack is an indoor-only constructed item, unlocked after reaching level 11 Cooking. The pan rack can be placed indoors or outdoors, and must also be placed on a vertical surface.

item_297.lead: A potted plant is a decoration that is currently not in the game. Its recipe and experience upon building are unknown.

item_298.lead: The pottery wheel is used to form unfired forms from clay, which can then be processed into a usable form at a kiln. Players must receive clay in their inventory for the first time to unlock the recipe for building the pottery wheel.

item_299.lead: The pristine armoured catfish trophy is a decoration unlocked by catching a Pristine Armoured Catfish from a rod fishing spot in Dowdun Reach.

item_300.lead: The pristine herring trophy is a decoration unlocked by catching a pristine herring from a rod fishing spot in Ghornfell.

item_301.lead: The pristine infernal eel trophy is a decoration unlocked by catching a Pristine Infernal Eel from a rod fishing spot in Dowdun Reach.

item_302.lead: The pristine lobster trophy is a decoration unlocked by catching a pristine lobster from a net fishing spot in Fellhollow.

item_303.lead: The pristine salmon trophy is a decoration unlocked by catching a pristine salmon from a rod fishing spot in Ghornfell.

item_304.lead: The pristine sardine trophy is a decoration unlocked by catching a pristine sardine from a rod fishing spot in Brynmoor.

item_305.lead: The pristine trout trophy is a decoration unlocked by catching a pristine trout from a rod fishing spot in Brynmoor.

item_306.lead: The pristine undead bass trophy is a decoration unlocked by catching a Pristine Undead Bass from a rod fishing spot in Fellhollow.

item_307.lead: The pristine undead eel trophy is a decoration unlocked by catching a Pristine Undead Eel from a rod fishing spot in Fellhollow.

item_308.lead: A purple chandelier is a constructed object that can be built only indoors, and requires the player to place it under a horizontally flat foundation (e.g., square tile, square foundation, etc.)

item_309.lead: Purple standing torch is a type of furniture that is created by learning the PLAN: Purple Standing Torch recipe at the Chaktan Kara vault.

item_310.lead: Purple standing torch is a type of furniture that is created by learning the PLAN: Purple Standing Torch recipe at the Chaktan Kara vault.

item_311.lead: Purple wall-mounted torch is a type of furniture that is created by learning the PLAN: Purple Standing Torch recipe at the Chaktan Kara vault.

item_312.lead: Purple wall-mounted torch is a type of furniture that is created by learning the PLAN: Purple Standing Torch recipe at the Chaktan Kara vault.

item_313.lead: The rain catcher is a Farming building used to convert rainwater to clean water. The rain catcher can hold up to 300 units of clean water and collects 10 units of water per second whilst raining. Players cannot open the rain catcher's interface unless there is at least one unit of rain stored inside the catcher.

item_314.lead: A red chandelier is a constructed object that can be built only indoors, and requires the player to place it under a horizontally flat foundation (e.g., square tile, square foundation, etc.)

item_315.lead: Red standing torch is a type of furniture that is created by learning the PLAN: red standing torch recipe.

item_316.lead: Red standing torch is a type of furniture that is created by learning the PLAN: red standing torch recipe.

item_317.lead: Red wall-mounted torch is a type of furniture that is created by learning the PLAN: red wall-mounted torch recipe.

item_318.lead: Red wall-mounted torch is a type of furniture that is created by learning the PLAN: red wall-mounted torch recipe.

item_323.lead: The round oak table is a type of furniture decoration.

item_324.lead: Round table is a type of furniture that is unlocked after creating ash planks. Players can place decorations on top of the round table.

item_325.lead: The rune altar is a crafting table used to craft runes, which are required to cast spells. To make runes, players need rune essence, which comes from essence geysers around the world, as well as from goblin packs, garou packs, and vault guardians. It does not have any special conditions to function.

item_326.lead: The sawmill is currently used to make ash planks and oak planks out of ash logs and oak logs. If a lumber storage is placed within five metres of the saw end, the planks will be deposited directly into it. It processes very slowly, so it is recommended to keep it filled while doing other tasks, or to fill it just before sleeping to process a whole stack instantly. It must not have a roof above it to function.

item_327.lead: A scarecrow is a buildable object unlocked at level 55 Farming. It is meant to prevent bird-type mobs from landing in your planters.

item_328.lead: A shelf is a type of decoration that is unlocked by receiving ash planks in the player's inventory for the first time. The shelf must be placed on a vertical surface and can hold items such as a bowl of peaches, bowl of onions, and other small decorations.

item_329.lead: Side table is a type of furniture that is unlocked after creating ash planks. Players can place decorations on top of the side table.

item_330.lead: [[File:Silver Medal.png|thumb|The icon for the Silver Medal in the building menu.]] Silver medal is a decorative trophy that players can build once they have completed all available Agility courses at silver or higher records.

item_331.lead: A simple rug is a decoration unlocked after crafting rough cloth for the first time. [[File:Simple Rug (placed).png|thumb|right|A simple rug placed after creation.]]

item_335.lead: The smithing anvil was used to create and repair higher-level tools, weapons, ammo, armour, and capes. It required a roof above it to function. It was removed on 23 June 2026 in Update 0.12.0 and replaced with blacksmith's bench, armour bench, and mystic forge.

item_336.lead: The spinning wheel is unlocked when players harvest from flax plants and receive flax for the first time. It is used to process fibres and furs into threads that can be used for crafting. It processes somewhat slowly, so it is recommended to keep it filled while doing other tasks. It requires a roof above it to function.

item_339.lead: A standing torch is a constructed object that can be built either indoors or outdoors, and requires a horizontally flat foundation (e.g., another standing torch, a square tile, or on the top end of a thin or thick beam). The standing torch has two points of contact, one at the base and one at the base of the fire. Players can only stack up to five torches on top of each other before the structure becomes too unstable.

item_340.lead: A standing torch is a constructed object that can be built either indoors or outdoors, and requires a horizontally flat foundation (e.g., another standing torch, a square tile, or on the top end of a thin or thick beam). The standing torch has two points of contact, one at the base and one at the base of the fire. Players can only stack up to five torches on top of each other before the structure becomes too unstable.

item_341.lead: The stonecutter is a buildable processing station where players can input 2 stone pieces to create 1 stone block, which is used to make power level 3 building pieces. The recipe and ability to build a stonecutter are unlocked after obtaining a steel bar in their inventory for the first time.

item_342.lead: A stone range can be built using 8 ash logs, 12 stone, and 3 animal bones. It is a lower-tier version of the cooking range. To unlock the recipe for the stone range, players must first build and interact with a campfire, or collect an animal bone in their inventory.

item_343.lead: A stool is a type of furniture that is unlocked after creating ash planks. Players can place decorations on top of the stool.

item_344.lead: A super compost bin is a buildable object unlocked at level 60 Farming. Unlike the regular compost bin, it will only accept a smaller pool of items, which includes willow logs, in order to produce super compost, which can be taken out of the bin with an empty compost bucket.

item_345.lead: Table is a type of furniture that is unlocked after creating ash planks. Players can place decorations on top of the table.

item_346.lead: The tackle box is a storage container that can hold up to 48 fishing baits (can be a mix of any type), as well as rods and nets. It becomes available once players reach level 39 in the Fishing skill.

item_347.lead: The tanner's kit is used to upgrade the tannery. Placing the tanner's kit near the tannery allows the player to use the tannery to make hard leather.

item_348.lead: A tannery can be built using 2 coarse thread, 4 animal bones and 12 ash logs. It allows for refining animal hides into leather. It processes somewhat slowly, so it is recommended to keep it filled while doing other tasks. Players must collect an animal bone to unlock the tannery.

item_350.lead: A training dummy is a constructed object, unlockable at level 37 Attack, that acts as a non-combative NPC with 400 hitpoints. Upon losing all its hitpoints, the training dummy will be knocked down for a few seconds, pop up again, and restart at full health. Note that bows and staves will lose regular durability as if attacking a monster. However, melee weapons do not lose durability, even if using the melee weapon's special attack.

item_351.lead: A wall is a structure that is used to provide adequate shelter for the player and for the respawn point (either a bed roll or a bed). This requires at least one point of contact to be connected to a surface. Building a wall does not require a foundation and does not require a roof upon construction. Note that the wall is 4 metres long in both the horizontal and vertical directions.

item_352.lead: A wall-mounted torch is a constructed object that does not require a roof to be built, but requires a foundation that includes either a wall, thick/thin beam, or any vertically built object. Players can choose to build either the cabin-like or the baroque-like version with the same requirements.

item_353.lead: A wall-mounted torch is a constructed object that does not require a roof to be built, but requires a foundation that includes either a wall, thick/thin beam, or any vertically built object. Players can choose to build either the cabin-like or the baroque-like version with the same requirements.

item_355.lead: The water barrel is a buildable object unlocked at level 24 Farming, which can hold either clean or dirty water (only from watering cans and not the drinks), but players cannot mix the two types of water inside the barrel.

item_356.lead: The weapon rack is an unlockable type of furniture at level 27 Attack, and can display up to 6 weapons or tools. This includes axes, pickaxes, melee weapons, ranged weapons, magic weapons, and masterwork weapons.

item_357.lead: A well is a buildable object unlocked at level 32 Farming. Players can store clean water and transfer it over to a water barrel or an empty watering can. This well must be built outdoors and on top of land for it to be placed. The well replenishes to its full capacity at midnight, and players cannot destroy the well whilst there is water stored inside.

item_358.lead: The willow farming plot can be used to grow plants with seeds through the Farming skill. To obtain the recipe, you must interact with the crafting table after obtaining willow logs.

item_359.lead: A window box is a type of decoration that is unlocked by receiving ash planks in the player's inventory for the first time. The window box can hold small decorations inside and can be placed either indoors or outdoors.

item_360.lead: A wooden barrel is a decorative item unlocked by learning the PLAN: wooden barrel recipe. The open wooden barrel does not need a foundation and can be placed either indoors or outdoors. Players can stack up to three barrels on top of each other before the stack becomes unstable.

item_362.lead: The yew farming plot can be used to grow plants with seeds through the Farming skill.

item_368.lead: Trinkets is an equipment slot item that allows players to wears either rings or amulets to help them in training or in combat. Trinkets can be crafted on the Jeweler's Bench. Currently, only one trinket can be worn at a time.

item_369.lead: Trinkets is an equipment slot item that allows players to wears either rings or amulets to help them in training or in combat. Trinkets can be crafted on the Jeweler's Bench. Currently, only one trinket can be worn at a time.

item_370.desc: Doesn't look like much now, but sear it on a bonfire and receive a delicious treat.
item_370.lead: Raw anchovies are a Power Level 3 raw ingredient, which means they can be cooked at a campfire or grill into seared anchovies starting at Cooking level 27, and not burnt into burnt anchovies at level 41. They can also be used to make anchovy bait. They can be gathered from net fishing spots with at least a wool net in Fractured Plains and Stormtouched Highlands.

journal.title: Fish
journal.text: Surprisingly good on pizza, these salty little fishes are a popular delicacy across Gielinor.

journal.title: Raw
journal.text: You could eat these by the handful if you didn’t mind the crunch. Traditionally cured in brine and turned into a deliciously salty snack. Goes very well on pizzas.

item_373.desc: Should be shelled before being braised.
item_373.lead: Raw armoured catfish is a Power Level 4 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire, grill, or with Infernal Rod into braised catfish starting at Cooking level 41, and not burnt into burnt catfish at level 50. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally a maple rod in Dowdun Reach at level 3 Fishing. Using animated feather increases the chance of catching one. It is the normal variant of a pristine armoured catfish.

journal.title: Fish
journal.text: Sometimes evolution gets inspired by the wrong things. The catfish of Ashenfall have long been the victim of any creature that chooses to make them lunch. They are caught, cooked and consumed more often than is reasonable, and their suffering seemed too great as a result. So it was that a god took pity on them and gave them a defence. It is uncertain which god, for none have claimed responsibility, but the divine whimsy could be the result of any of them. All we know is that the fish now have a chance against their assailants, an armoured hide to ward off some of the worst of their misery. Sadly, they are no match for you.

journal.title: Raw
journal.text: Looking at this, you're going to struggle to prepare it properly. Make sure you have a very, very sharp knife.

item_374.desc: Used to upgrade Masterwork Weapons and Vestiges from a lower Power level to Power Level 4.
item_374.lead: Ascension cores are items used and crafted in the mystic forge to ascend masterwork weapons from their base power level to the next tier. They are made by combining ascension shards or by collecting them as rewards for completing Nightmare Crucible instances in Umbral Sands. For most cores, players can gain core shards by killing mini-bosses (such as red dragons, green dragons, and blue dragons).

journal.text: Imagine, if you will, what you could do if you could harness your dreams. If you could take an ideal, refine it and reforge it using the power of the imagination. Such a technology is terrifying in its potential, and Avisk was the first to explore its possibilities. This core is a part of the nightmare, refined and reforged over and over again, then condescended into a singularity and sealed within dragonkin technology. It is a mote of potential, waiting to be released. The technology is limited for now. Avisk was only able to use it to improve his existing equipment, as well as to empower the beasts he trapped in the nightmare dreamscape. Fortunately, limited as it might be, you should find this technology particularly useful, as it will allow you upgrade and improve some of your more unique equipment, such as masterwork gear.

item_377.desc: Used to craft a Tier 4 Ascension Core
item_377.lead: Ascension shard is a basic item used to craft ascension cores, which are in turn used to upgrade masterwork weapons into stronger forms.

journal.text: Avisk was many things, arrogant, manipulative, cruel, but he was also a genius. Within the dreamscapes of the nightmare crucible, he found a way to reshape matter, reforging it into its ideal form. He took weapons and moulded them into stronger versions. He took a staff and re-imagined it stronger and more deadly. Using the stuff of nightmares, he found a limited way to reshape the world. We are, perhaps, fortunate that it was limited to such small scales. These shards are a part of that power. When combined with a fully realised core, they can upgrade legendary equipment into stronger versions of itself. A power we should hope Kuldra never finds.

item_381.desc: PERK: Focused Strikes INCREASED chance of landing CRITICAL HITS with MELEE ATTACKS
item_381.lead: Lesser Attack potion grants the perk Focused Strikes, which increases the chance of landing critical hits with melee attacks by 25% for 10-minutes (600 seconds). It is made with snapdragon, ground granite, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

item_382.desc: Equip and use these seeds to scatter them in a farming plot and start growing! Best planted in Fellhollow plots.
item_382.lead: Avantoe seeds are a type of Fellhollow seed, used in the Farming skill. Avantoe seeds can be used to grow avantoe in a farming plot. However, it is best to plant them in a willow farming plot.

journal.text: Back on the mainland, the avantoe has a reputation for being a little high-maintenance. It only grows after a heavy bout of rainfall, and - even then - the bloom only lasts for a matter of hours. Get distracted, and you can miss the plant's entire life-cycle. Luckily, the climate and soil of Ashenfall means that the avantoe is less flighty than its mainland equivalent. You can see why avantoe is the perfect reagent for stamina and agility potions. It lives its short life at speed, and leaves something of itself behind that does the same for you. As in, it can boost your stamina rather than give you a short life.

item_386.desc: You half expect it to start wriggling again.
item_386.lead: Raw beltfish is a Power Level 7 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire, grill, or with Infernal Rod into steamed beltfish. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with a yew rod in Umbral Sands at level 3 Fishing. Using kalphite bait increases the chance of catching one. It is the normal variant of a pristine beltfish.

journal.title: Fish
journal.text: The beltfish, or 'largehead hairtail' if you want to get fancy, is no replacement for a real belt. Anglers have been known to break their belts mid-fishing session and will look into their buckets, wondering if the beltfish 'might do'. Yes, I know - there's no helping some people. But if you are tempted, here are the reasons why a beltfish is a sub-par belt. 1. The beltfish is actually a bit of a chonker. It doesn't fit through the loops in your trousers. 2. The smell of a beltfish is riper than your average fish. That ripeness only escalates as the hours go on. 3. Nobody is going to be impressed with your fish-eye belt buckle. 4. An eel is actually a more functional belt.

journal.title: Raw
journal.text: Raw beltfish is a tricky customer. It's a tough, almost sinewy meat, more like a whip than a food product. If you're a chef and want to torment your sous-chef, then crack a beltfish and watch them pay attention. Equally, if you're a sous-chef and your chef is constantly whipping you with beltfish, then a beltfish makes for a handy garotte.

item_387.desc: A fruity medley of cooked berries. A great, sweet treat for enjoying in the wild.
item_387.lead: Berry compote is a consumable food item that can be crafted by combining redberries and dwellberries at a cooking pot. When consumed it provides moderate sustenance and 5 lifeward. There is also a 5% chance to produce a rat roast whilst making a berry compote.

item_390.lead: Bird nests are drops found when felling trees. They contain assortments of skilling items that are dropped on the floor once opened. The ability to find bird nests is unlocked at 16 Woodcutting. In addition, opening a bird nest will provide 20 Woodcutting experience.

item_394.lead: Black Knight guardians are power level 6 variants of the Black Knight warrior, who wields a shield.

journal.text: Chaos is an attractive philosophy until you're the one organising guard and patrol rotations. Chaos gains a little asterisk: you need a little organisation to facilitate the chaos. Those on guard rotations know that threats are just as likely to come from within than without. For this reason, veterans would advise the newer knights to glue a mirror to the back of their shield.

item_399.lead: Milliburn Rasmodel, also known as Lord Rasmodel, and the Black Knight Titan is a power level 6 boss monster, released with Dowdun Reach. He is the old commander of the Black Knights within Dowdun Reach, who was resurrected by the Dreaming Stone, and guards the passageway to the Umbral Sands.

item_400.lead: The Black Knight warriors are power level 6 monsters found within Dowdun Reach. They are members of the Black Knights within Dowdun Reach and resides in the Black Knight's Fortress.

journal.text: Lord Rasmodel rarely entrusted the rookies with any meaningful work. He found that they arrived with chaos in their hearts. They weren't old enough to realise that chaos is an ideal that rarely works in everyday life. So, he would give them the role of "Warriors", and would loosely allocate them an area of the Reach to wander. "Let their cynicism grow," Rasmodel would say. "If the demons or magi don't kill them first, they might harden into one of the good ones."

item_401.lead: Blightwood root are Woodcutting resource nodes located at the base of the large blightwood trees in the Bloodblight Swamp; players must have a iron logging axe or better to receive blightwood. Players can either chop these or cast Axtral Projection. Not every blightwood tree will have exposed roots, and there are a handful of roots that are not connected to any tree. Unlike other trees, these roots will only take one swing to clear with an iron logging axe, but only yield a small amount of logs per root. Blightwood roots respawn after three in-game days, as long as players do not place anything directly on the node's spawn.

item_403.desc: Perhaps you could learn something from it.
item_403.lead: The blue memory of Menaphos is a vestige that unlocks the blue desert cape and can be found in chests throughout Umbral Sands.

item_405.lead: Boggs is a power level 6 monster that appears with Rat Master Skrexis in The Menagerie.

item_412.desc: A refreshing fruity drink. Excellent for hydration.
item_412.lead: Cadavaberry infusion is a consumable drink item that provides 40 hydration and grants the perk Quenched, which reduces thirst drain by 33% for 900 seconds. It is made with clean water and dried cadavaberries in a cooking range.

item_413.lead: Carnivorous chinchompas are power level 5 monsters located within Dowdun Reach. Like their variants, they explode when in close range.

item_414.lead: Clay nodes are Mining resource nodes that can be found in Whispering Swamp and can be mined for clay using a stone pickaxe or better. Clay nodes respawn after three in-game days, as long as the player is at least 100 metres away, and their built objects are not directly on the node.

journal.text: Clay can be found in deposits around Ashenfall and can be recovered with just a few pickaxe swings. It is said that the Elder Gods created the universe out of clay, albeit of a more interesting vintage, and that the unwanted remains were hurled into the Abyss. The truth of this claim is hard to establish, as the Elder Gods are rarely prone to a friendly chat. Not least because, were you to hear them speak, your head would explode. This makes conversation tricky.

item_415.lead: A clay slab is an item that is not currently found in the game. An unfired clay slab exists in the cache, implying that the fired clay slab may come from the unfired version.

item_416.lead: A clay slab is an item that is currently not in the game.

item_417.lead: Coal nodes are Mining resource nodes found in Fellhollow, Dowdun Reach and Umbral Sands, which can be mined to obtain coal, a reagent required to create steel, mithril, and adamant bars.

journal.text: Coal is the petrified memory of a long dead ecosystem. Plants and animals, who lived countless aeons ago, crushed down into rocks of rigid carbon and becoming a powerful fuel that changes civilisations. When you burn the coal, imagine the worlds that came before and the lives forgotten. Let each piece become a funeral pyre for a long-lost age. Or enjoy shiny new steel armour, your call!

item_419.lead: Copper ore nodes are Mining resource nodes that can be found in Fractured Plains, Stormtouched Highlands, and Dowdun Reach. Players must have a bone pickaxe or better to mine the node for copper ore. Copper ore nodes respawn their copper ore after three in-game days, as long as the player is at least 100 metres away, and their built objects are not directly on the node.

journal.text: On its own, copper is useful but not great for weapons or armour. It must be combined with tin to create sturdier bronze.

item_424.lead: Curly is a power level 6 monster that appears with Rat Master Skrexis in The Menagerie.

item_425.lead: Delrom is a power level 6 lesser demon located under Dowdun Reach, near The Lake.

item_429.lead: Divine cabbage was a type of food that was scrapped after the initial launch of RuneScape: Dragonwilds.

item_437.lead: Dragonkin statue 02 is created by first learning the blueprint, found in chests near the Fractured Plains, or inside vaults. [[File:Dragonkin Statue 02 (placed).png|thumb|right|A Dragonkin Statue when built.]]

item_438.desc: A delicious flank steak, covered in a fruity dwellbery glaze. Mouthwateringly tasty!
item_438.lead: Dwellberry glazed roast flank is a consumable food item that can be cooked by combining dwellberries with raw bestial meat at a cooking pot, and provides moderate sustenance when consumed. There is also a 5% chance to produce a rat roast whilst making dwellberry glazed roast flank.

item_439.desc: A juicy piece of roasted meat with a deliciously fruity dwellberry glazing. Scrumptious!
item_439.lead: Dwellberry glazed roast meat is a food item that can be created through Cooking, by combining dwellberries with any tier one meat (raw rat meat, raw bird meat, raw farm meat, or raw game meat) at a cooking pot. Eating the dish provides moderate sustenance (30) and a small amount of lifeward (5) when consumed. There is also a 5% chance to produce a rat roast whilst making dwellberry glazed roast meat.

item_440.lead: Elite Black Knights are power level 6 monsters located in Dowdun Reach. They are elite members of the Black Knights. They are either alone, with another elite Black Knight or with a few hellhound

journal.text: Chaos is an attractive philosophy until you're the one organising guard and patrol rotations. Chaos gains a little asterisk: you need a little organisation to facilitate the chaos. Those on guard rotation know that threats are just as likely to come from within than without. For this reason, veterans would advise newer knights to glue mirror to the back of their shield.

item_443.desc: A long extinguished torch with unique charactersitics.
item_443.lead: The extinguished blue remnants is a vestige found by looting Buried Chests in Brynmoor and Ghornfell. There is a 2/100 chance for a buried chest to contain the vestige. It can be studied to unlock the blue torch recipe.

item_444.desc: A long extinguished torch with unique charactersitics.
item_444.lead: The extinguished green remnants is a vestige found by looting Buried Chests in Brynmoor and Ghornfell. There is a 2/100 chance for a buried chest to contain the vestige. It can be studied to unlock the green torch recipe.

item_445.desc: A long extinguished torch with unique charactersitics.
item_445.lead: The extinguished purple remnants is a vestige found by looting Buried Chests in Brynmoor and Ghornfell. There is a 2/100 chance for a buried chest to contain the vestige. It can be studied to unlock the purple torch recipe.

item_446.desc: A long extinguished torch with unique charactersitics.
item_446.lead: The extinguished green remnants is a vestige found by looting Buried Chests in Brynmoor and Ghornfell. There is a 2/100 chance for a buried chest to contain the vestige. It can be studied to unlock the green torch recipe.

item_447.desc: A long extinguished torch with unique charactersitics.
item_447.lead: The extinguished yellow remnants is a vestige found by looting Buried Chests in Brynmoor and Ghornfell. There is a 2/100 chance for a buried chest to contain the vestige. It can be studied to unlock the yellow torch recipe.

item_448.desc: Arrows with tips carved from animal fangs.
item_448.lead: Fang barbed arrows are fang arrows with weapon barbs crafted on the arrow. Like other barbed arrows, the icon will have a Bleed icon placed on the top right of the arrow to distinguish itself from regular arrows. There are no additional bonuses at this time.

item_449.desc: Arrows with tips carved from animal fangs.
item_449.lead: Fang fire arrows are fang arrows with fire oil applied with level 45 Ranged. Targets that are hit by the fang fire arrow will not be inflicted with the Burning debuff, but higher-tier arrows will have a higher chance of doing so. Like other fire arrows, the icon will have a fire icon placed on the top right of the arrow to distinguish itself from regular arrows.

item_450.lead: Fido is a power level 6 monster that appears with Houndmaster Rexiton under The Garrison.

item_453.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_453.lead: Food & drink salvage are a type of salvage hotspot that can be looted to obtain various resources. They can be found in the Dowdun Reach.

item_454.desc: PERK - FUNGAL FORTITUDE (300 SEC) Grants RESISTENCE to POISON effects It actually smells quite good.
item_454.lead: Fortifying crunchies are a consumable food item that provide moderate sustenance. It also gives the player the Fungal Fortitude perk, which grants resistance to Poison effects for 300 seconds. There is also a 5% chance to produce a rat roast whilst making fortifying crunchies.

item_455.desc: PERK - FUNGAL FORTITUDE (300 SEC) A warm vegetable soup, with added mushrooms. Grants RESISTENCE to POISON effects
item_455.lead: Fortifying soup is a consumable food item that provides moderate sustenance and 5 lifeward when eaten. It also provides the player with the Fungal Fortitude perk, which grants resistance to Poison buildup by 33% for 300 seconds. There is also a 5% chance to produce a rat roast whilst making fortifying soup.

item_456.desc: PERK - FUNGAL FORTITUDE (300 SEC) Grants RESISTENCE to POISON effects A warm meat and mushroom stew, fortifies you against the trials ahead.
item_456.lead: Fortifying stew is a stew that can be crafted by combining bittercap mushrooms with any raw meat at a cooking pot. When consumed, it provides moderate sustenance, 5 lifeward, and gives the Fungal Fortitude perk, granting resistance to Poison buildup by 33% for 300 seconds. There is also a 5% chance to produce a rat roast whilst making fortifying stew.

item_458.lead: Garou hanging ornament 01 is created by first learning the blueprint, found in chests near Fractured Plains or inside vaults. Hanging ornaments should be placed on the underside of the upper floors to show the built product. [[File:Garou Hanging Ornament 01 (placed).png|thumb|right|A Garou hanging ornament when built.]]

item_459.lead: Garou hanging ornament 02 is created by first learning the blueprint, found in chests near Fractured Plains or inside vaults.
