item_460.lead: Garou hanging ornament 03 is created by first learning the blueprint, found in chests near Fractured Plains or inside vaults. Hanging ornaments should be placed on the underside of the upper floors to show the built product. [[File:Garou Hanging Ornament 03 (placed).png|thumb|right|A Garou hanging ornament when built.]]

item_461.lead: Garou hanging ornament 04 is created by first learning the blueprint, found in chests near Fractured Plains or inside vaults. Hanging ornaments should be placed on the underside of the upper floors to show the built product. [[File:Garou Hanging Ornament 04 (placed).png|thumb|right|A Garou hanging ornament when built.]]

item_462.desc: A colossal crustacean. A little soggy now, so best dry it.
item_462.lead: Raw giant krill is a Power Level 4 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire or grill into dried giant krill starting at Cooking level 41, and not burnt into burnt giant krill at level 50. It can also be used to make giant krill bait. It can be gathered from net fishing spots with at least a mystic net in Dowdun Reach.

journal.title: Fish
journal.text: Krill are tiny, harmless, little crustaceans, whose lives amount to little more than mass consumption by larger beasts. Yet, here on Ashenfall, the krill refuse to be the victim. Consuming anima they grow to unreasonable size, hoping to fight off any wood-be predators. They are rarely successful.

journal.title: Raw
journal.text: To its krill kin, this creature is a beast of epic proportions. The sort of monster of legend that would tower over mountains and shatter towers with a single swipe of its enormous claws. Here, though, it’s a bit like a big shrimp. Much less intimidating.

item_463.lead: Gnasher is a power level 6 monster that appears with Houndmaster Rexiton under The Garrison.

item_464.lead: Gold ore nodes are Mining resource nodes that can be found in the Bloodblight Swamp and in The Lake in Dowdun Reach, and can be mined for gold ore and sapphire with a iron pickaxe or better. Gold ore nodes respawn their gold ore after three in-game days, as long as the player is at least 100 metres away, and their built objects are not directly on the node.

journal.text: Few metals are as beloved as gold. Its glistening nature has attracted countless pursuers, and those who find a viable vein need never work again. Sadly, on Ashenfall, the economy is not quite so well established and gold is merely another crafting component. Still, remember where you found it, because once all this dragon malarky is dealt with, you might make a tidy sum selling the location to prospectors.

item_465.lead: Granite deposits are Mining resource nodes that can be found in Stormtouched Highlands, Fractured Plains, and the Chaktan Kara vault. Granite deposits can be mined for granite using a bronze pickaxe or better. Granite deposits respawn after two in-game days, as long as the player is at least 100 metres away, and their built objects are not directly on the node's spawn area.

journal.text: These great lumps of rock are sturdier than normal stone and excellent material for construction.

item_466.desc: Recovers some lost health. Made with irit and redberries.
item_466.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_466.lead: Healing potion is a potion that instantly heals 80 health points upon consumption. It is made with irit, 2 dwellberries, and glass vessel in a brewing cauldron.

journal.text: Hold a healing potion in your hands and doubt might enter the mind. Do you drink it? Do you apply it directly to the wound? Is it a suppository? Well, allow us to clarify: it is taken orally. A healing potion won't just address your egregious malady. It will help with minor nuisances, too. If you've got a spot on the inside of your nostril, it will tidy that up nicely. An armpit itch? Gone in seconds. Ingrowing toenail? Consider it done.

item_468.lead: Hearty crunchies are a food item that can be created through Cooking, by combining onions and either redberries or dwellberries at a cooking pot, and provides moderate sustenance and 5 lifeward when consumed. There is also a 5% chance to produce a rat roast whilst making hearty crunchies.

item_469.desc: PERK - FUNGAL FORTITUDE (300 SEC) Grants RESISTANCE to POISON effects A comforting vegetable soup with added mushrooms. Helps prepare you for a grueling day ahead.
item_469.lead: Hearty fortifying soup is a consumable food item that can be crafted by combining bittercap mushrooms with onions at a cooking pot. When consumed, it provides moderate sustenance, 5 lifeward, and gives the Fungal Fortitude perk, granting resistance to Poison buildup by 33% for 300 seconds. There is also a 5% chance to produce a rat roast whilst making hearty fortifying soup.

item_470.desc: A comforting vegetable soup, reminds you of rainy days sat by the fire.
item_470.lead: Hearty soup is a consumable food item that can be created through Cooking by combining onion with either potato or cabbage at a cooking pot and provides moderate sustenance and 5 lifeward when consumed.

item_471.desc: A nice hot stew. A taste of home.
item_471.lead: Hearty stew is a stew that can be created through Cooking by combining a meat with a vegetable at a cooking pot, and much like meat stew provides moderate sustenance and 5 lifeward when eaten, however to as opposed to meat stew at least one tier two ingredient is used, either the meat used is raw bestial meat or the vegetable used is onion, or both. There is also a 5% chance to produce a rat roast whilst making hearty stew.

item_472.lead: Hellhounds are power level 6 monsters located in Dowdun Reach.

item_473.lead: Hellrats are power level 6 monsters located in Dowdun Reach.

item_474.desc: Cooked on an anvil, which may or may not be a red herring.
item_474.lead: Raw herring is a Power Level 3 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire, grill, or with Infernal Rod into smoked herring starting at Cooking level 27, and not burnt into burnt herring at level 41. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally an oak rod in Fractured Plains at level 3 Fishing. Using anchovy bait increases the chance of catching one. It is the normal variant of a pristine herring.

journal.title: Fish
journal.text: It is said that if you can cut down the tallest tree in the forest, with one of these, then you can gain power and riches beyond your wildest imagination. Still, others claim that only scarlet versions of this fish can cause such a feat, and so the debate has raged for centuries. Truth be told, these fish are not particularly prized by lumberjacks anywhere.

journal.title: Raw
journal.text: A bit too floppy to be useful for lumberjacks.

item_476.lead: Houndmaster Rexiton is a power level 6 variant of the Black Knight guardian. He is located under Dowdun Reach within The Garrison.

journal.text: Houndmaster Rexiton doesn't realise the power that he wields. If he wanted to, he could trigger a huge power-shift in Dowdun Reach. The hellhounds obey his voice. His key, and his key only, turns in their locks each night. With a pointed word or a neglectful thought, he could cause chaos. Rexiton would never turn on the Reach because, at heart, he is a devout romantic. It's a combination that Lord Rasmodel noticed quickly and capitalised on. Rexiton was devout to both Zamorak and the Reach. He was an idealist who believed that Dowdun could become the centre of Gielinor. With Zamorak in the ascendance, and Dowdun so heavily fortified, he earnestly believed it could become the capital of the known world. Rexiton also wanted nothing more than for everyone to get along. The rifts of Dowdun Reach were seen as temporary to him. If he could form a bond with a hellhound, then the world could drop its squabbles and come together in peace. Lord Rasmodel couldn't think of a more lovable idiot to be in charge of one of the Reach's most formidable weapons.

item_478.lead: Icthlarin's Little Helper reward pack is an item given to the player upon completing the quest Icthlarin's Little Helper.

item_479.desc: A massive granite warhammer head. Garou masons imbue their stone weapons with wild anima to make them stronger than metal.
item_479.lead: The imbued granite maul head is one of the components used in crafting the granite maul after the quest Granite Mauled.

item_480.desc: Wriggly no more. Will need to be smoked before it goes near your palate.
item_480.lead: Raw infernal eel is a Power Level 4 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire, grill, or with Infernal Rod into smoked infernal eel starting at Cooking level 41, and not burnt into burnt infernal eel at level 50. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally a maple rod in Dowdun Reach at level 3 Fishing. Using giant krill bait increases the chance of catching one. It is the normal variant of a pristine infernal eel.

journal.title: Fish
journal.text: In truth, this is not a demonic fish, but rather the result of a strange magical and infernal energies. The eel is naturally a magically attuned fish, some generate small thunderstorms within their flesh, others blend with shadows to become almost entirely invisible. These eels, infused as they were with the abundant anima of Ashenfall, became changed by the energies of Dowdun Reach's demonic rites. Fortunately, the transformation, while a little disconcerting, only really serves to give the ma slightly spicy aftertaste.

journal.title: Raw
journal.text: Possessed of a strangely smoky flavour, with a surprisingly spicy kick. Best cooked very carefully, preferably in the presence of a priest.

item_485.lead: Iron ore nodes are Mining resource nodes that can be found in the Stormtouched Highlands and Fellhollow, and can be mined for iron ore with a bronze pickaxe or better. Iron ore nodes respawn their iron ore after three in-game days, as long as the player is at least 100 metres away, and their built objects are not directly on the node.

journal.text: Do you know the riddle of iron? No, me neither, asking for a friend. Iron is a durable metal, capable of creating some of the strongest arms and armour available.

item_487.lead: Mushroom kebab is a consumable food item that provides 120 health, 110 sustenance as well as the perks Foreman's Feast and Fungal Fortitude, which reduces the stamina cost of Woodcutting and Mining by 33% and reduces Poison buildup by 33% for 600 seconds. It is made with grilled mushrooms, fried cabbage, haunch, and bread in a cooking range and learned by unlocking Adept Culinaromancer at level 36 Cooking.

item_488.desc: To say that a Kot Pack is the belongings of a single KotHaar is something of a misrepresentation. You're actually holding the belongings of dozens of KotHaar, stretching back millennia. A KotHaar will carry the obsidian of their ancestors, which was reconstituted from their ancestors before them. The Kot Pack is a lineage, an ancestral record of the creature you killed. It puts things a little into perspective, and I'm sure you will treat it with the respect it deserves.
item_488.lead: Kot packs are a drop from KotHaar sentinels, and contains elder curiosities, rune essence, and obsidian devices.

journal.text: To say that a Kot Pack is the belongings of a single KotHaar is something of a misrepresentation. You're actually holding the belongings of dozens of KotHaar, stretching back millennia. A KotHaar will carry the obsidian of their ancestors, which was reconstituted from their ancestors before them. The Kot Pack is a lineage, an ancestral record of the creature you killed. It puts things a little into perspective, and I'm sure you will treat it with the respect it deserves.

item_489.desc: Recharges your armour with a large amount of lifeward.
item_489.lead: A large wardstone is a wardstone that recharges a player's armour with 90 lifeward in one second, but will inflict 25 Soulscourge on the player.

item_491.lead: Leather salvages are a type of salvage hotspot that can be looted to obtain various resources. They can be found in Dowdun Reach.

item_493.lead: Blue dragons, also known as lesser blue dragons are power level 6 dragons found in Dowdun Reach. They are said to have lightning-based abilities and drop blue dragon hide upon death.

item_494.lead: Lesser demons are power level 6 monsters located under Dowdun Reach. They are incredibly powerful and fast, dealing mostly heavy and fast blows. There are several variants of a lesser demon, shardbound lesser demon and Delrom.

item_495.desc: A potion that restores a moderate amount of health.
item_495.lead: Lesser healing potion is a potion that instantly heals 70 health points upon consumption. It is made with snapdragon, 2 dwellberries, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

journal.text: A step up from the weaker version, this potion allows the body to absorb more of the ambient anima, which, in turn, ramps up healing. The potion allows the drinker to shrug off greater physical trauma than before. For years, herblore masters have worked on versions that might work on emotional trauma, but there has been little success to date.

item_497.lead: Limestone rocks are Mining resource nodes located in The Lake underneath Dowdun Reach and along the river in The Courtyard. Players will need a mithril pickaxe to mine them.

journal.text: If you like the look of this rock, imagine what it could like in your house. Carve off a few chunks with your pickaxe and save up for a fetching limestone interior. The white will complement your eyes. You might be surprised to learn that Vannaka refuses to use limestone in any capacity. Someone told him that you can contract lime's disease from it, a rash that pains the joints and nerves. "Can't be spoiling these reflexes", he'd say, swinging an axe. Don't try to correct the man - it's not worth it.

item_498.desc: Don't worry, it's not alive anymore. Roast for best results.
item_498.lead: Raw lobster is a Power Level 4 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire or grill into roasted lobster starting at Cooking level 41, and not burnt into burnt lobster at level 50. It can also be used to make lobster bait. It can be gathered from net fishing spots with at least a fine net in Fellhollow. It is the normal variant of a pristine lobster.

journal.title: Fish
journal.text: Do not be fooled by the traders on the street who preach of rare black lobsters worth unparalleled wealth. These are lies. For the rare black lobster is, in truth, a source of great darkness and evil. Forged from {{RSL|Black stone (material)|black stone

journal.title: Raw
journal.text: Although some people insits that a lobster must be boiled alive to get the best flavour, you have already put it out of its misery - fortunately for the lobster. Now you can look forward to boiling it guilt-free for a much gentler flavour.

item_500.lead: Mages of Zamorak are power level 6 monsters located within Dowdun Reach. They can cast fire spells, teleport short distances, and call on the Flames of Zamorak under their targets.

item_501.lead: Maple trees are Woodcutting resource nodes and a type of tree found in Dowdun Reach, which require a mithril logging axe (or better) to cut.

journal.text: A tree full of bounties, whether it's maple logs for your crafting needs or maple syrup for cooking. The maple tree knows how much you need its wares and it keeps a ledger. You are indebted to the maple tree, and it will come to collect.

item_502.desc: Recharges your armour with a moderate amount of lifeward.
item_502.lead: A medium wardstone is a wardstone that recharges a player's armour with 60 lifeward in one second, but will inflict 25 Soulscourge on the player.

item_504.lead: Metal salvage are a type of salvage hotspot that can be looted to obtain various resources. They can be found in Dowdun Reach.

item_505.lead: Misc. salvage are a type of salvage hotspot that can be looted to obtain various resources. They can be found in Dowdun Reach.

item_507.desc: Why eat just one animal? A carnivore's delight!
item_507.lead: Mixed platter is a consumable food item that can be created through Cooking by combining raw bestial meat with any tier one meat (raw rat meat, raw bird meat, raw farm meat, or raw game meat) at a cooking pot and provides moderate sustenance and 5 lifeward when eaten.

item_508.desc: Your mouth waters just looking at it.
item_508.lead: Raw monkfish is a power level 7 food that can be captured at net fishing spots in the Umbral Sands region. Monkfish are so-called on Ashenfall due to the goddess Elidinis. The Moon Garou, having never seen a monk, adopted the name after the goddess herself named them.

journal.title: Fish
journal.text: There are, in fact, two variants of the monkfish. One is the Piscatoris monkfish, known for its gamey taste and slightly depressed countenance. The other is the Ashenfall monkfish, which has a more trout-like flavour and a happier, almost smirking countenance. Anglers, who like to simplify things, distinguish them by calling them 'sad boy' and 'happy boy'. Both monkfish are 'sad boys' when they're caught, of course.

journal.title: Raw
journal.text: It may be called the 'Ashenfall' monkfish, but you'd be hard-pressed to find it anywhere other than in Umbral Sands. That's mostly down to a lack of trade. The Moon Garou are an isolationist sort, preferring to keep their trading partners to other Moon Garou. Their closest non-garou partners would be the Black Knights but they, too, like to keep to themselves, and would prefer to deal with other humans over the garou. Which is a shame, really, as monkfish deserves to go continental. Ashenfall monkfish is like trout, but with a slight fizzing sensation, similar to popping candy. If you've got a child or garou cub who won't eat their fish, then try them on Ashenfall monkfish. In our house, it's a gateway fish, leading onto other, less gimmicky fish.

item_509.desc: A reward for helping the Moon Garou.
item_509.lead: Moon Garou packs are quest rewards given to the player by completing all of the reputation quests for each tribe in Umbral Sands. Different items are rewarded for completing each of the three tribes.

item_510.lead: Nosey is a power level 6 monster that appears with Rat Master Skrexis in The Menagerie.

item_511.desc: The image of a fearsome dragon. Used in crafting powerful equipment.
item_511.lead: The noxious draconic visage is an award obtained from the Wise Old Man in exchange for Velgar's head, which is obtained by killing Velgar during or after the quest Dragon Slayer. It can be used to upgrade the anti-dragon shield into the dragonblight shield.

item_512.lead: Oak trees are Woodcutting resource nodes and can be identified by different coloured leaves and darker bark than ash trees. Oak trees are located all over Brynmoor and Ghornfell. They can be chopped down using a bronze logging axe or better. Players will receive 28 oak logs in total upon chopping the entire tree and the stump.

journal.text: Oak Trees look down on the trees around them, convinced of their own superiority. Their bark is harder, stronger and more difficult to fell than their ash cousins.

item_513.lead: Game updates are changes that have been added to RuneScape: Dragonwilds and news that can impact the game at a later date. Updates mentioned below are only from the public early access release forward; closed alpha versions are not listed here. Updates are listed in reverse chronological order, and several dates may include multiple updates and news.

item_516.lead: Pip is a power level 6 monster that appears with Rat Master Skrexis in The Menagerie.

item_518.lead: Plant salvage are a type of salvage hotspot that can be looted to obtain various resources. They can be found in Dowdun Reach.

item_519.lead: Poison ichor is a basic item that comes from killing wild jade vines and putrid rats.

journal.text: Dropped by poisonous enemies. Nature is full of malicious little critters who carry toxins. Snakes, spiders, politicians, each of them has ways to make other creatures suffer. This ichor is prized by poisoners and alchemists, as it can be used to create deadly concoctions that will give someone, or something, a really bad day.

item_520.lead: Potion salvage are a type of salvage hotspot that can be looted to obtain various resources. They can be found in Dowdun Reach.

item_522.lead: Rat Master Skrexis is a power level 6 monster located within Dowdun Reach. They are able to cast fire spell, short distance teleport and call on the Flames of Zamorak under their targets.

item_524.lead: Ravens are power level 1 birds found all over Dowdun Reach.

item_526.desc: A delicious flank steak, covered in a fruity redberry glaze. Delightfully delicious!
item_526.lead: Redberry glazed roast flank is a consumable food item that can be cooked by combining redberries with raw bestial meat at a cooking pot, and provides moderate sustenance and 5 lifeward when eaten. There is also a 5% chance to produce a rat roast whilst making redberry glazed roast flank.

item_527.desc: A juicy piece of roasted meat with a tangy redberry glazing. Tasty!
item_527.lead: Redberry roast rat is a consumable food item that provides 30 health and 45 sustenance. It is made with rat roast and dried redberries in a stone range or a cooking range, however a player must interact with a stone range first to learn the recipe.

item_528.lead: Reek is a power level 6 monster that appears with Rat Master Skrexis in The Menagerie.

item_529.desc: Heavy platelegs made from Leather and Bone.
item_529.lead: Reinforced legs are a power level 2 armour piece that can be crafted at a crafting table.

item_530.lead: Trinkets is an equipment slot item that allows players to wears either rings or amulets to help them in training or in combat. Trinkets can be crafted on the Jeweler's Bench. Currently, only one trinket can be worn at a time.

item_531.lead: Trinkets is an equipment slot item that allows players to wears either rings or amulets to help them in training or in combat. Trinkets can be crafted on the Jeweler's Bench. Currently, only one trinket can be worn at a time.

item_533.lead: Rune essence geysers are resource nodes that can be found in multiple regions across Ashenfall. They hold multiple rune essence rocks that lie around them, and have at most three rune essence rocks float above the geysers. The floating rune essence rocks can be shot down by using magic weapon attacks, or a ranged weapon. They can also be harvested by casting Rocksplosion at them, which both the floating rocks and the ones on the ground will take three in-game days to respawn, as long as players do not place anything directly on the node's spawn.

journal.text: This strange material absorbs magical energy, causing it to defy gravity, among other things. It is best known for the creation of runes: powerful little stones that can be used to cast spells. A pickaxe is needed to harvest the essence. The floating essence rocks can be knocked out of orbit with a little effort, making them easier to mine.

item_535.desc: While it might be edible now, you'll need to fry it in this game.
item_535.lead: Raw salmon is a Power Level 3 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire, grill, or with Infernal Rod into fried salmon starting at Cooking level 27, and not burnt into burnt salmon at level 41. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally an oak rod in Fractured Plains at level 3 Fishing. Using feathered lure increases the chance of catching one. It is the normal variant of a pristine salmon.

journal.title: Fish
journal.text: The life of a salmon is one of great journey and strife. They swim back over great distances, leaping upstream in search of a cementing their legacy. It is tragic then, perhaps, that such journeys become the happy lunchtimes of bears and other animals.

journal.title: Raw
journal.text: The Wushanko islands are masters of turning this into a delicious and satisfying meal. Alas, you never did take the time to study their culinary ways and must apply heat to this meal, lest your eject your internalised failures upon Ashenfall’s soil.

item_539.desc: A small fish that was brought into this world to be fried and eaten.
item_539.lead: Raw sardine is a Power Level 2 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire, grill, or with Infernal Rod into fried sardine starting at Cooking level 12, and not burnt into burnt sardine at level 27. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally an ash rod in Temple Woods and Bramblemead Valley at level 3 Fishing. Using shrimp bait increases the chance of catching one. It is the normal variant of a pristine sardine.

journal.text: Sardines travel in large shoals; their lives spend as part of a grand community. There’s something a little tragic seeing one here on its own. Still, with a little heat, perhaps a sprinkle of salt and other seasonings, and you’ve got yourself a nice snack.

item_545.lead: Sergeant Blister is a power level 7 variant of the Black Knight guardian. They are located under Dowdun Reach within The Garrison. They must be defeated to obtain the Dreaming Stone Shard.

journal.text: You wanna know why they call me Blister? 'Course you do. You'd well to listen up. People love to gripe and fight in 'ere. Lotsa madness, lotsa grievances - it's gonna 'appen. But they know not to fight wiv'out Blister. I get called tout suite. I'm the one who handles the bets. You wanna make some extra dirt from a fight? You come to me. I give fair odds. Why Blister? I'm the one who grows fat an' happy from all the friction in this place. Like a blister on your foot, ain't it?

item_546.lead: Shardbound lesser demons are power level 6 variants of a lesser demon. They are located in Dowdun Reach under The Library and The Demon Gate. They must be fought and defeated in order to obtain the Dreaming Stone Shard

item_547.desc: Schrodinger's shrimp: could end up burnt or fried.
item_547.lead: Raw shrimp is a Power Level 2 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire or grill into sauteed shrimp starting at Cooking level 12, and not burnt into burnt shrimp at level 27. They can also be used to make shrimp bait. They can be gathered from net fishing spots with at least a coarse net in Temple Woods and Bramblemead Valley.

journal.title: Fish
journal.text: Almost all fishing careers begin with these little critters. Their number is practically infinite, so the universe responds by gifting them the survival instinct of an inebriated moth approaching the most magnificent flame. Many a new fishermen has found their diet consisting almost exclusively of these crunchy little things.

journal.title: Raw
journal.text: There are many ways to cook shrimp. Countless recipes that promise wonderful taste sensations. Right now, though, I would suggest you don’t really want to eat them. They’re all wriggly.

item_548.lead: Silver ore nodes are a Mining resource node that can be found in Bloodblight Swamp, and can be mined for silver ore and red topaz using a bronze pickaxe or better. Silver ore nodes respawn their silver ore after three in-game days, as long as the player is at least 100 metres away, and their built objects are not directly on the node.

journal.text: They say that silver is touched by the moon, explaining why lycanthropes are so affected by it. Silver makes for an exceptionally good magical conductor, making it highly prized by enchanters everywhere.

item_552.desc: Recharges your armour with a small amount of lifeward.
item_552.lead: A small wardstone is a wardstone that recharges a player's armour with 30 lifeward in one second, but will inflict 25 Soulscourge on the player. To unlock this wardstone, players must both create and equip any power level 2 chest.

item_556.desc: One of the ingredients for making glass, obtained from cooking Swamp Weed.
item_556.lead: Soda ash is a resource forgeable into molten glass (not present in-game), and is made from swamp weed. Soda ash is presently not in the game.

item_559.lead: Stone boulders are Mining resource nodes that can be found throughout Ashenfall and inside vaults, and can be mined with any pickaxe. Stone boulders respawn after two in-game days, as long as the player is at least 100 metres away, and their built objects are not directly on the node's spawn area.

journal.text: Large boulders can be found just about anywhere. With even the most basic pickaxe, they can be reduced to little more than pebbles, which are much more useful for crafting. It is perhaps humbling to see these centuries-old stones reduced to nothing.

item_561.lead: Summoner Flament is a power level 6 monster located within Dowdun Reach. They are able to cast fire spell, short distance teleport and call on the Flames of Zamorak under their targets.

item_562.desc: Perhaps you could learn from it
item_562.lead: The sun-bleached head wrap is a vestige that unlocks the desert hood.

item_565.lead: Textile salvage are a type of salvage hotspot that can be looted to obtain various resources. They can be found in Dowdun Reach.

item_567.lead: Thorny irit root requires a steel logging axe to fell. Thorny irit roots can be found in the town of Emberwood, near the surrounding larger lake, in and near the ruined buildings.

journal.text: Irit is normally much more manageable and leafy, but here in Fellhollow it was twisted into a hateful thorn-covered vine. Mind your fingers when harvesting it.

item_568.lead: Tin ore nodes are Mining resource nodes that can be found in Fractured Plains and Stormtouched Highlands, and can be mined for tin ore with a bone pickaxe or better. Tin ore nodes respawn their tin ore after three in-game days, as long as the player is 100 metres away, and their built objects are not directly on the node.

journal.text: Tin and copper are the classic double act, combining their essence to make superior bronze.

item_570.desc: A book filled with knowledge on how to swing a pickaxe. Awards a small amount of Mining XP.
item_570.lead: Tome of Mining - Vol 1 is a skill tome that is one of four rewards given after completing the Restless Ghosts quest. It can also be received occasionally from chests. When read, the tome gives 100 Mining experience.

item_571.desc: A book filled with knowledge on how to swing a pickaxe. Awards a decent amount of Mining XP.
item_571.lead: Tome of Mining - Vol 2 is a skill tome found in chests within Fellhollow. When read, the tome gives 400 Mining experience.

item_572.desc: A powerful tome containing ancient techniques of warfare. Grants a large amount of experience in the Attack, Magic and Ranged skills.
item_572.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_572.lead: The Tome of the Titan is a reward from completing the Black Knight's Fortress quest.

item_573.desc: A piece of cloth torn from one of Dowdun Reach's tapestries.
item_573.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_573.lead: The torn tapestry is a vestige that is found in a buried chest in Dowdun Reach. Upon studying the vestige, players can create the Dowdun Reach cape.

item_574.lead: Trinkets is an equipment slot item that allows players to wears either rings or amulets to help them in training or in combat. Trinkets can be crafted on the Jeweler's Bench. Currently, only one trinket can be worn at a time.

item_575.desc: Grill this trout on a fire. You will thank us later.
item_575.lead: Raw trout is a Power Level 2 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire, grill, or with Infernal Rod into grilled trout starting at Cooking level 12, and not burnt into burnt trout at level 27. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally an ash rod in Temple Woods and Bramblemead Valley at level 3 Fishing. Using feather bait increases the chance of catching one. It is the normal variant of a pristine trout.

journal.title: Fish
journal.text: There is little exciting one can say about trout, they have few advocates and fewer fans. Yet, they do taste delicious with a little lemon and a few herbs, so perhaps we should thank them for not being awful. One trout was awful. A villain. A monster who rose from the depths to bring terror to us all. Nah, just kidding – they’re trout… I got nothing.

journal.title: Raw
journal.text: Bonier than some of the other popular fishes, the trout is nevertheless one of the most regularly consumed freshwater fishes. Its flavour is heavily modified by its diet…which, on Ashenfall, is more than a little worrying if I’m honest.

item_576.desc: It may not look edible, but trust us: grill it and you're in for a treat.
item_576.lead: Raw undead bass is a Power Level 4 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire, grill, or with Infernal Rod into grilled undead bass starting at Cooking level 41, and not burnt into burnt undead bass at level 50. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally a willow rod in Fellhollow at level 3 Fishing. Using spooky bait increases the chance of catching one. It is the normal variant of a pristine undead bass.

journal.title: Fish
journal.text: Even in death there are some fisherfolk who spend their quiet moments hooking these creatures. They wait, rictus still, in patience and draw these wretched things from beneath the waves only to find their prey as dead and decayed as they are, and cast them back into the waters.

journal.title: Raw
journal.text: In life, these are gamy fish, sleek of form and delicious with a bit of lemon. In unlife... well... they're a little less appetising, and lemons are surprisingly sparse on Ashenfall. Still, needs must.

item_577.desc: A dead undead eel. We suggest you braise it.
item_577.lead: Raw undead eel is a Power Level 4 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire, grill, or with Infernal Rod into braised undead eel starting at Cooking level 41, and not burnt into burnt undead eel at level 50. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally a willow rod in Fellhollow at level 3 Fishing. Using lobster bait increases the chance of catching one. It is the normal variant of a pristine undead eel.

journal.title: Fish
journal.text: There is something deeply disturbing about a fish that remains to die. More disturbing still are the eels that slither and writhe and wriggle beneath the waters, their hearts no longer beating and their eyes filled with the milky-white film of rot and decay.

journal.title: Raw
journal.text: Sometimes, you have to ask yourself why you cook everything you find. Is this really going to make a succulent meal? Even dead it twitches occasionally, animated by some remnant of necromantic energy. Its flesh is partially decayed and the smell... oh the smell... I recommend cooking it very, very thoroughly.

item_578.desc: Perhaps you could learn from it
item_578.lead: Unyielding obsidian construct is a vestige that is dropped by the Tok-Xil and unlocks the toktz-ket-xil shield.

item_581.desc: A potion that restores a small amount of health.
item_581.lead: Weak healing potion is a potion that instantly heals 40 health points upon consumption. It is made with harralander, redberries, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

journal.text: Alchemists have long strived to create potions to rid mankind of all their ills. Normally, these potions are regeneratives that boost the body's ability to repair itself by drawing in the ambient anima and infusing it into the blood and tissue of the drinker. On the mainland, this changes healing from days to a matter of hours. On Ashenfall, the results are far more pronounced. The ambient anima of the region is so strong that wounds heal in moments. Cuts vanish as if they never were, wounds healing so quickly that even scars cannot form. Weaker versions of the potion burn themselves out before they can heal severe injuries, but the results are impressive nonetheless.

item_585.lead: Willow trees are Woodcutting resource nodes and a type of tree found in Fellhollow, growing in areas known as 'willow groves', which require an iron logging axe (or better) to cut.

journal.text: Legends say that willow trees house the weeping spirits of those who died in the woods. Anywhere but Fellhollow this would be nonsense, but in a land so heavily infused with the dead, you can’t rule it out.

item_586.lead: The Wintumber tree is a seasonal decoration that can be either built indoors or outdoors.

item_587.lead: Zamorakian acolytes are power level 6 monsters located in Dowdun Reach. They are able to cast fire spell and attack with their daggers.

item_589.desc: PERK: Antifire NEGATES and grants RESISTANCE to FIRE effects
item_589.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_589.lead: Antifire potion applies the perk Antifire, which removes Burning stacks and grants 33% resistance from Burning buildup for 300 seconds (5 minutes). It is crafted with irit, blue dragon scale dust, and glass vessel.

item_590.desc: Removes poison and grants resistance to it. Made with irit and poison ichor.
item_590.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_590.lead: An antipoison potion applies the perk Antipoison II, which removes Poison effects and grants 66% resistance from future Poison effects, compared to 33% resistance from Antipoison. It is crafted with irit, poison ichor, and glass vessel.

item_591.lead: Arcane infusion is a consumable drink item that provides 40 hydration and grants the perk Arcane Aligned, which reduces the stamina cost of magic attacks by 33% for 300 seconds. It is made with clean water, antler, and harralander in a stone range or Cooking Range. It is learned by unlocking Teamonger at level 14 Cooking, and requires interacting with a stone range first to learn the recipe.

item_592.desc: There seems to be something solid in the ash pile.
item_592.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_592.lead: Ash pile are a drop from a lesser demon and contains cursed essence, vile ashes, and infernal fragments.

item_593.desc: Fluffy and delicious, if only you had some butter.
item_593.lead: The baked potato is a power level 1 food item that provides 20 sustenance and 20 health when eaten. They can be cooked at either a campfire or grill.

item_594.lead: Beef & tomato stew is a consumable food item that provides 60 health and 65 sustenance. It is made with grilled tomatoes, steak, and dried redberries in a stone range or a cooking range, however a player must interact with a stone range first to learn the recipe.

journal.text: Tomatoes go well with just about everything. They enhance the flavours of anything they’re paired with and a nice beef stew is no exception. The combined flavours are comforting as well as filling, and almost make you forget that you’re a long way from home, on a continent filled with murderous dragons.

item_595.desc: A potent soup made from beltfish.
item_595.lead: Beltfish broth is a consumable food item that provide 130 health and 25 sustenance. It is made with steamed beltfish, peach, and fried cabbage and despite being a filling meal, can only be cooked in a cooking range.

item_596.desc: Made by combining smoked herring, seared anchovies and dried dwellberry.
item_596.lead: Berry drizzle pan-seared is a consumable food item that provides 160 health and 65 sustenance. It is made with smoked herring, seared anchovies, and dried dwellberries in a cooking range.

journal.text: "Pan-seared what?", you may ask. Well, pan-seared herring and anchovies, my good fellow. That might sound like a lot of fish in one meal, but some dwellberry acts as a sweet binding agent, making the whole eating-process rather delightful. It's a meal that's been around for generations, and you will often hear battle-worn adventurers wishing that they were back home for 'some of mammy's pan-seared'. We suspect that the berry drizzle pan-seared that you've made is NOT from mammy, however. We may be wrong: it's very possible that there's a quest that we've forgotten.

item_597.lead: Bird nests are drops found when felling trees. They contain assortments of skilling items that are dropped on the floor once opened. The ability to find bird nests is unlocked at 16 Woodcutting. In addition, opening a bird nest will provide 20 Woodcutting experience.

item_598.desc: If your feline hungry, eat a catfish. Grants the Sea Life perk.
item_598.lead: Braised catfish is a consumable food item that provides 120 health and 30 sustenance. It is made by cooking raw armoured catfish on either a campfire or a grill, and is used in stuffed catfish.

journal.text: Cooking a braised catfish is no mean feat. The process involves removing the armoured shell while managing to avoid the nerve-endings that, once severed, can release a poison that is fatal to humans. Then a chef needs to achieve precisely the right temperature to neutralise the latent poison without - again - activating it. Of course, if you want fewer friends, braised catfish is easy as pie to cook.

item_599.desc: Makes you queasy but does wonders for hunger. Grants the Warding Fish perk.
item_599.lead: Braised undead eel is a consumable food item that provides 60 health and 25 sustenance. It is made by cooking raw undead eel on either a campfire or a grill, and is used in fish fry.

journal.text: Sweet Saradomin on High, why on earth are you braising an undead eel? Are you a mind rune short of a rune pouch? Perhaps it's a dare, and you're going to get a hefty payout after making it? I can't think of any other reason, sane or otherwise, why you would fish for the horrible, wriggly thing, pick it up afterwards, then braise it, which - we may add - is a process to DRAW OUT FLAVOURS. What next? Bury it in the ground for days and eat it afterwards? I would not put it past you.

item_600.desc: Crusty brown outside, pillowy white inside.
item_600.lead: Bread is a power level 2 food. It can be created by using a bag of flour on a kiln. It heals 20 health and provides 30 sustenance when consumed.

item_601.desc: Too well done, but still edible.
item_601.lead: Burnt anchovies is a consumable burnt food item that has a chance to be made when cooking raw anchovies at a campfire or grill. It can be eaten or used for Composting.

item_603.desc: Too well done, but still edible.
item_603.lead: Burnt beltfish are consumable burnt food that have a chance to be made when cooking raw beltfish, providing 15 sustenance when consumed. It can also be used as compost in a compost bin.

item_604.lead: Burnt bread is a consumable burnt food item that has a chance to be made when cooking bread or guaranteed when intentionally overcooking bread at a campfire or grill. It can be eaten or used for composting.

item_605.lead: Burnt cabbages are a consumable burnt food item that have a chance to be made when cooking cabbage at a campfire or grill. They provide 10 sustenance when consumed or can be used for compost with the Farming skill.

item_607.desc: Too well done, but still edible.
item_607.lead: Burnt cadavaberries are a consumable burnt food item that have a chance to be made when cooking cadavaberries at a campfire or grill, providing 10 sustenance and 45 soulscourge when consumed, and have no uses beyond being eaten for food.

item_608.desc: Too well done, but still edible.
item_608.lead: Burnt desert sole are consumable burnt food that have a chance to be made when cooking raw desert sole, providing 15 sustenance when consumed. It can also be used as compost in a compost bin.

item_610.lead: Burnt eggs are a consumable burnt food item that have a chance to be made when cooking eggs at a campfire or grill.They provide 10 sustenance when consumed or can be used for compost with the Farming skill.

item_611.lead: Burnt fillets are a consumable burnt food item that have a chance to be made when cooking raw bird meat at a campfire or grill, providing 10 sustenance when consumed. However, burnt fillets, like any burnt food, can be used as compost at a compost bin.

item_612.lead: Burnt flanks are a consumable burnt food item that have a chance to be made when cooking raw bestial meat at a campfire or grill. They provide 10 sustenance when consumed or can be used for compost with the Farming skill.

item_613.lead: Burnt giant krill is a consumable burnt food item that has a chance to be made when cooking raw giant krill at a campfire or grill. It can be eaten or used for composting.

item_617.lead: Burnt lobster is a consumable burnt food item that has a chance to be made when cooking raw lobster at a campfire or grill. It can be eaten or used for composting.

item_618.lead: Burnt maple syrup is a power level 4 consumable burnt food item that has a chance to be made when cooking maple sap at a campfire or grill, and guaranteed when cooking maple syrup. It requires a Cooking level lower than 50 to burn from maple sap, and guaranteed with a level lower than 41. It provides 15 sustenance when consumed. Despite being a power level 4 item, it can only be deposited into a compost bin and not a super compost bin.

item_619.lead: Burnt monkfish are consumable burnt food that have a chance to be made when cooking raw desert sole, providing 15 sustenance when consumed. It can also be used as compost in a compost bin.

They have no uses beyond being eaten for food, but are planned to be usable for compost with the release of the Farming skill.

item_632.desc: Too well done, but still edible.
item_632.lead: Burnt trout is a consumable burnt food item that has a chance to be made when cooking raw trout at a campfire or grill. It can be eaten or used for composting.

item_633.desc: Too well done, but still edible.
item_633.lead: Burnt undead bass is a consumable burnt food item that has a chance to be made when cooking raw undead bass at a campfire or grill. It can be eaten or used for composting.

item_634.desc: Too well done, but still edible.
item_634.lead: Burnt undead eel is a consumable burnt food item that has a chance to be made when cooking raw undead eel at a campfire or grill. It can be eaten or used for composting.

item_635.desc: Too well done, but still edible.
item_635.lead: A burnt undead steak is a burnt version of undead meat. Restores 25 sustenance, gives 45 soulscourge and gives the ravenous effect, which lasts for 150 seconds.

item_636.desc: Too well done, but still edible.
item_636.lead: Burnt watermelon is a consumable burnt food item that has a chance to be made when cooking watermelon or guaranteed when intentionally overcooking watermelon jerky at a campfire or grill. It can be eaten or used for composting.

item_637.lead: Cactus water is a consumable drink item that provides 25 hydration and grants the perk Frosted Flavours that grants resistance to scorch buildup for 300 seconds.

journal.text: If you think about it, a cactus is a pocket oasis. It is foliage and water in a concentrated space, deep within the desert. And for a desperate adventurer like yourself, thirsty from the Scorch, it can taste many times better than a pool back in Brynmoor.

item_638.desc: Can be eaten raw, but wouldn't recommend it. Can be cooked alone or as an ingredient in cooking meals.
item_638.lead: Cadavaberries are a consumable food item that provides 10 sustenance but also 20 Soulscourge, which will cause damage over time if it builds to 100. They are also a power level 4 ingredient, which means they can be cooked at a campfire or grill into dried cadavaberries starting at Cooking Level 41, and not burnt into burnt cadavaberries at level 50. They can be collected from cadavaberry bushes in Fellhollow and Farmed from cadavaberry bush (Farming) grown from cadavaberry seeds.

journal.text: Don’t eat them. No, seriously, don’t. At least not raw. Cadavaberries are poisonous and deadly, often used in sinister ceremonies of ritual sacrifice. The cadavaberries on Ashenfall are equally toxic, but can be coaxed into good behaviour with the judicious addition of fire. The toxins can be burned away, providing a surprisingly pleasant tasting berry beneath. But, one must be careful, for preparing them wrong is the last mistake someone is likely to make.

item_639.desc: A refreshing fruity drink. Excellent for hydration.
item_639.lead: Cadavaberry infusion is a consumable drink item that provides 40 hydration and grants the perk Quenched, which reduces thirst drain by 33% for 900 seconds. It is made with clean water and dried cadavaberries in a cooking range.

item_640.desc: A technically edible steak. Morally? That's another question
item_640.lead: Cauterised undead steak is a power level 4 food item that provides 2 health and 25 sustenance as well as the perks Ravenous and Steadfast Stomach, which drains hydration and sustenance 20% faster and grants resistance to Wither effects for 150 seconds. It can be cooked from undead meat at either a campfire or a grill, and is used in dubious meat pie.

journal.text: Despite the appearance of their former owners and the deeply unpleasant smell emanating from it, undead meat is not rotten. It, like the nature of its former owners, is preserved in a state between life and death, as if it's on the cusp of souring, but never quite getting there. This unique nature gives it some very interesting properties, but sadly, flavour isn't one of them.

item_641.lead: Cheeky fryup is a consumable food item that provides 70 health and 70 sustenance as well as the perk Foreman's Feast, which reduces the stamina cost of Woodcutting and Mining by 33% for 300 seconds. It is made with rat roast, baked potato, and fried egg in a stone range or a cooking range. It is learned by unlocking Amateur Culinaromancer at level 16 Cooking, and requires interacting with a stone range first to learn the recipe.

journal.text: The grease. The sizzling scents. The feeling of your arteries withering just from a single glance at the dish. Is there anything in life as close to the divine as a nice, cheeky fry up? Popular among those who have consumed a few too many gnomish cocktails the night before, a cheeky fry up is hailed as a great cure for the pounding headache that follows such indulgences.

item_642.desc: A source of hydration, free from the taint of natural water sources.
item_642.lead: Clean water is a consumable drink item that provides 25 hydration on drinking. It can be used to make infusions.

item_643.lead: Cooling arcane infusion is a consumable drink item that provides 40 hydration as well as the perks Arcane Aligned and Frosted Flavours, which reduces the stamina cost of magic attacks by 33% and grants resistance to Scorch buildup for 600 seconds. It is made with cactus water, anima-infused bark, and toadflax in a cooking range.

journal.text: The stereotype is that wizards are the lazy corner of the combat triangle. They don't have to swing an axe like a melee warrior, or dodge behind mushrooms like a ranger. They stand stock-still, tossing fireballs: a glass cannon who crosses their non-spellcasting fingers, hoping that they don't get impaled on an arrow. But let me tell you: the wizard has to wear the heaviest, most uncomfortable robes, even in the heat of places like the Umbral Sands, and that is hard work. For those wizards, there is nothing like the cool, soothing taste of a cooling arcane infusion.

item_644.desc: A thirst-quenching drink that improves your reflexes.
item_644.lead: Cooling evasive infusion is a consumable drink item that provides 40 hydration and grants the perks Evasion and Frosted Flavours, which reduces the stamina cost of dodging by 33% and grants resistance to Scorch buildup for 600 seconds. It is made with cactus water, shocking plant bulb, and snapdragon in a cooking range.

journal.text: Dodging an enemy's attack is already 'cool' - just ask any of the top-ranking thieves from the Thieves' Guild, back on mainland Gielinor. But evading enemies while ice-cold yourself: that is the epitome of style.

item_645.desc: A hydrating drink infused with primal fury.
item_645.lead: Cooling ferocious infusion is a consumable drink item that provides 40 hydration as well as the perks Ferocious Fighter and Frosted Flavours, which reduces the stamina cost of physical attacks by 33% and grants resistance to Scorch buildup for 600 seconds. It is made with cactus water, dragon tooth, and toadflax in a cooking range.

journal.text: Vannaka approves this message. When you absolutely, positively have to kill every skeleton, demon or dragon in the room: accept no substitute. Except, perhaps, the cooling relentless infusion. Honestly, Vannaka can't pick between them.

item_646.desc: A thirst-quenching drink that puts a spring in your step.
item_646.lead: Cooling fleet-footed infusion is a consumable drink item that provides 40 hydration as well as the perks Fleet Footed and Frosted Flavours, which reduces the stamina cost of sprinting by 33% and grants resistance to Scorch buildup for 600 seconds. It is made with cactus water, onion, and snapdragon in a cooking range.

journal.text: Nine out of ten sprinters prefer it. After a burst of energy, nothing is quite like uncorking a cooling fleet-footed infusion to both settle the stamina and give you a touch of brainfreeze. Comes in low-fat and 'monster' variants.

item_647.desc: A tasty tipple that'll put a quiver in your quiver.
item_647.lead: Cooling relentless infusion is a consumable drink item that provides 40 hydration as well as the perks Relentless Ranger and Frosted Flavours, which reduces the stamina cost of ranged attacks by 33% and grants resistance to Scorch buildup for 600 seconds. It is made with cactus water, shrapnel, and toadflax in a cooking range.

journal.text: The best archers in the world are often said to have ice in their veins. It's an odd idiom - you would imagine that would be both uncomfortable and give an archer the shivers, precisely what they wouldn't want - but it's meant to indicate a steeliness, a cold efficiency. Well, imagine applying a tap (or faucet, if that's your orientation) to an archer and draining them for a drink. That would be the cooling relentless infusion.

item_648.desc: A source of hydration, tainted by the residue of a cataclysmic event.
item_648.lead: Dirty water is a consumable drink item that provides 10 hydration but also 20 Soulscourge, which will cause damage over time if it builds to 100. It can be cooked (purified) at a campfire or grill into clean water at any level of Cooking, but provides only 1 XP, unlike all other ingredients. It can be collected from ponds or any accessible body of water.

item_649.desc: A cloth shoulder back, contains useful smithing materials.
item_649.lead: Doric's smithing supplies is a container rewarded to the player after completing the first part of Doric's Quest.

item_650.desc: A cloth shoulder back, contains useful smithing materials.
item_650.lead: Doric's superior smithing supplies is a container rewarded to the player after completing the second part of Doric's Quest.

item_651.lead: A Dragon Slayer reward pack is a reward from completing two sections of the Dragon Slayer quest, Lost Adventurer and Fight for your Life. Players who open the pack will receive three harralander, three redberries, and three clay after completing Lost Adventurer, and players who open the second pack will receive one anti-dragon shield, one noxious draconic visage, and one Tome of the Dragon Slayer.

item_652.lead: A Dragon Slayer reward pack is a reward from completing two sections of the Dragon Slayer quest, Lost Adventurer and Fight for your Life. Players who open the pack will receive three harralander, three redberries, and three clay after completing Lost Adventurer, and players who open the second pack will receive one anti-dragon shield, one noxious draconic visage, and one Tome of the Dragon Slayer.

item_653.desc: Probably not poisonous. A neat little snack.
item_653.lead: Dried cadavaberries are a power level 4 food item that provides 20 sustenance and 20 health when eaten, and can be cooked at either a campfire or grill.

item_654.desc: Sweet and chewy, a great fruity snack.
item_654.lead: Dried dwellberries are a power level 3 food item that provides 20 sustenance and 20 health when eaten, and can be cooked at either a campfire or grill.

item_655.desc: Krills hunger with one bite. Grants the Sea Legs perk.
item_655.lead: Dried giant krill is a consumable food item that provides 50 health and 25 sustenance as well as the perk Sea Legs, which makes you immune to the slowing effects of water for 300 seconds. It is made by cooking raw giant krill on either a campfire or a grill, and is used in stir-fry and stuffed catfish.

item_656.lead: Dried peaches are a power level 1 food item made by cooking a peach at a campfire or grill. They provide 25 sustenance and 20 health when consumed.

item_657.desc: A little sour, but a tasty snack.
item_657.lead: Dried redberries are a power level 1 food item that can be cooked at either a campfire or a grill. Dried redberries provide 15 sustenance and 20 health when consumed.

item_658.lead: Dubious meat pie is a consumable food item that provides 50 health, 100 Sustenance, and 20 Soulscourge as well as the perks Ravenous and Steadfast Stomach, which drain thirst and hunger 20% faster and grant resistance to Wither effects for 300 seconds. It is made with roast pumpkin, cauterised undead steak, and bread in a cooking range.

journal.text: The smell from this pie is strange. Undertones of gamey meats, the tantalising touch of subtle herbs and spices. The pastry is crip{{sic

item_659.lead: Dwellberries are a consumable food item that provides 10 sustenance. They are also a Power Level 3 ingredient, which means they can be cooked at a campfire or grill into dried dwellberries starting at Cooking level 27, and not burnt into burnt dwellberries at level 41. They can also be used to make dwellberry infusion, feathered lure, as well as some potions, a decoration, and weapons. They can be collected from dwellberry bushes in Fractured Plains and Stormtouched Highlands, Farmed from dwellberries (Farming) grown from dwellberry seeds, and found in chests in Ghornfell.

journal.text: Pretty blue berries, go well in a cheesecake.

item_660.lead: Dwellberry crunchies are a consumable food item that provides 70 health and 40 sustenance. They are made with dried dwellberries and wheat in a stone range or a cooking range, however a player must interact with a stone range first to learn the recipe.

item_661.desc: A refreshing, fruity drink. Good for hydration.
item_661.lead: Dwellberry infusion is a consumable drink item that provides 40 hydration and grants the perk Quenched, which reduces thirst drain by 33% for 600 seconds. It is made with clean water and dwellberries in a stone range or cooking range. However, a player must interact with a stone range first to learn the recipe.

item_662.desc: Made by combining fried egg and fried salmon. Grants the Sea Life perk.
item_662.lead: Eggs royale is a consumable food item that provides 120 health and 30 sustenance as well as the perk Sea Life, which restores 3 health every second for 900 seconds. It is made with fried egg and fried salmon in a stone range or a cooking range, however a player must interact with a stone range first to learn the recipe.

journal.text: Do you know what they call an eggs royale in Asgarnia? 'Salmon and egg'. Barbarians. There aren't many flavours that go together as well as salmon and egg. Pork and cheese. Bread and butter. Fishing potions and a hangover.

item_663.desc: A thirst-quenching drink that improves your reflexes.
item_663.lead: Evasive infusion is a consumable drink item that provides 40 hydration and grants the perk Evasion, which reduces the stamina cost of dodging by 33% for 300 seconds. It is made with clean water and small animal fang in a stone range or a cooking range. However, a player must first interact with a stone range to learn the recipe.

item_664.desc: A hydrating drink infused with primal fury.
item_664.lead: Ferocious infusion is a consumable drink item that provides 40 hydration and grants the perk Ferocious Fighter, which reduces the stamina cost of physical attacks by 33% for 300 seconds. It is made with clean water, animal bone, and harralander in a stone range or cooking range. It is learned by unlocking Teamonger at level 14 Cooking, and requires interacting with a stone range first to learn the recipe.

item_665.desc: Roasted bird meat. Tastes like everything tastes.
item_665.lead: A fillet is a power level 1 food item that provides 20 sustenance and 20 health when eaten. It can be cooked at either a campfire or grill.

item_666.desc: Flammable and volatile, handle with care! Used to craft Fire arrows.
item_666.lead: Fire oil is an item that is unlocked at level 45 Ranged, where players can use fire oil to create fire arrows. Note that adding fire oil to arrows will change the damage property of the arrow from Ranged damage to Fire Magic damage and will apply a 60% burn buildup.

journal.text: Used to craft Fire arrows. Some people just like to watch the world burn… and you can too, with these new handy fire oils! That’s right, just lob one of these beauties at your enemies and watch them ignite. Enjoy their screams as their skin boils away and breathe in the delightful aroma of a fresh barbecue! Fire oil, like snake oil, was once the creation of a travelling merchant to Ashenfall. She had journeyed to Brynmoor alongside some of the Saradominist settlers, and with her she brought pungent unguents, elucidating elixirs, marvellous medicines, and weapons of localised destruction. When her wares summoned the call for refunds, she would dazzle the onlookers with a sudden fiery display and then disappear into the alleyways until she had been forgotten. She would then return in one of a staggering array of disguises, until the tragic day when her wagon hit a pothole during a quick getaway and her many, many, bottles of fire oils decided to sing the song of their people. Fortunately, even though she and everything she owned, tragically found itself reduced to smouldering atoms, her recipe lived on and found more conventional uses.

item_667.desc: Made by combining roasted lobster, braised undead eel and fried cabbage.
item_667.lead: Fish fry is a consumable food item that provides 180 health and 55 sustenance. It is made with fried cabbage, braised undead eel, and roasted lobster in a cooking range.

journal.text: A 'fish fry' is something of a misnomer as only the eel is a fish, and even that's questionable now that it's undead. The lobster is most definitely a crustacean, and a cabbage is a holy orb of sustenance, delivered by the majestic Brassica Prime. Therefore, not a fish. We give a fish fry a pass, mainly because it's a Fellhollow delicacy, once favoured by Ravanna. It was invented after a sailor saw a lobster and eel fighting and threw a well-aimed cabbage. He fried the result and lo, fish fry was born.

item_668.lead: Flank steak is a power level 3 food item that provides 25 sustenance, 30 health, as well as the perk Coagulated, which reduces Bleed buildup for 150 seconds. It can be cooked from raw bestial meat at either a campfire or a grill, and is used in roast dinner, meat pizza, meat sandwich, meat twist sandwich, and steak sandwich.

item_669.desc: A thirst-quenching drink that puts a spring in your step.
item_669.lead: Fleet-footed infusion is a consumable drink item that provides 40 hydration and grants the perk Fleet Footed, which reduces the stamina cost of sprinting by 50% for 300 seconds. It is made with clean water and feathers in a stone range or a cooking range. However, a player must first interact with a stone range to learn the recipe.

item_670.desc: PERK: Focused Agility Grants a 30% XP BOOST for the Agility Skill
item_670.lead: Lesser Focused Agility potion grants the perk Focused Agility, which provides a 5-minute (300-second) +30% XP boost for the Agility skill. It is made with avantoe, gold leaf, and glass vessel in a brewing cauldron.

item_671.desc: PERK: Focused Artisan II Grants a 30% XP BOOST for the ARTISAN Skill
item_671.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_671.lead: Focused Artisan potion grants the perk Focused Artisan II, which provides a 5-minute (300-second) +30% XP boost for the Artisan skill. It is made with irit, necrotic bonemeal, and glass vessel in a brewing cauldron.

item_672.desc: PERK: Focused Attack II Grants a 30% XP BOOST for the Attack Skill
item_672.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_672.lead: Focused Attack potion grants the perk Focused Attack II, which provides a 5-minute (300-second) +30% XP boost for the Attack skill. It is made with irit, small animal fang, and glass vessel in a brewing cauldron.

item_673.desc: PERK: Focused Construction II Grants a 30% XP BOOST for the Construction Skill
item_673.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_673.lead: Focused Construction potion grants the perk Focused Construction II, which provides a 5-minute (300-second) +30% XP boost for the Construction skill. It is made with irit, ground sandstone, and a glass vessel in a brewing cauldron.

item_674.desc: PERK: Focused Cooking II Grants a 30% XP BOOST for the Cooking Skill
item_674.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_674.lead: Focused Cooking potion grants the perk Focused Cooking II, which provides a 5-minute (300-second) +30% XP boost for the Cooking skill. It is made with irit, cabbage, and glass vessel in a brewing cauldron.

item_675.desc: PERK: Focused Farming II Grants a 30% XP BOOST for the Farming Skill
item_675.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_675.lead: Focused Farming potion grants the perk Focused Farming II, which provides a 5-minute (300-second) +30% XP boost for the Farming skill. It is made with irit, undead bone, and glass vessel in a brewing cauldron.

item_676.desc: PERK: Focused Fishing II Grants a boost to your Fishing XP for a short period of time.
item_676.lead: Focused Fishing potion grants the perk Focused Fishing II, which provides a 5-minute (300-second) +30% XP boost for the Fishing skill. It is made with irit, grilled trout, and glass vessel in a brewing cauldron.

item_677.desc: PERK: Focused Mining II Grants a 30% XP BOOST for the Mining Skill
item_677.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_677.lead: Focused Mining potion grants the perk Focused Mining II, which provides a 5-minute (300-second) +30% XP boost for the Mining skill. It is made with irit, coarse animal fur, and glass vessel in a brewing cauldron.

item_678.desc: PERK: Focused Runecrafting II Grants a 30% XP BOOST for the Runecrafting Skill
item_678.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_678.lead: Focused Runecrafting potion grants the perk Focused Runecrafting II, which provides a 5-minute (300-second) +30% XP boost for the Runecrafting skill. It is made with irit, feathers, and glass vessel in a brewing cauldron.

item_679.desc: PERK: Focused Woodcutting II Grants a 30% XP BOOST for the Woodcutting Skill
item_679.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_679.lead: Focused Woodcutting potion grants the perk Focused Woodcutting II, which provides a 5-minute (300-second) +30% XP boost for the Woodcutting skill. It is made with irit, redberries, and glass vessel in a brewing cauldron.

item_680.desc: A hunger-reducing snack made with fried cabbages and grilled mushrooms.
item_680.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_680.lead: Forager's sandwich is a consumable food item that provides 70 health, 80 sustenance as well as the perks Knowledgable Nourishment and Fungal Fortitude, which increases experience gain in all skills by 10% and reduces Poison buildup by 33% for 600 seconds. It is made with fried cabbage, grilled mushrooms, and bread in a cooking range after finding the recipe in the garrison in Dowdun Reach.

journal.text: Brassica Prime approves of this sandwich. Although, the mushrooms are a little much: they could probably have been thinned out. Maybe removed? Yes, remove them. The bread, too. Is it needed? Would you perhaps consider removing the envelope of bread that houses the sweet cabbage missive? Your dribbly jowls will thank us.

item_681.desc: Yum! Maybe I do like cabbage.
item_681.lead: Fried cabbage is a power level 1 food item that can be cooked at either a campfire or grill. Fried cabbages have 20 sustenance and 20 health when consumed.

item_682.lead: Fried eggs are a power level 1 food item made by cooking an egg at a campfire or grill. Fried eggs have 20 sustenance and 20 health when consumed.

item_683.desc: A pungent meal that brings a tear to your eye.
item_683.lead: Fried onions are a consumable food item that provide 20 sustenance as well as the perk, Grounded, which reduces the amount of shock damage taken for 150 seconds. They can be cooked from onion at either a campfire or a grill, and are used in squeaking sausage, wild pie, and steak sandwich.

item_684.desc: For when you feel like a hungry bear. Grants the Sea Life perk.
item_684.lead: Fried salmon is a consumable food item that provides 70 health and 20 sustenance as well as the perk Sea Life, which restores 3 health every second for 300 seconds. It is made by cooking raw salmon on either a campfire or a grill, and is used in eggs royale.

journal.text: Fried salmon may not be the most substantial or healing of fish, but it's celebrated for its moist texture and delicious taste. Famously, it was the subject of a smear campaign from the Saradominist church to get it banned as a foodstuff, as they objected to the populace describing it as 'moist'. They deemed the adjective 'unsaintly'.

item_685.desc: Delicious little fishies. Grants the Warding Fish perk.
item_685.lead: Fried sardine is a consumable food item that provides 30 health and 15 sustenance, as well as granting the perk Sea Life, which restores 3 health every second for 180 seconds. It is made by cooking raw sardine on either a campfire or a grill, and is used in sauteed sardines and lesser Focused Fishing potion.

journal.text: A fried sardine, also known as a charred pilchard or 'pilcharred', is the go-to snack for a fisherman's pocket. If you see a stoic fisherman who talks very little, it's likely because they've got a mouthful of fried sardine and don't want to reveal the bones between their teeth. Fried sardines were also the subject of a failed business venture by a dwarf called Drorkar. He tried to manufacture 'tins' that would contain these sardines, with smithed 'rings' to open their tiny metal coffins. It was roundly rejected and cost the dwarf a great deal.

item_686.desc: A fruit party, wrapped in golden pastry.
item_686.lead: Fruit pie is a consumable food item that provides 90 health and 85 sustenance. It is made with dried redberries, dried dwellberries, and bread in a cooking range.

journal.text: Grannies everywhere are masters of this dish. Delicious fruits, a touch of sugar, some delightful pastry and that final ingredient - a dark blessing to ancient gods. Or love, that works too. With the pact complete, these pies allow you those fond memories of comfort, hope and family. Something much needed out in the wilds of Ashenfall.

item_687.desc: A brutal bag sewn from hide and sinew.
item_687.lead: A garou pack is dropped from killing garou berserkers, garou druids, garou hunters, garou thanes, and the Garou King.

item_688.desc: A warming dish made with roast pumpkin, maple syrup and dried redberry.
item_688.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_688.lead: Glazed pumpkin sandwich is a consumable food item that provides 80 health and 100 sustenance as well as the perks Knowledgable Nourishment, Foreman's Feast, and Soul Food, which increases experience gain in all skills by 10%, reduces the stamina cost of Woodcutting and Mining by 33%, and restores 8 health every 5 seconds for 600 seconds. It is made with dried redberries, roast pumpkin, maple syrup, and bread in a cooking range after finding the recipe nearby Zanik in the Dowdun Reach underground.

journal.text: Not only is the roast pumpkin sandwich glazed because it is doused in delicious maple syrup; it is also glazed in the modern parlance, since it is showered with excessive, unwarranted or exaggerated praise. This makes it double-glazed. Like a window.

item_689.desc: A cloth shoulder bag, grimy and poorly kept.
item_689.lead: A goblin pack is dropped from killing goblin warriors, goblin archers, goblin runts, and goblin bruisers.

item_690.lead: Grilled mushrooms are a power level 2 food item that provide 20 sustenance, 20 health, and the perk Fungal Fortitude, which reduces Poison buildup by 33% for 150 seconds. They can be cooked from bittercap mushroom at either a campfire or a grill, and are used in pungent omelette, mushroom kebab, forager's sandwich, and steak sandwich.

item_691.desc: Fire really brings out the flavour.
item_691.lead: Grilled tomatoes are a power level 1 cooked food, made from tomatoes at either a grill or campfire. Players have a chance to burn the tomato, resulting in burnt tomatoes.

journal.text: Somehow still juicy, even after a judicious application of fire.

item_692.desc: Stave off hunger with this tasty bite. Grants the Sea Life perk.
item_692.lead: Grilled trout is a consumable food item that provides 40 health and 15 sustenance. It is made by cooking raw trout on either a campfire or a grill, and is used in herb baked trout and Focused Fishing potion.

journal.text: Until recently, grilled trout was prescribed by doctors thanks to its regenerative properties. 'A grilled trout a day will keep the gout away' was the common phrase. After a study by the Cook's Guild in far-off Varrock, however, it was found that regular eaters of grilled trout were 20% more likely to contract gout. Don't let that stop you enjoying the bitter notes of a trout. The Cook's Guild did a study and found that 75% of gout-inflicted people thought it was totally worth it.

item_693.desc: Undead and makes you unhungry. Grants the Sea Life perk.
item_693.lead: Grilled undead bass is a consumable food item that provides 80 health and 25 sustenance as well as the perk Sea Life, which restores 3 health every second for 600 seconds. It is made by cooking raw undead bass on either a campfire or a grill, and is used in undead delight.

journal.text: Only moderately less disgusting than braising an undead eel is grilling an undead bass. At least you can close your eyes and imagine what the bass once was: a tasty fish that took a wrong turn at Ardougne and ended up in the Withering. At some point in the future, some forward-thinking chef will determine that grilled undead bass is a delicacy. Right now, however, we look at you with the stinkiest of eyes and think 'for shame'.

item_694.desc: Roasted game meat. Tender and tasty.
item_694.lead: Haunch is a consumable food item that can be cooked at either a campfire or grill.

item_695.desc: Made by combining grilled trout and a baked potato. Grants the Sea Life perk.
item_695.lead: Herb baked trout is a consumable food item that provides 100 health and 35 sustenance. It is made with grilled trout and baked potato in a stone range or a cooking range, however a player must interact with a stone range first to learn the recipe.

journal.text: Cathan was known for his love of herb baked trout. He would often claim it was 'the best thing you could do with a tater'. That was until Vannaka picked up a potato, threw it halfway across Temple Woods, and knocked the Party Hat off of Dionysius's head. Cathan subsequently admitted that herb baked trout was 'the second-best thing you could do with a tater'.

item_696.desc: Removes poison and grants resistance to it.
item_696.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_696.lead: Lesser antipoison potion grants the perk Antipoison, which removes Poison stacks and grants 33% resistance from Poison buildup for 10-minutes (600 seconds). It is made with toadflax, swamp weed, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

journal.text: While the weaker variant of antipoison is sufficient for everyday usage, there are some situations that require a more potent resistance. The toxic mists in Ghornfell, over the swamps, are more powerful than a weaker resistance will protect against. These lesser potions strengthen the immune system and keep the toxic miasma from the drinker’s blood. Imperfect, still, but a much greater chance of survival.

item_697.desc: PERK: Focused Strikes INCREASED chance of landing CRITICAL HITS with MELEE ATTACKS
item_697.lead: Lesser Attack potion grants the perk Focused Strikes, which increases the chance of landing critical hits with melee attacks by 25% for 10-minutes (600 seconds). It is made with snapdragon, ground granite, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

item_698.desc: PERK: Focused Agility Grants a 15% XP BOOST for the Agility Skill
item_698.lead: Lesser Focused Agility potion grants the perk Focused Agility, which provides a 10-minute (600-second) +15% XP boost for the Agility skill. It is made with snapdragon, silver leaf, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

item_699.desc: PERK: Focused Artisan Grants a 15% XP BOOST for the ARTISAN Skill
item_699.lead: Lesser Focused Artisan potion grants the perk Focused Artisan, which provides a 10-minute (600-second) +15% XP boost for the Artisan skill. It is made with snapdragon, ground clay, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

item_700.desc: PERK: Focused Attack Grants a 15% XP BOOST for the ATTACK Skill
item_700.lead: Lesser Focused Attack potion grants the perk Focused Attack, which provides a 10 minute (600 second) +15% XP boost for the Attack skill. It is made with snapdragon, ram horn, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

item_701.desc: PERK: Focused Construction Grants a 15% XP BOOST for the CONSTRUCTION Skill

journal.text: Although humans cannot use magic without runes, they can become quite proficient conduits for power. A wizard and a farmer in possession of the same runes do not produce the same results; the former far outshines the latter. This revelation made some farmers pretty upset. For years, they had ranted to their cows and sheep about how wizards were just snooty uppity types with shiny rocks. Yet, faced with the evidence, there was no denying that a farmer and a wizard weren't equals in disguise. One farmer wanted to level the playing field by bringing in a local witch who had a grudge against the snooty men in blue robes. Between the two of them, they found a way to use a magical potion to improve a person's connection to their own latent magic. Those who drank the potion were able to cast spells more efficiently and with greater skill than they ever could before. The farmer wanted to use this new advantage to raze the tower to the ground, put the wizards in their place, and claim magic as a tool of the people. Unfortunately, the witch envisioned a different future, one that sparkled with glittering gold coins. She died happily, wealthier than she had ever dreamed and surrounded by adoring young suitors vying for a slice of her inheritance. The farmer died after being trampled to death by cows tired of his grumbling.
