item_1116.lead: Coarse thread is a material item created at a spinning wheel. It can be crafted using either 1 flax or 3 coarse animal fur, either of which will create a single coarse thread.

journal.text: Woven strands that create a more durable thread. Useful in a wide range of crafting projects.

item_1118.desc: Mined from copper deposits. It can be smelted at a Furnace.
item_1118.lead: Copper ore is a basic Mining material mined from copper ore nodes, which are mainly found in the Fractured Plains. It can be smelted at a furnace along with Tin to produce bronze bars.

journal.text: Shiny and metallic, combine with tin to make bronze bars.

item_1120.desc: Drops from a volatile bulbous plant that explodes when hit. Can be spun at the spinning wheel to create fine thread.
item_1120.lead: Corpse cotton is a drop from zogres and corpse cotton plants which is used to create fine thread.

journal.text: The corpse flower is a peculiar creature. Strange, almost flesh-like sacks, filled with a noxious gas that explodes upon contact with the air. The resulting mass of fibres looks disturbingly like thin strips of a cadaver's skin, earning it the name "corpse cotton" by the more macabre Emberwood villagers. In truth it's little more than thick plant fibres that can be woven together into a smooth, durable and, frankly, fashionable fabric.

item_1121.desc: Corpse Cotton seeds. Equip and use them to scatter these into a farming plot and start growing! Best Planted in Fellhollow plots.
item_1121.lead: Corpse cotton seeds are a type of seed, used in the Farming skill. They can be used to grow Fellhollow's corpse cotton plants in a farming plot. However, it is best to plant them in willow farming plot. Planting the seeds in a farming plot will yield 5 experience Farming. Corpse cotton seeds can be obtained from harvesting wild corpse cotton plants.

journal.text: Popular with necromantic horticulturalists, the corpse cotton plant is as useful as it is mildly disturbing. These seeds will allow you to avoid getting yourself blown up in random locations, instead allowing you to access this dreadful plant in the comfort of your own garden.

item_1124.desc: Harvested from demons. Can be used as a tanning agent at the tannery.
item_1124.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_1124.lead: Cursed essence is a basic material required for making cursed leather at the tannery.

journal.text: Cursed essence is a magical agent often used in tanning. It is also something of a curiosity, one that a simple tanner can't readily explain. It goes further than simply binding itself to material; it latches onto it, almost parasitically. Demonologists have a theory that, altough cursed essence drops from the avernic demons of Dowdun Reach, it is actually cthonic in nature. It would explain the tendril-like tenacity.

item_1125.desc: A sinister leather. Used in crafting.
item_1125.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_1125.lead: Cursed leather is thicker and more resilient than draconic leather. Two draconic leather and one cursed essence is required to craft it at a tannery.

item_1126.desc: Made by combining necrotic bonemeal and vile ashes. A crafting component.
item_1126.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_1126.lead: Demonic oil is one of the materials required for making power level 6 armour.

journal.text: Combine corrupt bonemean and vile ashes and the result is demonic oil. We should be specific about waht kind of oil this is: please do not pour it into a frying pan or use it on a squeaky hinge. This is potent oil, as the "demonic" prefix will attest. It is used for crafting, and solely for crafting. Now you've got us wondering what would happen if you did actually add it to a frying pan or a squeaky hinge. Oviously, please don't do it. But if you happen to do it, through an accident or momentary lack of wisdom, could you let us know what happens?

item_1127.desc: A coarse but hard-wearing fabric made from local flora.
item_1127.lead: Desert cloth is created with a loom and is primarily used for power level 7 armour.

item_1128.desc: A strong but rough thread spun from desert weed.
item_1128.lead: Desert thread is a material item created at a spinning wheel.

journal.text: By spinning desert weed into useful fibres, you can create yourself a nice bundle of desert thread. This thread is useful for all manner of tailoring enterprises.

item_1129.desc: A hearty plant native to the region. Can be spun into a durable thread
item_1129.lead: This article is about the resource. For the Plant itself, see Desert Weeds.

item_1130.desc: A handful of Desert Weed seeds. Equip and use them to scatter these into a farming plot and start growing! Best planted in Umbral Sand plots.
item_1130.lead: Desert weed seeds are a type of Umbral Sand seed, used in the Farming skill. Desert weed seeds can be used to grow Desert Weed (Farming) in a farming plot. However, it is best to plant them in a yew farming plot.

journal.text: Why is Umbral Sands yellow? Because the desert weed! Desert weed is an admirable plant, mainly for its ability to survive no matter the conditions. Even when there are no nutrients in the sand, water is scarce, and the temperature only exists at the extremes, the desert weed is the little plant that could. It finds potential in the tiny cracks between death and more death. We are all playing this little survival game, but perhaps the desert weed is out-performing us all.

item_1131.desc: A rare and precious gem, coveted by jewelers.
item_1131.lead: Diamond is a gemstone that can be obtained from mining coal nodes. It can be found if the player has unlocked the Gem Prospector perk at level 16 Mining. It can be manually mined with an appropriate pickaxe or using the Rocksplosion spell.

item_1132.desc: Why did they laugh when I bought this? Sold by local traders.
item_1132.lead: Dihydrogen monoxide is a basic item that can be bought from Umbral Sands merchants for 25 garou chit. Unlike most drinks, this cannot be consumed.

journal.text: If a smiling garou sells you some 'human salts', or 'dinner dust' then be wary. There is a good chance that the garou trader doesn't like you and is selling you one of Umbral Sands' common compounds: dihydrogen monoxide. The scientists among you will perk up your ears: dihydrogen monoxide is a compound that forms a base for so many toxic substances and diseases. It's not 'dinner dust', as the cheeky garou might have suggested. Put it in a vial, keep it away from the hands of grasping children, and use it with care.

item_1133.desc: The skin of a savage beast.
item_1133.lead: Dire wolf hide is dropped from a dire wolf and can be crafted into dire wolf leather at the tannery.

item_1134.desc: The tanned hide of a savage beast.
item_1134.lead: Dire wolf leather can be created by tanning dire wolf hide at a tannery.

item_1135.desc: A sturdy leather made from draconic hide, or from tanning hard leather with dragon blood.
item_1135.lead: Draconic leather is thicker and more resilient than hard leather. Players can create draconic leather with dragonwolf hide or dragon blood and three pieces of hard leather in a tannery.

item_1136.desc: Scruffy organic bits and pieces that can be combined to make draconic leather.
item_1136.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_1136.lead: Draconic leather scraps are a basic material used to craft draconic leather at a tannery.

item_1137.lead: Draconic visages are items that are collected after defeating either Velgar, Imaru, or Fuzan. They may refer to:

item_1138.desc: Harvested from dragons and dragonwolves. Used as a tanning agent at the tannery.
item_1138.lead: Dragon blood is a drop from dragon wolves and dragons.

journal.text: The blood of a dragon is a strange thing. It is infused with magic in a way that most other creatures can't match, a side effect of the alchemical processes that created their kind. Dragonkin scientists needed blood that could adapt to a wide range of chimeric additions to the body. As such, dragon blood, unlike human blood, doesn't possess any particular type, and each could act as donor{{sic|"a donor" not "donor"

item_1139.desc: A rare and precious gem, coveted by jewelers.
item_1139.lead: Dragonstone is a gemstone obtained from mining adamant ore nodes. It can be found if the player has unlocked the Gem Prospector perk at level 16 Mining. It can be manually mined with an appropriate pickaxe or using the Rocksplosion spell.

item_1140.desc: A piece of dragon tooth, extracted from a dragon skull found in the Highlands.
item_1140.lead: Dragon teeth can be obtained either by mining teeth from the head of the dragon skull in the Stormtouched Highlands or by killing lesser dragons. It is one component of the challenge horn, which is used in the Dragon Slayer quest. Players will need to have an iron pickaxe to mine this item. Dragon teeth respawn after two in-game days, as long as the player is at least 100 metres away, and their built objects are not directly on the spawn area.

item_1141.desc: Dropped from felled draconic beasts. Can be processed at the tannery.
item_1141.lead: Dragonwolf hide is a drop from dragon wolves and Doric's smithing supplies. Dragonwolf hide is used to make draconic leather at the tannery.

journal.text: Do not pity the dragonwolf. Oh, you don't? That's fine then. Yes, horrible little blighters aren't they? Their teeth are too jagged and they're far too aggressive for my tastes. Still, it seems that deadly critters don't just want to roll over and die so you can harvest their skin, who'd have thought? The dragonwolf is an experiment that didn't quite go right. It wasn't wrong, exactly, it was certainly a step in the direction their creator wanted, but like most Dragonkin experiments, they was never "good enough". Too warm-blooded. Too fluffy. Too weak. Fortunately, the crafters in Emberwood were not quite so picky. They found the hide to be incredibly durable and hardy, whilst remaining surprisingly flexible. They would craft wonderous outfits from the tanned leather, trying to emulate their winged overseers.

item_1142.lead: Dried tea leaves is a basic item processed from tea leaves at the kiln. It is used to make ground tea leaves at the grindstone.

journal.text: It's almost impossible to hold dried tea leaves up to the nose, have a huff, and not go "aaaaaah" in a deep, relieved sort of manner. It's the smell of lazy Sunday afternoons, butt in a rocking chair, wistfully thinking back to your golden years.

item_1143.desc: A dwellberry seed. Equip and use them to scatter these into a farming plot and start growing! Best planted in Ghornfell plots.
item_1143.lead: Dwellberry seeds are a type of Ghornfell seed, used in the Farming skill. Dwellberry seeds can be obtained from harvesting wild dwellberry bushes.

journal.text: Garou consider dwellberries to have spiritual significance. Their priests believe that if they are crushed into paste and used as a war paint, they can ward off evil spirits, misfortune, and vermin. The seeds are often used in this process, creating a powdery texture that can make it easier to spread the paint across the fur.

item_1144.desc: A symbol of the earth's might, essential for earth-based magic. Runes are retained if you happen to die
item_1144.lead: Earth runes can be crafted at a rune altar at level 15 Runecrafting or higher.

item_1145.desc: Dropped from aggressive spirits or extracted from wither hearts. Used in crafting.
item_1145.lead: Ectoplasm is a basic material dropped by Spirits such as lost souls or acquired by processing one withered heart in a kiln for a yield of three. It may be beneficial for players to kill lost souls instead of rotsworn enemies because the beginning stages of being Soul Rifted include power level 2 lost souls spawning instead of power level 5 rotsworn skeletons, making it easier to receive ectoplasm. If going this route, quickly escape out of the soul rift by being near a Purification Pool whilst in the soul rift process.

item_1146.lead: Eggs are a Power Level 1 raw ingredient, which means they can be cooked at a campfire or grill into fried egg starting at Cooking level 1, and not burnt into burnt egg at level 12. They can also be used to make Victoria sponge cake. They are found in bird nests from trees, dropped by chickens in Bramblemead Valley and Dowdun Reach, and from terrorbirds in the Fractured Plains.

item_1147.desc: Obsidian curiosities that feel pleasing in the hand. Can be ground and smelted into pure obsidian.
item_1147.lead: Elder curiosities is a basic item obtained from kot packs dropped by KotHaar sentinels or from chests found in Umbral Sands. It can be processed into ground obsidian at a grindstone.

journal.text: On mainland Gielinor, the TzHaar and TokHaar have a hereditary forging process. Their entire body mass, every ounce of them, is reconstituted from their ancestors via the Elder Kiln. Depending on your philosophical leanings, they ARE their ancestors, carrying the memories and materials of their predecessors onto a new life. The KotHaar have taken a different path. They are genealogical alloys. The material of their ancestors is included in the forging process within the Cave of Screams, but there is a thick vein of something else in their composition. It is difficult to know what this 'mixer' is - whether it is from the Lens, the finder of the Lens, or Fuzan's fire - but the result is a race that the TzHaar would consider heretical. The KotHaar have lost any memory of their ancestors, and those that have been cast into the Cave of Screams are all in thrall to Fuzan.

item_1148.lead: Emeralds are a gemstone. They currently cannot be legitimately obtained.

item_1149.desc: What is it about feathers that fascinates a fish? A great way to bait them. Trout seems the most susceptible. increases the catch chance of this fish.
item_1149.lead: Feather bait is a power level 2 Fishing bait crafted at the crafting table. It increases the chance of catching trout. Players can store the bait in a tackle box, which holds up to 48 baits.

journal.text: Some fish are drawn to feathers. Something about the colours and the way the water dances around them, it's almost hypnotic to them.

item_1150.desc: Entice Salmon with a knotted ball of bird knock-offs. Increases the catch chance of this fish.
item_1150.lead: Feathered lures are a power level 3 Fishing bait crafted at the crafting table. It increases the chance of catching salmon. Players can store the bait in a tackle box, which holds up to 48 baits.

journal.text: Sometimes a feather alone isn’t enough, there must be flavour as well. Delicious, sticky, berry juice is pressed into this lure, so that the taste of it might spread through the water and attract the attention of fish with fruitier palettes.

item_1151.desc: Gathered from avian creatures and nests. Feathers are used to fletch arrows.
item_1151.lead: Feathers are obtained by killing birds, such as chickens and terrorbirds, and used to fletch arrows.

item_1152.desc: A complex network of fibres and water reservoirs. Can be tanned to produce a durable material.
item_1152.lead: Fibrous pipe cactus can be found west of the Moon Garou tribe near a grove of yew trees, and can be used to make 3 cactus fibres in a tannery.

item_1153.desc: Woven from fine thread and gold. Used in weapon and armour crafting.
item_1153.lead: Fine cloth is created with a loom, requiring three fine thread. Fine cloth is used primarily for power level 5 armour.

item_1154.desc: Made from spun corpse cotton. Can be used as a bow string and in stitching weapons and gear.
item_1154.lead: Fine thread is a material item created at a spinning wheel. It can be crafted using 4 corpse cotton, creating a single fine thread.

journal.text: Because "corpse thread" is far too sinister a title, this thread is referred to as fine thread. It's stronger, thinner and more malleable than cotton threads. The villagers of Emberwood enjoyed this thread in their clothing, creating garments that would suffer greater strain than their previous gear. Farmers were particularly fond of it

item_1155.desc: Flammable and volatile, handle with care! Used to craft Fire arrows.
item_1155.lead: Fire oil is an item that is unlocked at level 45 Ranged, where players can use fire oil to create fire arrows. Note that adding fire oil to arrows will change the damage property of the arrow from Ranged damage to Fire Magic damage and will apply a 60% burn buildup.

journal.text: Used to craft Fire arrows. Some people just like to watch the world burn… and you can too, with these new handy fire oils! That’s right, just lob one of these beauties at your enemies and watch them ignite. Enjoy their screams as their skin boils away and breathe in the delightful aroma of a fresh barbecue! Fire oil, like snake oil, was once the creation of a travelling merchant to Ashenfall. She had journeyed to Brynmoor alongside some of the Saradominist settlers, and with her she brought pungent unguents, elucidating elixirs, marvellous medicines, and weapons of localised destruction. When her wares summoned the call for refunds, she would dazzle the onlookers with a sudden fiery display and then disappear into the alleyways until she had been forgotten. She would then return in one of a staggering array of disguises, until the tragic day when her wagon hit a pothole during a quick getaway and her many, many, bottles of fire oils decided to sing the song of their people. Fortunately, even though she and everything she owned, tragically found itself reduced to smouldering atoms, her recipe lived on and found more conventional uses.

item_1156.desc: Equippable as ammo when using a magic weapon (provided the required skill perk is unlocked). A symbol of blazing heat, essential for fire-based magic. Runes are retained if you happen to die.
item_1156.lead: Fire runes can be crafted at a rune altar at level 25 Runecrafting or higher, and can deal between 6-10 base damage, along with whatever staves the player equips. Fire runes are used in spells such as Rocksplosion, Superheat, and Fire Spirit.

item_1158.desc: Harvested from flax plants, essential for crafting linen and bowstrings.
item_1158.lead: Flax can be found by harvesting the flax plants in either Bramblemead Valley, Fractured Plains, or Stormtouched Highlands. It can be used on the spinning wheel to create coarse thread. Collecting flax for the first time unlocks the creation of the spinning wheel and fletching bench.

item_1159.desc: Flax seeds. Equip and use them to scatter these into a farming plot and start growing! Best Planted in Brynmoor plots.
item_1159.lead: Flax seeds are a type of Brynmoor seed, used in the Farming skill. Flax seeds can be used to grow flax (Farming) in a farming plot. However, it is best to plant them in an ash farming plot.

journal.text: Now you can plant these pretty blue flowers wherever you like. Bring much needed vibrancy to your drab and dreary little wooden hovel. Or, of course, you could grow them for harvest and turn them into thread, but isn't that a waste when they're so very pretty?

item_1160.desc: Raw sheepskin that can be processed into wool.
item_1160.lead: Fleece is a basic material, gathered from killing rams and sheep.

item_1161.desc: A high-temperature fuel. Needed to smelt more advanced metals.
item_1161.lead: Fuel pellet is a fuel source that can be created at a Blacksmiths Bench. It can be used in a blast furnace as fuel to create higher tiered materials. Players must receive coal in their inventory and build a blast furnace to unlock the fuel pellet. (Be cautious some players reported that the recipe was not available to them.)

journal.text: Flammable objects pressed together into a smaller, even more flammable object. The fuel pellet burns hotter and stronger than basic fuels, making it much more desirable for more complex smithing techniques.

item_1162.desc: An object of garou origin that might hold value with local traders.
item_1162.lead: Garou artifact is an item found in Umbral Sands. It can be sold to the merchants Domri, Beartach and Iasadair for 500 garou chits. Garou artifact can also be used to craft Lunar Robes.

journal.text: Lost remnants of the Old Kingdom, the desert civilisation created by the Moon Garou before it was destroyed by Fuzan. These antiques are pieces of history for the Moon Garou and vendors will be happy to purchase them, for a very fair price.

item_1163.desc: A local currency favoured by garou traders.
item_1163.lead: Garou chit are currency used by the Moon Garou in Umbral Sands.

journal.text: Currency is a relatively new concept for the garou who, through most of their history, relied on a barter system based around hunting. As the Moon Garou settled into less hectic lives, they needed a means of trade that everyone had access to, and so created the chits to do so. These chits are formed from tiny scraps of adamantite, melted down and then stamped with the branding of the tribes. A fun fact about them is that both sides have garou heads on them, one male and one female, so you can flip as many heads in a row as you want.

item_1164.desc: A high quality material sold by local garou merchants.
item_1164.lead: Garou weave can be bought from the merchants Iasadair, Beartach and Domri or found in chests in Umbral Sands and is primarily used for power level 7 armour.

journal.text: Sadly, this is not a new hairstyle unlock, rather it’s a special cloth created by the Moon Garou. They say it’s woven from moon sprite silk, which can only be obtained in the light of a full moon and, even then, only by shamans. The truth is that it’s less complicated than that. It’s crafted by a gaggle of garou grannies, each of them weaving together special fibres that have been passed down their family line for generations. Each bolt of cloth may seem the same, but they are each a unique blending of garou family craftwork.

item_1165.desc: If I told you why this bait works, I'd have to krill you. Infernal Eels look alive! Increases the catch chance of this fish.
item_1165.lead: Giant krill bait is a power level 6 Fishing bait crafted at the crafting table. It increases the chance of catching infernal eels. Players can store the bait in a tackle box, which holds up to 48 baits.

journal.text: The vile ashes imbedded within these strange fishing lures, whisper to the most sinful part of the fish, drawing them to their demise. At least that’s what the Zamorakian mages claimed. In truth, they were simply tastier and more desirable to the fish, who have little concept of morality.

item_1166.desc: A delightful ornament that will really tie your home together.
item_1166.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_1166.lead: A glass decoration is an item that can be crafted using molten glass at the jeweler's bench.

journal.text: Let's take a moment to recognise your glass-blowing skills. ... Congratulations on your craftmanship. You have the puff of an angel.

item_1167.desc: It's transparent that you're going to use this when building.
item_1167.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_1167.lead: Glass panes is created with molten glass at a jeweler's bench, and are used in construction.

item_1168.desc: A glass item made by glassblowing.
item_1168.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_1168.lead: Glass vessels can be created with molten glass at a jeweler's bench, and can be used for various recipes.

item_1169.desc: A precious metal found in the deepest parts of Ghornfell; used for crafting valuable items.
item_1169.lead: A gold bar is a component of making a variety of armour. Gold bars are used for making dragonkin mage and wild archer armour.

item_1170.desc: A thin sheet of brilliant gold, can be used for demonstrating your prowess, potion making or even recycling into gold bars.
item_1170.lead: Gold leaf is a craftable item reward from various Agility courses that allows the player to make potions, golden regional capes, and a gilded version of the gyrhawk amulet. To obtain these, players must either collect them from golden reward packs or recycle gold bars at the jeweler's bench to make sheets of ten per bar.

journal.text: Fashion is often described as circular, turning from modish to outmoded and back again. Or it's portrayed like waves, as fads come and go, never to be seen again. But some fashions are like trees. They've always been there, unmoving, over generations. Gold leaf is one of them. You can definitely over-use it, but when used with care, it's timeless.

item_1171.desc: Mined from gold deposits. It can be smelted at a Furnace.
item_1171.lead: Gold ore is a basic Mining material mined from Gold Ore Nodes, which can be mainly found in the Bloodblight Swamp. It can be smelted at a furnace to make gold bars.

journal.text: Few things have led to quite so much wanton destruction as gold. Wars have been fought over it. Brother has slain brother just for a handful of the glimmering nuggets. Yet, without the trappings of commerce, it is but a metal like any other. Pretty though, good in jewellery.

item_1172.desc: Scraps that can be searched through. All that glitters may not be gold.
item_1172.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_1172.lead: Gold salvage piles are a basic material, nine of them can be smelted in a furnace to create one gold bar.

item_1173.desc: A dense stone used for construction and crafting. Very commonly found underground, in mines and dungeons.
item_1173.lead: Granite is a basic Mining material that can be mined from granite deposits.

journal.text: This stone is stubbornly resistant to magic. Whereas other stones absorb the nascent anima, Granite refuses. It exists on its own terms, not the whims of magic. As such, it is highly prized in construction projects, as it resists most magic and those enchantments that do affect it, last much longer. Legend speaks of a weapon forged from this stone. A great hammer, said to be able to crush almost any armour.

item_1174.lead: Greater kalphite wing is a basic item dropped by kalphite guardians and kalphite queens that can be processed at a grindstone into shimmerscale powder.

item_1175.desc: Obtained from felled Lesser Green Dragons. Can be processed at the Tannery.
item_1175.lead: Green dragon hide is a basic material dropped by green dragons which can be tanned to create green dragonhide leather.

item_1176.desc: Made by tanning Green Dragonhide. A key crafting component for armour.
item_1176.lead: Green dragonhide leather is a Processed material created from tanning green dragon hide.

item_1177.desc: Pulverised stone, used in building, and as an Herblore ingredient.
item_1177.lead: Ground clay is made by using clay on a grindstone. It is used to make lesser Focused Artisan potions.

item_1178.desc: Pulverised stone, used in building and as an ingredient in herblore.
item_1178.lead: Ground granite is created by putting granite in a grindstone. It is used in making attack potions.

item_1179.desc: Ground from gypsum. This reagent seems to reflect light and therefore heat.
item_1179.lead: Ground gypsum is created by putting a gypsum in a grindstone.

item_1180.desc: Fine limestone ground from limestone. With the proper tools, it can be made into glass in the Blast Furnace.
item_1180.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_1180.lead: Ground limestone is a processed material used to make molten glass in a blast furnace.

item_1181.desc: An object of pure, refined obsidian.
item_1181.lead: Ground obsidian is a basic item created by grounding elder curiosities or obsidian device in a grindstone.

journal.text: If obsidian can contain concentrated KotHaar consciousness, then what is ground obsidian? Does each granule contain a single memory? Do these scattered pieces of KotHaar consciousness communicate with each other on some level? Does a bag of ground obsidian contain more information than any library? We have SO many questions.

item_1182.desc: Fine sand ground from sandstone. With the proper tools, it can be made into glass in the Furnace.
item_1182.lead: Ground sandstone is a processed material used to make tier 2 walls for building. In a future update, it will also have a use in making molten glass.

item_1183.desc: Pulverised stone, used in building, and as an Herblore ingredient.
item_1183.lead: Ground stone is created by putting a stone in a grindstone. Ground stone is used in tier 2 constructed items and will be used for herblore in future updates.

item_1184.lead: Ground tea leaves is a basic item processed from dried tea leaves at the grindstone. It is used to make strong tea and strong sweet tea at the cooking range.

journal.text: If the ground tea leaves, where does it go? Congratulations on being midway through the making-tea process. Keep going: we believe in you. Soon, you will have a hot mug of tea in your hands, and nothing - not the ever-approaching prospect of facing Kuldra - will be able to intrude on your peace.

item_1185.desc: A crumbly stone unsuitable for building but, once ground, offers unique properties.
item_1185.lead: Gypsum is a basic Mining material mined from gypsum nodes, found scattered across the Umbral Sands.

item_1186.desc: A marvel of alchemy that, once applied to equipment, adds durability in extreme conditions.
item_1186.lead: Gypsum wax is one of the materials required for making power level 7 armour.

journal.text: A combination of gypsum powder and dihydrogen monoxide, gypsum wax contains the worst of both materials. It's as claggy and hard to remove as gypsum powder, and as deadly as dihydrogen monoxide.

item_1187.desc: Sturdy material for crafting durable armour.
item_1187.lead: Hard leather is thicker and more resilient than normal leather. Players can create hard leather with two pieces of regular leather and one adhesive or four pieces of hard leather scraps in a tannery. Picking up the item grants 20 Artisan XP.

item_1188.desc: Sturdy material for crafting durable armour.
item_1188.lead: Hard leather is thicker and more resilient than normal leather. Players can create hard leather with two pieces of regular leather and one adhesive or four pieces of hard leather scraps in a tannery. Picking up the item grants 20 Artisan XP.

item_1189.desc: Dropped from beasts in Fellhollow. Combined at the Tannery to create hard leather.
item_1189.lead: Hard leather scraps are found by killing Zombie Cow's and are used to create hard leather. Picking up the item grants 20 Artisan XP.

journal.text: Fragments of thick and sturdy hides, these scraps are of little use on their own, but combined they can become a resilient leather with a wide range of uses. The Children of Shadows would scavenge these scraps across Fellhollow, using the pieces to craft profane totems to their sinister god — unaware that he would be offended at such a low-effort offering.

item_1190.desc: A fragrant herb used in restorative potions.
item_1190.lead: Harralander is a herb that is harvested from Harralander plants, found primarily in the Whispering Swamp and can be bought from Domri - The Merchant for 6 garou chits.

item_1191.desc: Harralander seeds. Equip and use them to scatter these into a farming plot and start growing! Best Planted in Brynmoor plots.
item_1191.lead: Harralander seeds are a type of Brynmoor seed, used in the Farming skill.

journal.text: Tired of sinking into swamp-mud in search of these fragrant little herbs? Well now you can grow them yourself. The fragrance of these herbs is even better without the swamp to full it and can be a very pleasant pick-me-up first thing in the day.

item_1192.desc: Found lying around Fellhollow, around long-dead trees. Used in the crafting.
item_1192.lead: When the withering began, it was souls that suffered first, torn away and dragged into the underworld to be consumed by the cursed dragon. Yet, as time drew on, Imaru's hunger did not diminish, only grow, and so the world itself began to suffer.

journal.text: It may be strange that bark could be referred to as hollow. It's generally extracted in strips, or patches, but nothing that could act as a container. Indeed there would need to be an entire tree without a centre to make it hollow, and that's exactly the case here. When the withering began, it was souls that suffered first, torn away and dragged into the underworld to be consumed by the cursed dragon. Yet, as time drew on, Imaru's hunger did not diminish, only grow, and so the world itself began to suffer. Things taste worse in Fellhollow. Dreams are vapid and empty, if you have them at all. A campfire feels colder, even if it warms you just as well as before. Because the substance, the soul of that thing if you will, is being consumed. Hollow bark comes from a tree that has been hollowed out from within. Its insides are less than they should be, weaker and wrong. As awful as this is, it makes the bark develop in odd ways desirable by skilled mages with a poor sense of fashion.

item_1193.desc: Used to craft magical equipment. Postie Pete also has a use for them.
item_1193.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_1193.lead: Infernal fragments is a type of currency used in Evil Emporium to purchase several item recipes, and capes - these can be found in chests within Dowdun Reach, or dropped by certain monsters, such as lesser demons, hellhounds, hellrats, Black Knights, Zamorakian acolytes, Mages of Zamorak and shardbound lesser demons.

item_1194.desc: Named as such due to the infinite number of colours it features. It's quite garish.
item_1194.lead: Infinity cloth is created with a loom and is primarily used for power level 7 armour.

item_1195.desc: Harvested from Thorny Irit Roots, used in potion making at the brewing cauldron.
item_1195.lead: Irits are herbs acquired from destroying thorny irit roots and can be bought from Domri - The Merchant for 18 garou chits.

journal.text: It is unsurprising that irit grows in Fellhollow, considering it has such a close association with the dead. Whereas normal irit grows around graveyards and near the temples of death deities, the irit in Fellhollow grows everywhere. Yet, unlike its leafier version, the irit here is twisted and sharp. It is formed of thorny roots that writhe out of the ground and must be cut down to access the herb beneath. After all, the dead in Fellhollow refuse to stay buried without a fight, why wouldn’t the irit react the same?

item_1196.lead: Irit seeds are a type of Fellhollow seed, used in the Farming skill.

journal.text: Thorny irit is a pain to harvest. You must seek out the spiky roots and battle with them before you can claim the herbs for yourself. With these seeds, you can skip some of that faff and instead grow them wherever you like, the very pinnacle of convenience.

item_1197.desc: A versatile metal used for crafting a wide range of durable items.
item_1197.lead: An iron bar is a component of a variety of armour and weapons.

item_1198.desc: A pair of iron crossbow limbs. Used in crafting an Iron Crossbow.
item_1198.lead: Iron crossbow limbs are used in crafting iron crossbows. They are created at a blacksmith's bench.

journal.text: Following certain incidents with cats and crossbow limbs, a superstition began to build in Bramblemead about the danger of crossbows and felines. It was considered bad luck to house a cat in the same home as a crossbow, with reasoning ranging from the safety of the cat, to the safety of the human population should the cats rise up and develop opposable thumbs. Whilst harmless at first, when the need for crossbows grew due to the conflict with the garou, cats found themselves with fewer and fewer homes willing to house them. Over the years this led to domestic cats being a rare sight in Bramblemead. It also created a deep-seated resentment in the cats, and they plotted their revenge. Most would tell you that cats had nothing to do with the destruction of Bramblemead and the Brynmoor settlements, yet if you ask a cat, they will simply purr with a sinister grin on their face.

item_1199.desc: Mined from iron deposits. It can be smelted in a Furnace.
item_1199.lead: Iron ore is a basic Mining material that can be mined from iron ore nodes, which are mainly found all over the Stormtouched Highlands and Fellhollow. Three ores can be smelted in a furnace into an iron bar, or three can be combined with three coal in a blast furnace to create a steel bar.

journal.text: Iron is sturdy, durable and malleable. Blacksmiths prize it highly as a material for crafting superior arms and armour. It is rumoured that certain fae creatures are repelled by the ore, perhaps due to its rigidity and refusal to change to the whims of magical beings.

item_1200.desc: Scraps that can be searched through. There might be something of value in there.
item_1200.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_1200.lead: Iron salvage piles are a basic material, nine of them can be smelted in a furnace to create one iron bar.

item_1201.desc: A rare gemstone used to craft enchanted jewellery.
item_1201.lead: Jade is a gemstone that can be obtained by mining iron ore nodes. It can be found if the player has unlocked the Gem Prospector perk at level 16 Mining. It can be mined both manually with an appropriate pickaxe and by using the Rocksplosion spell.

journal.text: The greener the Jade's colour, the higher its concentration of iron. It is popular among many cultures for both its beauty and use as a crafting material. In the eastern lands of {{RSL|Wushanko

item_1202.desc: Kalphite bait. Increases the catch chance of fish.
item_1202.lead: Kalphite bait is a power level 7 bait crafted at the crafting table. Players can store the bait in a tackle box, which holds up to 48 baits.

journal.text: A fish can't swallow an entire kalphite. They might want to, as elastic as their mouths are, but a fish cannot cross the line from admiring a kalphite to digesting it. That's where you come in. With a slice here and there, suddenly a fish gets to try am morsel of antennae or mandible. And let me tell you: if the size roles were reversed, the kalphite would be wiped out in a week.

item_1203.desc: A viscous, sticky fluid. Can be processed into a durable adhesive.
item_1203.lead: Kalphite ichor is a basic item obtained from kalphite enemies and kalphite eggs in Umbral Sands. It can be processed into acrid adhesive.

journal.text: What are you doing with that? You're not... hyuk... picking it up, are you? With your bare hands? Put it down! That's... ouurngle... hideous stuff. You can't possibly use it for anything... HHKKKKKnnnggle... practical, can you?

item_1204.desc: A durable kalphite carapace, suitable for crafting.
item_1204.lead: Kalphite shell is a basic item used as a crafting material. It can be processed from kalphite shell fragments with acrid adhesive at the tannery.

journal.text: Ah, very good: you have cottoned onto something that mainland Gielinor has failed to understand. The way to make armour as strong as a kalphite's exoskeleton is not to hammer it into shapes that are suitable for humans. The carapace is too resistant, and you will get an armour that is ill-fitting for the human form. There will be plenty of gaps for someone to slip a Keris into. What you need to do is break the shell into its component fragments. You need to make a kind of kalphite mosaic, then adhere it with something acrid to make it into an armour. That's how you become as hardy as a kalphite.

item_1205.desc: Shattered kalphite chitin. Could be salvaged with the right adhesive.
item_1205.lead: Kalphite shell fragments is a basic item obtained from kalphite enemies in Umbral Sands. It can be processed into kalphite shell at a tannery.

journal.text: You might get some looks, but make sure you pocket the little scraps of kalphite that you find. These little exoskeleton offcuts may not be much on their own, but grab some acrid adhesive and you can glue them together to make kalphite shells. Where you go after that is up to you. We recommend magic carpet battles, tossing shells at each other as you race.

item_1206.lead: Kalphite wing is a basic item dropped by kalphite soldiers that can be processed at a grindstone into shimmerscale powder.

item_1207.desc: A bitter green herb used to make potions.
item_1207.lead: Kwuarm is a herb that must be farmed using kwuarm seeds found in Goblin, Garou, or skeleton packs.

journal.text: This herb has travelled far to deliver its malicious benefits to the people of Ashenfall. Its name, in Dwarvish, means “warm death” since it causes a terrible burning fever if the sap is consumed. When crushed down to release its sap and oils, this herb is a requirement in some of the deadliest and most dangerous poisonous mixtures.

item_1208.desc: Kwuarm Seeds. Equip and use them to scatter these into a farming plot and start growing! Best planted in Ghornfell plots.
item_1208.lead: Kwuarm seeds are a type of Ghornfell seed, used in the Farming skill. Kwuarm seeds can be obtained from a skeleton or garou pack, after discovering ash logs. When planted with the Farming skill, kwuarm seeds will grow into kwuarm.

journal.text: These plants are greedily hoarded by goblins and garou, their poisonous capabilities highly desired by their scouts. With these seeds, you no longer need to slaughter goblins in droves to acquire these herbs, instead you can grow them yourself in your own back yard.

item_1209.desc: Resource needed for teleportation. Runes are retained if you happen to die.
item_1209.lead: Law runes can be crafted at a rune altar at level 50 Runecrafting or higher. Law runes are needed for teleporting with lodestones.

item_1210.desc: A basic crafting material created from animal hide; commonly used for making equipment.
item_1210.lead: Leather is created by putting animal hide or animal hide scraps into the tannery.

item_1211.desc: Can be ground into ground limestone
item_1211.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_1211.lead: Limestone is a basic Mining material mined from limestone rocks, found scattered across the Dowdun Reach region, typically beside bodies of water.

journal.text: Turn your limestone this way and that you might spot a fossil. Lesser blue dragons have been in the region for some time, and there were experiments that led to them. Being experiments, they weren't cognitively blessed, so it's entirely possible that you'll find the talon of a dragon that got trapped in a rockfall. You could also find the odd chicken wing from the Second Age. The Children of Shadows loved a shake and bake.

item_1212.desc: Scraps of lobster meat made into bait to draw in fish. A meal Undead Eels cannot resist. Increases the catch chance of this fish.
item_1212.lead: The lobster bait is a power level 5 Fishing bait crafted at the crafting table. It increases the chance of catching undead eels. Players can store the bait in a tackle box, which holds up to 48 baits.

journal.text: Some fish can only be attracted with a very expensive meal. Kind of like trying to date someone far out of your league. What better way to woo those with more refined palettes than a delicious lobster dinner?

item_1213.desc: Cut from maple trees. Can be crafted into various equipment.
item_1213.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_1213.lead: Maple logs are obtained by chopping down maple trees, with a mithril logging axe or better.

item_1214.desc: Harvested from maple trees. An ingredient that can be cooked on a campfire.
item_1214.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_1214.lead: Maple sap is a Power Level 4 basic material, which means it can be cooked at a campfire or grill into maple syrup starting at Cooking level 41, and not burnt into burnt maple syrup at level 50. It can be gathered from chopped maple trees.

item_1216.desc: Marentill Seeds. Equip and use them to scatter these into a farming plot and start growing! Best Planted in Brynmoor plots.
item_1216.lead: Marentill seeds (also spelled marrentil) are a type of Brynmoor seed, used in the Farming skill.

journal.text: No longer do you need traipse through the swamps in search of these precious little herbs, now you can grow them in your own back garden. When not drowned out by the foul stench of the swamps, these herbs have a pleasant odour to them that can attract invisible squirrels to your garden. Keep your eyes open for them!

item_1217.desc: A bitter tasting herb used in resistance potions.
item_1217.lead: Marrentil (also spelled marrentill in books) is a herb found from harvesting a marrentill plant in the Whispering Swamp and can be bought from Domri - The Merchant for 6 garou chits.

item_1218.desc: A versatile metal used for crafting weapons and armour.
item_1218.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_1218.lead: Mithril bars are a processed material created with three mithril ore (or nine mithril salvage piles) and three coal inside a blast furnace.

journal.text: In the Third Age on Ashenfall, mithril was incredibly desirable. It was only available in small quantities then, as its scarcity - perhaps inevitably - made it the fashion of the time. High-priests would incorporate it into their rosaries. Community leaders would wear it as brooches. It was rare enough that people would comment when they saw it. Ooh, Rosie's doing well for herself. That sort of thing. The idea of a mithril bar would have been mind-boggling to anyone in the Third Age. No matter their alignment, they'd have stabbed you in the belly and run away cackling with it. But here you are with an entire ingot. Take a moment and consider yourself a Third Age king.

item_1219.desc: A pair of mithril crossbow limbs. Essential for crafting mithril crossbow.
item_1219.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_1219.lead: Mithril crossbow limbs are used in crafting mithril crossbows. They are created at a blacksmith's bench.

journal.text: What do you call a crossbow without limbs? A REALLY cross bow. Oh shush, you. That joke plays well at fletching conventions.

item_1220.desc: Mined from Mithril deposits. It can be smelted in a Furnace.
item_1220.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_1220.lead: Mithril ore is a basic Mining material that can be mined from mithril ore nodes, which can be found all over the Dowdun Reach region and its underground areas. Three ores can be smelted along 3 pieces of coal in a blast furnace to produce mithril bars.

journal.text: Mithril Means much to dwarves. It was first discovered by a dwarf called Tolkun in the First Age. and its seams have been uncovered in much of Gielinor. For the way it shines, dwarves call it The Dwarven Welcome". Find the ore while mining and it lights up to greet you with a dwarven welcome. A "Dwarven Welcome" is also what dwarves call a headbutt while wearing a mithril helmet.

item_1221.desc: Scraps of mithril that can be smelted into more useful bars.
item_1221.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_1221.lead: Mithril salvage piles are a basic material that can be combined with three coal in a blast furnace to create one mithril bar.

item_1222.desc: Hot glass ready to be blown into useful objects.
item_1222.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_1222.lead: Molten glass is a processed material. It can be created with three ground sandstone and three ground limestone at a blast furnace. This is used at a jeweler's bench to craft glass vessel, glass decoration & glass pane.

journal.text: Beautiful, yet hard to handle, the creation of molten glass was a turning point for Gielinorian civilization. It allowed the creation of vials, windows, and those pretty little animals that grandmothers love to collect and put on shelves.

item_1223.desc: Bait made from monkfish tail. Increases the catch chance of Desert Sole.
item_1223.lead: Monkfish bait is a power level 7 Fishing bait crafted at the crafting table. It increases the chance of catching desert soles. Players can store the bait in a tackle box, which holds up to 48 baits.

journal.text: You may be aware that, in some languages, fish is known as 'poisson'. Notice how 'poisson' is one letter shy of 'poison'? There's a reason for that: all fish carry varying amounts of poison in their bodies. Cooking can help to remove some of that poison, but certain varieties of raw fish are extremely dangerous to eat. A chunk of raw monkfish is not only delicious to other fish, but extremely poisonous. It makes it an angler's dream: a little glob of angry meat that can attract and then kill some of the most desirable fish.

item_1224.desc: Large fangs used in creating deadly weaponry.
item_1224.lead: Monstrous fangs are obtained by defeating an abyssal demon. There is currently no use for monstrous fangs.

item_1225.desc: Spun from mystic fibre. Magic courses through every thread.
item_1225.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_1225.lead: Mystic cloth is a item used for armours. It is crafted at the loom using three mystic thread.

item_1226.desc: Dropped by Zamorak magi. Can be spun into thread at a spinning wheel.
item_1226.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_1226.lead: Mystic fibres are found by opening Zamorakian mage pack and are used to create mystic thread.

item_1227.desc: Spun from mystic fibre. Magic courses through every thread.
item_1227.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_1227.lead: Mystic thread is a basic item created at a spinning wheel using four mystic fibres.

item_1228.lead: Naptha is an item that is unlocked at level 45 Ranged, where players can use naptha to create fire oil. It is also dropped by dragon wolves.

journal.text: Distilled from swamp tar and charcoal. Once known as “thick water”, naptha is liquid fire in waiting. It takes little to bring this substance to ignition, even too bright a sunny day can bring the raging flame from within. As such, this material is widely sought by anyone with a strong desire to set things aflame. Pyromaniacs, alchemists and dragon cultists alike yearn for this liquid.

item_1229.desc: Nature runes are used for casting transumation spells. Runes are retained if you happen to die.
item_1229.lead: Nature runes can be crafted at a rune altar at level 38 Runecrafting or higher.

item_1230.desc: Made from ground up undead bone. A useful crafting ingredient.
item_1230.lead: Necrotic bonemeal is one of the materials required for making sacred oil and demonic oil.

journal.text: The walking dead are strange things, animated by hunger, need, rage and a touch of magic. In Ashenfall it is the hunger of Imaru that drives them, as her great maw draws in the souls of both the living and the dead, the afflicted try to cling to life with everything that they have. They fail, but the drive remains. Fear, desperation, and simple need keeps the body moving, if not alive. This changes the body, that hunger and rot seeping into the very bones and changing them to be something other than they were. When ground down, these bones become a powder containing hints of that animating magic. A necromantic resonance with a wide range of uses.

item_1231.desc: Sturdy oak logs used for crafting equipment and furniture.
item_1231.lead: Oak logs are obtained by chopping down oak trees, with a bronze axe or better.

item_1232.lead: Oak planks can be created by using oak logs on a sawmill. Currently, they have no uses in construction.

item_1234.desc: An obsidian object, useful as little more than a paperweight. Can be ground and then smelted into pure obsidian.
item_1234.lead: Obsidian device is a basic item obtained from kot packs dropped by KotHaar sentinels or from chests found in Umbral Sands. It can be processed into ground obsidian at a grindstone.

journal.text: After being beaten to a pulp by a KotHaar, you might find it difficult to believe that they are a cultured race. Or, more specifically, they WERE a cultured race, and that culture has eroded away to almost nothing over the centuries. There are records of KotHaar libraries, with books written on stone. It is hard to believe, but at least one play has been performed by the KotHaar, although no KotHaar can remember to what it pertained. While the life of the modern KotHaar doesn't leave room for culture and entertainment, it is common to find them fiddling with the remnants of it. They fidget with old stone pamphlets, fragments of toys, and materials that were used in KotHaar sports. These obsidian devices mean little to the KotHaar, but they get a semblance of reassurance from tinkering with them.

item_1235.desc: A vegetable that often brings a tear to the eye.
item_1235.lead: Onions are a Power Level 3 raw ingredient, which means they can be cooked at a campfire or grill into fried onions starting at Cooking level 27, and not burnt into burnt onion at level 41. They can also be used to make lesser Focused Cooking potion, bowl of onions, and potted onion. They can be collected from onion (plant) in Fractured Plains, and Farmed from onion (Farming) grown from onion seeds. Onions can be used to make compost.

item_1236.desc: Onion Seeds. Equip and use them to scatter these into a farming plot and start growing! Best planted in Ghornfell plots.
item_1236.lead: Onion seeds are a type of Ghornfell seed, used in the Farming skill. Onion seeds can be obtained from harvesting wild onion (plant).

journal.text: Sometimes you just want a way to make everyone around you cry. Onions have always served this purpose, and I often bring one with me to slice into at social gatherings when I feel everyone is being just a little too happy. With these seeds, you can avoid scavenging for onions across the dangerous plains and instead a produce a steady supply with which to torment your friends and family. Or you could eat them, I guess, if you're weird.

item_1237.desc: A rare gemstone used to craft enchanted jewellery.
item_1237.lead: Opal is a gemstone that can be obtained by mining tin ore nodes, copper ore nodes, and stone boulders. It can be found if the player has unlocked the Gem Prospector perk at level 16 Mining. It can be mined both manually with an appropriate pickaxe and by using the Rocksplosion spell.

item_1238.desc: A strong and lightweight crafting material.
item_1238.lead: Padded cloth is both a decorative item used in building as well as a material for other items, such as armours and tools.

journal.text: A bolt of cloth that has been reinforced. Makes for sturdier armour than normal cloth.

item_1239.desc: A Pipe Cactus seed. Pop it into a farming plot and start growing! Best planted in Umbral Sand plots.
item_1239.lead: Pipe cactus seeds are a type of Umbral Sands seed, used in the Farming skill. Pipe cactus seeds can be used to grow Pipe Cactus (Farming) in a farming plot. However, it is best to plant them in a yew farming plot.

journal.text: The pipe cactus is like an iceberg, if you replace the ice with cactus and the sea with sand. A pipe cactus runs deep, deep into the sands, its roots grasping for any moisture it can find. That moisture often can be found at the bottom of quicksand, or on the bedrock, many metres below the surface. A pipe cactus is one of the few that can 'pipe' that moisture up. Many a moon garou has tried to suck that moisture up through the 'pipe' of the cactus, like a natural well. The pipe cactus has evolved counter-measures to that particular ploy, including valve-like structures up its stem, and, you know, spikes.

item_1240.lead: Poison ichor is a basic item that comes from killing wild jade vines and putrid rats.

journal.text: Dropped by poisonous enemies. Nature is full of malicious little critters who carry toxins. Snakes, spiders, politicians, each of them has ways to make other creatures suffer. This ichor is prized by poisoners and alchemists, as it can be used to create deadly concoctions that will give someone, or something, a really bad day.

item_1241.lead: Potatoes are a Power Level 2 raw ingredient, which means they can be cooked at a campfire or grill into baked potato starting at Cooking level 12, and not burnt into burnt potato at level 27. They can be gathered from potato (plant)s in Bramblemead Valley and potato (Farming) from potato seeds. Potatoes can be used to make compost.

item_1242.desc: A Potato Seed. Equip and use them to scatter these into a farming plot and start growing! Best Planted in Brynmoor plots.
item_1242.lead: Potato seeds are a type of Brynmoor seed, used in the Farming skill. Potato seeds can be used to grow potatoes in a farming plot. However, it is best to plant them in ash farming plot.

journal.text: Know this secret, child, the potato is a source of foods both delicious and dangerous. They can be baked, roasted over a fire to create a delectable fluffy centre encased within a crisp and tasty core. Or they can be combined with butter and milk to craft a small mountain of creamy extravagance that can serve both as meal and sculpture material. These seeds, small and unremarkable, can be transformed into meals of such exquisite flavour that they can end wars. Or, as was the case of the feud between the Sherrydoe and Nab families, start one - that ended up in a house burning to the ground, three failed marriages and a cow being briefly elected mayor. It's best not to ask.

item_1244.desc: An unusually large Armoured Catfish, worthy of putting it on the wall as trophy or cook it to gain more food.
item_1244.lead: Pristine armoured catfish is a Power Level 4 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire, grill, or with Infernal Rod into 3 braised catfish starting at Cooking level 41, and not burnt into 3 burnt catfish at level 50. It can also be used to make Pristine Armoured Catfish Trophy. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally a maple rod in Dowdun Reach at level 3 Fishing. Using animated feather increases the chance of catching one. It is the pristine variant of a Raw Armoured Catfish.

journal.text: Sometimes evolution gets inspired by the wrong things. The catfish of Ashenfall have long been the victim of any creature that chooses to make them lunch. They are caught, cooked and consumed more often than is reasonable, and their suffering seemed too great as a result. So it was that a god took pity on them and gave them a defence. It is uncertain which god, for none have claimed responsibility, but the divine whimsy could be the result of any of them. All we know is that the fish now have a chance against their assailants, an armoured hide to ward off some of the worst of their misery. Sadly, they are no match for you.

item_1245.lead: Pristine beltfish is a Power Level 4 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire, grill, or with Infernal Rod into 3 steamed beltfish. It can also be used to make Pristine Beltfish Trophy. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally a yew rod in Umbral Sands at level 3 Fishing. Using kalphite bait increases the chance of catching one. It is the pristine variant of a raw beltfish.

journal.text: If there were a Fishing Contest quest in Ashenfall, you can be sure that this little belter (ha!) would win outright. The lean, whiplike grace; the elegant lines of its form; the shimmer on its scales. We don't want to go overboard, but this fish you have caught is quite the looker.

item_1246.lead: Pristine desert sole is a Power Level 4 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire, grill, or with Infernal Rod into 3 sun baked sole. It can also be used to make Pristine Desert Sole Trophy. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally a yew rod in Umbral Sands at level 3 Fishing. Using monkfish bait increases the chance of catching one. It is the pristine variant of a raw desert sole.

journal.text: Some fish were born to be hung on a plaque within somebody's house. The desert sole, flat as the wood that you're going to nail it onto, is one of those fish. Its eyes even follow you as you move around the house, like those paintings you hear about in haunted houses. As a note, the attractive form of the pristine desert sole, and its flatness of course, means that it could have other uses. It makes for a fine doily, for example. You're free to use it as you please.

item_1248.desc: An unusually large Herring, worthy of putting it on the wall as trophy or cook it to gain more food.
item_1248.lead: Raw herring is a Power Level 3 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire, grill, or with Infernal Rod into 3 smoked herring starting at Cooking level 27, and not burnt into 3 burnt herring at level 41. It can also be used to make Pristine Herring Trophy. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally an oak rod in Fractured Plains at level 3 Fishing. Using anchovy bait increases the chance of catching one. It is the pristine variant of a raw herring.

journal.text: It is said that if you can cut down the tallest tree in the forest, with one of these, then you can gain power and riches beyond your wildest imagination. Still, others claim that only scarlet versions of this fish can cause such a feat, and so the debate has raged for centuries. Truth be told, these fish are not particularly prized by lumberjacks anywhere.

item_1249.desc: An unusually large Infernal Eel, worthy of putting it on the wall as trophy or cook it to gain more food.
item_1249.lead: Pristine infernal eel is a Power Level 4 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire, grill, or with Infernal Rod into 3 Smoked Infernal Eel starting at Cooking level 41, and not burnt into 3 Burnt Infernal Eel at level 50. It can also be used to make Pristine Infernal Eel Trophy. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally a maple rod in Dowdun Reach at level 3 Fishing. Using giant krill bait increases the chance of catching one. It is the pristine variant of a raw infernal eel.

journal.text: In truth this is not a demonic fish, but rather the result of strange magic and infernal energies. The eel is naturally a magically attuned fish, some generate small thunderstorms within their flesh, others blend with shadows becoming almost entirely invisible. These eels, infused as they were with the abundant anima of Ashenfall, became changed by the energies of Downdun Reach’s demonic rites. Fortunately, the transformation, while a little disconcerting, only really serves to give them a slightly spicy aftertaste.

item_1250.desc: An unusually large Lobster, worthy of putting it on the wall as trophy or cook it to gain more food.
item_1250.lead: Pristine lobster is a Power Level 4 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire or grill into 3 roasted lobster starting at Cooking level 41, and not burnt into 3 burnt lobster at level 50. It can also be used to make a Pristine Lobster Trophy. It can be gathered from net fishing spots with at least a fine net in Fellhollow. It is the pristine variant of a raw lobster.

journal.text: Do not be fooled by the traders on the street who preach of rare black lobsters worth unparalleled wealth. These are lies. For the rare black lobster is, in truth, a source of great darkness and evil. Forged from black stone found beneath the waters of the Cursed Archipelago, the rare black lobster whispers terrible, terrible secrets to its bearer. It urges them towards darker and darker acts, until nothing of the host is left except an overwhelming urge toward evil. Seek thee not the rare black lobster, for it will bring nought but despair!

item_1251.lead: Pristine monkfish is a Power Level 4 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire or grill into 3 monkfish fillets. It can also be used to make Pristine Monkfish Trophy. It can be gathered from net fishing spots with ideally a desert net in Umbral Sands. It is the pristine variant of a raw monkfish.

journal.text: Congratulations! Of all the monkfish in the world, you have come across possibly the most dapper. You may wish to spend some time forging a monocle, to really tie the look together. That is, of course, one of those things that is funny to write in a journal like this, but will lead to disappointment and frustration if you actually try it in game.

item_1252.desc: An unusually large Salmon, worthy of putting it on the wall as trophy or cook it to gain more food.
item_1252.lead: Pristine salmon is a Power Level 3 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire, grill, or with Infernal Rod into 3 fried salmon starting at Cooking level 27, and not burnt into 3 burnt salmon at level 41. It can also be used to make Pristine Salmon Trophy. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally an oak rod in Fractured Plains at level 3 Fishing. Using feathered lure increases the chance of catching one. It is the pristine variant of a raw salmon.

journal.text: The life of a salmon is one of great journey and strife. They swim back over great distances, leaping upstream in search of a cementing their legacy. It is tragic then, perhaps, that such journeys become the happy lunchtimes of bears and other animals.

item_1253.desc: An unusually large Sardine, worthy of putting it on the wall as trophy or cook it to gain more food.
item_1253.lead: Pristine sardine is a Power Level 2 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire, grill, or with Infernal Rod into 3 fried sardines starting at Cooking level 12, and not burnt into 3 burnt sardines at level 27. It can also be used to make Pristine Sardine Trophy. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally an ash rod in Temple Woods and Bramblemead Valley at level 3 Fishing. Using shrimp bait increases the chance of catching one. It is the pristine variant of a raw sardine.

journal.text: There is a popular game among children, where they hide themselves around the house and then other children join them once their hiding place has been discovered. It was a game clearly invented by very tired parents, who wanted to make sure their kids were well behaved and contained in a well-known location. After all, where else can you fit seventeen children if not for the wardrobe? Sadly for Gielinor's fisherfolk, the creature with the namesake of said children's game, do not possess the same desire to make their captors life easier. Fortunately, however, they are numerous enough that one need not worry themselves too much about the difficulty of catching them.

item_1255.desc: An unusually large Trout, worthy of putting it on the wall as trophy or cook it to gain more food.
item_1255.lead: Pristine trout is a Power Level 2 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire, grill, or with Infernal Rod into 3 grilled trout starting at Cooking level 12, and not burnt into 3 grilled trout at level 27. It can also be used to make Pristine Trout Trophy. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally an ash rod in Temple Woods and Bramblemead Valley at level 3 Fishing. Using feather bait increases the chance of catching one. It is the pristine variant of a raw trout.

journal.text: There is little exciting one can say about trout, they have few advocates and fewer fans. Yet, they do taste delicious with a little lemon and a few herbs, so perhaps we should thank them for not being awful. One trout was awful. A villain. A monster who rose from the depths to bring terror to us all. Nah, just kidding - they're trout... I got nothing.

item_1256.desc: An unusually large Undead Bass, worthy of putting it on the wall as trophy or cook it to gain more food.
item_1256.lead: Pristine undead bass is a Power Level 4 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire, grill, or with Infernal Rod into 3 Grilled Undead Bass starting at Cooking level 41, and not burnt into 3 burnt undead bass at level 50. It can also be used to make Pristine Undead Bass Trophy. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally a willow rod in Fellhollow at level 3 Fishing. Using spooky bait increases the chance of catching one. It is the pristine variant of a raw undead bass.

journal.text: Even in death there are some fisherfolk who spend their quiet moments hooking these creatures. They wait, rictus still, in patience and draw these wretched things from beneath the waves only to find their prey as dead and decayed as they are, and cast them back into the waters.

item_1257.desc: An unusually large Undead Eel, worthy of putting it on the wall as trophy or cook it to gain more food.
item_1257.lead: Pristine undead eel is a Power Level 4 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire, grill, or with Infernal Rod into 3 Braised Undead Eel starting at Cooking level 41, and not burnt into 3 burnt undead eel at level 50. It can also be used to make Pristine Undead Eel Trophy. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally a willow rod in Fellhollow at level 3 Fishing. Using lobster bait increases the chance of catching one. It is the pristine variant of a raw undead eel.

journal.text: There is something deeply disturbing about a fish that remains to die. More disturbing still are the eels that slither and writhe and wriggle beneath the waters, their hearts no longer beating and their eyes filled with the milky-white film of rot and decay.

item_1258.desc: More treat than trick. Can be cooked by itself or used as an ingredient in cooking meals.
item_1258.lead: Pumpkins are a Power Level 4 raw ingredient, which means they can be cooked at a campfire or grill into roast pumpkin starting at Cooking level 41, and not burnt into burnt pumpkin at level 50. They can be gathered from pumpkin (plant)s in Fellhollow and Dowdun Reach and Farmed from Pumpkin (Farming) grown from pumpkin seeds. Pumpkins can not be used as an item in a compost bin, however can be used in a super compost bin.

item_1259.desc: Pumpkin Seeds. Equip and use them to scatter these into a farming plot and start growing! Best Planted in Fellhollow plots.
item_1259.lead: Pumpkin seeds are a type of Fellhollow seed, used in the Farming skill. Pumpkin seeds can be used to grow Pumpkin (farming) in a farming plot. However, it is best to plant them in Willow Farming Plot.

journal.text: These gourds are most popular around autumn, when they are hollowed out by local children and used to ward away spirits - poorly, as it seems they attract more than they repel. Indeed one strange fellow found himself so delighted by the odd gourds that he took an aspect of them into himself, feeling that they best embodied his favourite time of the year. So the strange individual known as "Pumpkin Pete", part of the Pete family, came to be.

item_1260.desc: A large horn belonging to an animal. Used in crafting.
item_1260.lead: Ram horns are dropped by rams, which are found in the Stormtouched Highlands. Two ram horns are required in the quest Dog Days.

item_1261.desc: Doesn't look like much now, but sear it on a bonfire and receive a delicious treat.
item_1261.lead: Raw anchovies are a Power Level 3 raw ingredient, which means they can be cooked at a campfire or grill into seared anchovies starting at Cooking level 27, and not burnt into burnt anchovies at level 41. They can also be used to make anchovy bait. They can be gathered from net fishing spots with at least a wool net in Fractured Plains and Stormtouched Highlands.

journal.title: Fish
journal.text: Surprisingly good on pizza, these salty little fishes are a popular delicacy across Gielinor.

journal.title: Raw
journal.text: You could eat these by the handful if you didn’t mind the crunch. Traditionally cured in brine and turned into a deliciously salty snack. Goes very well on pizzas.

item_1262.desc: Should be shelled before being braised.
item_1262.lead: Raw armoured catfish is a Power Level 4 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire, grill, or with Infernal Rod into braised catfish starting at Cooking level 41, and not burnt into burnt catfish at level 50. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally a maple rod in Dowdun Reach at level 3 Fishing. Using animated feather increases the chance of catching one. It is the normal variant of a pristine armoured catfish.

journal.title: Fish
journal.text: Sometimes evolution gets inspired by the wrong things. The catfish of Ashenfall have long been the victim of any creature that chooses to make them lunch. They are caught, cooked and consumed more often than is reasonable, and their suffering seemed too great as a result. So it was that a god took pity on them and gave them a defence. It is uncertain which god, for none have claimed responsibility, but the divine whimsy could be the result of any of them. All we know is that the fish now have a chance against their assailants, an armoured hide to ward off some of the worst of their misery. Sadly, they are no match for you.

journal.title: Raw
journal.text: Looking at this, you're going to struggle to prepare it properly. Make sure you have a very, very sharp knife.

item_1263.desc: You half expect it to start wriggling again.
item_1263.lead: Raw beltfish is a Power Level 7 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire, grill, or with Infernal Rod into steamed beltfish. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with a yew rod in Umbral Sands at level 3 Fishing. Using kalphite bait increases the chance of catching one. It is the normal variant of a pristine beltfish.

journal.title: Fish
journal.text: The beltfish, or 'largehead hairtail' if you want to get fancy, is no replacement for a real belt. Anglers have been known to break their belts mid-fishing session and will look into their buckets, wondering if the beltfish 'might do'. Yes, I know - there's no helping some people. But if you are tempted, here are the reasons why a beltfish is a sub-par belt. 1. The beltfish is actually a bit of a chonker. It doesn't fit through the loops in your trousers. 2. The smell of a beltfish is riper than your average fish. That ripeness only escalates as the hours go on. 3. Nobody is going to be impressed with your fish-eye belt buckle. 4. An eel is actually a more functional belt.

journal.title: Raw
journal.text: Raw beltfish is a tricky customer. It's a tough, almost sinewy meat, more like a whip than a food product. If you're a chef and want to torment your sous-chef, then crack a beltfish and watch them pay attention. Equally, if you're a sous-chef and your chef is constantly whipping you with beltfish, then a beltfish makes for a handy garotte.

item_1264.lead: Raw bestial meat is a Power Level 3 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire or grill into flank steak starting at Cooking level 27, and not burnt into burnt flank at level 41. It is dropped by wolves and dire wolves in Fractured Plains and Stormtouched Highlands.

item_1265.desc: Freshly harvested from avian creatures. A staple for cooking.
item_1265.lead: Raw bird meat is a Power Level 1 raw ingredient, which means they can be cooked at a campfire or grill into fillet starting at Cooking level 1, and not burnt into burnt fillet at level 12. It is dropped by chickens in Bramblemead Valley and Dowdun Reach, and terrorbirds in the Fractured Plains.

item_1266.desc: You half expect it to start wriggling again.
item_1266.lead: Raw desert sole is a Power Level 7 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire, grill, or with Infernal Rod into sun baked sole. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with a yew rod in Umbral Sands at level 3 Fishing. Using monkfish bait increases the chance of catching one. It is the normal variant of a pristine desert sole.

journal.title: Fish
journal.text: Desert sole is not the music genre of choice for Moon Garou. Instead, the desert sole is a rather flat fish that likes to nestle at the bottom of sandy pools. Being sandy-coloured themselves, it makes for a rather difficult fish to spot, let alone catch. The flatness of a desert sole once drew the attention of the dragonkin, Lacrussa. She noted the evolutionary benefit of being paper-thin, camouflaged and having organs spread out across the body. So she dabbled with the idea for dragons. Needless to say, her 'flat-dragon' years were some of her least productive.

journal.title: Raw
journal.text: For a flatfish without much weight to it, the desert sole really cranks out aromas. It's especially pungent, as if it is using its full surface area to emanate. Your best bet is to cook it quick-smart. You don't want to be that guy who goes to a gathering and opens a lunch bag with some raw desert sole.

item_1267.desc: Raw meat from farm animals. It can be cooked on a campfire.
item_1267.lead: Raw farm meat is a Power Level 2 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire or grill into steak starting at Cooking level 12, and not burnt into burnt steak at level 27. It is dropped by cows in Temple Woods, Bramblemead Valley, and Dowdun Reach, sheep in Fractured Plains, Stormtouched Highlands, and Dowdun Reach, and rams in Stormtouched Highlands and Dowdun Reach.

item_1268.desc: Raw meat from wild animals. It can be cooked on a campfire.
item_1268.lead: Raw game meat is a Power Level 2 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire or grill into haunch starting at Cooking level 12, and not burnt into burnt haunch at level 27. It is dropped by deer in Temple Woods, Bramblemead Valley, Fractured Plains, Stormtouched Highlands, and Dowdun Reach.

item_1269.desc: A colossal crustacean. A little soggy now, so best dry it.
item_1269.lead: Raw giant krill is a Power Level 4 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire or grill into dried giant krill starting at Cooking level 41, and not burnt into burnt giant krill at level 50. It can also be used to make giant krill bait. It can be gathered from net fishing spots with at least a mystic net in Dowdun Reach.

journal.title: Fish
journal.text: Krill are tiny, harmless, little crustaceans, whose lives amount to little more than mass consumption by larger beasts. Yet, here on Ashenfall, the krill refuse to be the victim. Consuming anima they grow to unreasonable size, hoping to fight off any wood-be predators. They are rarely successful.

journal.title: Raw
journal.text: To its krill kin, this creature is a beast of epic proportions. The sort of monster of legend that would tower over mountains and shatter towers with a single swipe of its enormous claws. Here, though, it’s a bit like a big shrimp. Much less intimidating.

item_1270.desc: Cooked on an anvil, which may or may not be a red herring.
item_1270.lead: Raw herring is a Power Level 3 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire, grill, or with Infernal Rod into smoked herring starting at Cooking level 27, and not burnt into burnt herring at level 41. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally an oak rod in Fractured Plains at level 3 Fishing. Using anchovy bait increases the chance of catching one. It is the normal variant of a pristine herring.

journal.title: Fish
journal.text: It is said that if you can cut down the tallest tree in the forest, with one of these, then you can gain power and riches beyond your wildest imagination. Still, others claim that only scarlet versions of this fish can cause such a feat, and so the debate has raged for centuries. Truth be told, these fish are not particularly prized by lumberjacks anywhere.

journal.title: Raw
journal.text: A bit too floppy to be useful for lumberjacks.

item_1271.desc: Wriggly no more. Will need to be smoked before it goes near your palate.
item_1271.lead: Raw infernal eel is a Power Level 4 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire, grill, or with Infernal Rod into smoked infernal eel starting at Cooking level 41, and not burnt into burnt infernal eel at level 50.
