It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally a maple rod in Dowdun Reach at level 3 Fishing. Using giant krill bait increases the chance of catching one. It is the normal variant of a pristine infernal eel.

journal.title: Fish
journal.text: In truth, this is not a demonic fish, but rather the result of a strange magical and infernal energies. The eel is naturally a magically attuned fish, some generate small thunderstorms within their flesh, others blend with shadows to become almost entirely invisible. These eels, infused as they were with the abundant anima of Ashenfall, became changed by the energies of Dowdun Reach's demonic rites. Fortunately, the transformation, while a little disconcerting, only really serves to give the ma slightly spicy aftertaste.

journal.title: Raw
journal.text: Possessed of a strangely smoky flavour, with a surprisingly spicy kick. Best cooked very carefully, preferably in the presence of a priest.

item_1272.desc: Don't worry, it's not alive anymore. Roast for best results.
item_1272.lead: Raw lobster is a Power Level 4 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire or grill into roasted lobster starting at Cooking level 41, and not burnt into burnt lobster at level 50. It can also be used to make lobster bait. It can be gathered from net fishing spots with at least a fine net in Fellhollow. It is the normal variant of a pristine lobster.

journal.title: Fish
journal.text: Do not be fooled by the traders on the street who preach of rare black lobsters worth unparalleled wealth. These are lies. For the rare black lobster is, in truth, a source of great darkness and evil. Forged from {{RSL|Black stone (material)|black stone

journal.title: Raw
journal.text: Although some people insits that a lobster must be boiled alive to get the best flavour, you have already put it out of its misery - fortunately for the lobster. Now you can look forward to boiling it guilt-free for a much gentler flavour.

item_1273.desc: Your mouth waters just looking at it.
item_1273.lead: Raw monkfish is a power level 7 food that can be captured at net fishing spots in the Umbral Sands region. Monkfish are so-called on Ashenfall due to the goddess Elidinis. The Moon Garou, having never seen a monk, adopted the name after the goddess herself named them.

journal.title: Fish
journal.text: There are, in fact, two variants of the monkfish. One is the Piscatoris monkfish, known for its gamey taste and slightly depressed countenance. The other is the Ashenfall monkfish, which has a more trout-like flavour and a happier, almost smirking countenance. Anglers, who like to simplify things, distinguish them by calling them 'sad boy' and 'happy boy'. Both monkfish are 'sad boys' when they're caught, of course.

journal.title: Raw
journal.text: It may be called the 'Ashenfall' monkfish, but you'd be hard-pressed to find it anywhere other than in Umbral Sands. That's mostly down to a lack of trade. The Moon Garou are an isolationist sort, preferring to keep their trading partners to other Moon Garou. Their closest non-garou partners would be the Black Knights but they, too, like to keep to themselves, and would prefer to deal with other humans over the garou. Which is a shame, really, as monkfish deserves to go continental. Ashenfall monkfish is like trout, but with a slight fizzing sensation, similar to popping candy. If you've got a child or garou cub who won't eat their fish, then try them on Ashenfall monkfish. In our house, it's a gateway fish, leading onto other, less gimmicky fish.

item_1274.desc: Tough, gamey meat that can be cooked and eaten.
item_1274.lead: Raw rat meat is a Power Level 1 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire or grill into rat roast starting at Cooking level 1, and not burnt into burnt rat roast at level 12. It is dropped by giant rats in Temple Woods and Bramblemead Valley and vaults, rat kings in vaults, putrid rats and plague kings in the Whispering Swamp and the Bloodblight Swamp, and chinchompas in the Fractured Plains.

item_1275.desc: While it might be edible now, you'll need to fry it in this game.
item_1275.lead: Raw salmon is a Power Level 3 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire, grill, or with Infernal Rod into fried salmon starting at Cooking level 27, and not burnt into burnt salmon at level 41. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally an oak rod in Fractured Plains at level 3 Fishing. Using feathered lure increases the chance of catching one. It is the normal variant of a pristine salmon.

journal.title: Fish
journal.text: The life of a salmon is one of great journey and strife. They swim back over great distances, leaping upstream in search of a cementing their legacy. It is tragic then, perhaps, that such journeys become the happy lunchtimes of bears and other animals.

journal.title: Raw
journal.text: The Wushanko islands are masters of turning this into a delicious and satisfying meal. Alas, you never did take the time to study their culinary ways and must apply heat to this meal, lest your eject your internalised failures upon Ashenfall’s soil.

item_1276.desc: A small fish that was brought into this world to be fried and eaten.
item_1276.lead: Raw sardine is a Power Level 2 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire, grill, or with Infernal Rod into fried sardine starting at Cooking level 12, and not burnt into burnt sardine at level 27. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally an ash rod in Temple Woods and Bramblemead Valley at level 3 Fishing. Using shrimp bait increases the chance of catching one. It is the normal variant of a pristine sardine.

journal.text: Sardines travel in large shoals; their lives spend as part of a grand community. There’s something a little tragic seeing one here on its own. Still, with a little heat, perhaps a sprinkle of salt and other seasonings, and you’ve got yourself a nice snack.

item_1277.desc: Schrodinger's shrimp: could end up burnt or fried.
item_1277.lead: Raw shrimp is a Power Level 2 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire or grill into sauteed shrimp starting at Cooking level 12, and not burnt into burnt shrimp at level 27. They can also be used to make shrimp bait. They can be gathered from net fishing spots with at least a coarse net in Temple Woods and Bramblemead Valley.

journal.title: Fish
journal.text: Almost all fishing careers begin with these little critters. Their number is practically infinite, so the universe responds by gifting them the survival instinct of an inebriated moth approaching the most magnificent flame. Many a new fishermen has found their diet consisting almost exclusively of these crunchy little things.

journal.title: Raw
journal.text: There are many ways to cook shrimp. Countless recipes that promise wonderful taste sensations. Right now, though, I would suggest you don’t really want to eat them. They’re all wriggly.

item_1278.desc: Grill this trout on a fire. You will thank us later.
item_1278.lead: Raw trout is a Power Level 2 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire, grill, or with Infernal Rod into grilled trout starting at Cooking level 12, and not burnt into burnt trout at level 27. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally an ash rod in Temple Woods and Bramblemead Valley at level 3 Fishing. Using feather bait increases the chance of catching one. It is the normal variant of a pristine trout.

journal.title: Fish
journal.text: There is little exciting one can say about trout, they have few advocates and fewer fans. Yet, they do taste delicious with a little lemon and a few herbs, so perhaps we should thank them for not being awful. One trout was awful. A villain. A monster who rose from the depths to bring terror to us all. Nah, just kidding – they’re trout… I got nothing.

journal.title: Raw
journal.text: Bonier than some of the other popular fishes, the trout is nevertheless one of the most regularly consumed freshwater fishes. Its flavour is heavily modified by its diet…which, on Ashenfall, is more than a little worrying if I’m honest.

item_1279.desc: It may not look edible, but trust us: grill it and you're in for a treat.
item_1279.lead: Raw undead bass is a Power Level 4 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire, grill, or with Infernal Rod into grilled undead bass starting at Cooking level 41, and not burnt into burnt undead bass at level 50. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally a willow rod in Fellhollow at level 3 Fishing. Using spooky bait increases the chance of catching one. It is the normal variant of a pristine undead bass.

journal.title: Fish
journal.text: Even in death there are some fisherfolk who spend their quiet moments hooking these creatures. They wait, rictus still, in patience and draw these wretched things from beneath the waves only to find their prey as dead and decayed as they are, and cast them back into the waters.

journal.title: Raw
journal.text: In life, these are gamy fish, sleek of form and delicious with a bit of lemon. In unlife... well... they're a little less appetising, and lemons are surprisingly sparse on Ashenfall. Still, needs must.

item_1280.desc: A dead undead eel. We suggest you braise it.
item_1280.lead: Raw undead eel is a Power Level 4 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire, grill, or with Infernal Rod into braised undead eel starting at Cooking level 41, and not burnt into burnt undead eel at level 50. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally a willow rod in Fellhollow at level 3 Fishing. Using lobster bait increases the chance of catching one. It is the normal variant of a pristine undead eel.

journal.title: Fish
journal.text: There is something deeply disturbing about a fish that remains to die. More disturbing still are the eels that slither and writhe and wriggle beneath the waters, their hearts no longer beating and their eyes filled with the milky-white film of rot and decay.

journal.title: Raw
journal.text: Sometimes, you have to ask yourself why you cook everything you find. Is this really going to make a succulent meal? Even dead it twitches occasionally, animated by some remnant of necromantic energy. Its flesh is partially decayed and the smell... oh the smell... I recommend cooking it very, very thoroughly.

item_1281.desc: A redberry seed. Equip and use them to scatter these into a farming plot and start growing! Best Planted in Brynmoor plots.
item_1281.lead: Redberry seeds are a type of Brynmoor seed, used in the Farming skill. Redberry seeds can be used to grow redberries in a farming plot. However, it is best to plant them in an ash farming plot.

journal.text: Grow your own tasty berries with these lovely little seeds. In ancient Ashenfall, young villagers would gift a potential romantic partner with a handful of berries, and if the plant flourished it was seen as proof that they were meant to be together. Most considered it a rather cheap and rubbish gift, and so contrary to the folklore, these rarely resulted in meaningful relationships.

item_1282.desc: Obtained from felling lesser red dragons. Can be processed at the tannery.
item_1282.lead: Red dragon hide is a basic material dropped by red dragons which can be tanned to create red dragonhide leather.

item_1283.desc: Made by tanning red dragonhide. A key crafting component for armour.
item_1283.lead: Red dragonhide leather is a processed material created from tanning red dragon hide.

item_1284.desc: A rare gemstone used to craft enchanted jewellery.
item_1284.lead: Red topaz is a gemstone that can be obtained by mining silver ore nodes. It can be found if the player has unlocked the Gem Prospector perk at level 16 Mining. It can be manually mined with an appropriate pickaxe or using the Rocksplosion spell.

journal.text: This glittering gemstone really catches the light, sparkling like a tiny little star that’s dying. Count Valingard, one of Brynmoor’s nobility in the Third Age, was very fond of these stones and was said to have an entire chandelier made from them. Sadly, dragon fire appears to be particularly good at melting them, so the chandelier is no longer with us.

item_1285.desc: An object of pure, refined obsidian.
item_1285.lead: Refined obsidian is a basic item processed from nine ground obsidian at the blast furnace.

journal.text: It's hard for a human to understand just how much obsidian means to a KotHaar. Imagine that your homes, tools and weapons were the flesh of your ancestors. Imagine that the money in your wallet was stretched skin from a distant relative. Now, switch out your disgust for a kind of holy reverence: the KotHaar feel this towards all the obsidian about them. That flesh isn't just a physical remnant of their ancestors, it carries their memories too. Knowledge permeates the rock.

item_1286.desc: A versatile textile used for crafting equipment and furniture. It is woven at a loom from linen thread.
item_1286.lead: Rough cloth is created with a loom, requiring three coarse thread. Rough cloth is used primarily for constructing rugs and Wizard Armour.

item_1287.desc: A mysterious porous rock used as a base for powerful runes.
item_1287.lead: Rune essence can be gathered by mining rune essence stones surrounding the geysers around Ashenfall. Some spawn with rocks on the ground that you can easily gather from. The floating rocks require being hit (most easily with an arrow or an attack from a staff), and they will then fall to the ground to be mined. Alternatively, players can cast Rocksplosion whilst aiming at the floating rocks and can collect rune essence without affecting the pickaxe's durability.

item_1288.desc: Made from combining necrotic bonemeal and ectoplasm. Used as a crafting component.
item_1288.lead: Sacred oil is one of the materials required for making power level 5 armour.

journal.text: You may think an undead bone is no different from a normal bone, and in most cases that's true. The animating forces of necromancy normally just puppet the bones, allowing them to be possessed by a spirit or controlled by some external force. The undead of Fellhollow are different. They are animated by the last remnants of their humanity, tiny bits of soul clinging on in tattered forms. They move because they need to and they shudder because they fear what happens when they stop. As such, the bones of the Fellhollow dead have strange properties that a skilled craftsman can refine and find uses for. Morbid, yes, but inventive.

item_1289.desc: A building material; can be ground into sand.
item_1289.lead: Sandstone is a basic Mining material mined from sandstone rocks, found scattered across the Fractured Plains, Stormtouched Highlands, Dowdun Reach and Umbral Sands. Sandstone is used in construction, alongside Stone and granite. [[File:Sandstone Rocks.png|thumb|Two Sandstone rocks in the Fractured Plains]]

journal.text: A rock with a grainy texture. I really don't know what you're expecting here, there's no deep lore about sandstone.

item_1290.desc: A rare gemstone used to craft enchanted jewellery.
item_1290.lead: Sapphire is a gemstone that can be obtained by mining gold ore nodes. It can be found if the player has unlocked the Gem Prospector perk at level 16 Mining. It can be manually mined with an appropriate pickaxe or using the Rocksplosion spell.

journal.text: Your eyes are like sapphires, sparkling in the night Every syllable you utter creates pure delight. A day in your company is infinitely bright Will you be my valentine tonight? A poem by a lovestruck Bramblemead youth. It was not successful. Aside from their use in terrible teenage poetry, sapphires are a vital component in jewellery crafting. They can be found hidden among the metal ores around Ghornfell, or hidden in the various chests left behind by the old kingdom.

item_1291.desc: A light yet resilient leather, suited for survival in desert sands.
item_1291.lead: Scorch leather is thicker and more resilient than hard leather. Players can create scorch leather with draconic leather, kalphite shell and a piece of acrid adhesive in a advanced tannery.

item_1292.desc: A shimmering iridescent powder. Its shifting hues are almost hypnotic.
item_1292.lead: Shimmerscale powder is a processed material created at a grindstone from kalphite wings, its star-like shimmer making it a key ingredient in the creation of infinity cloth.

item_1293.desc: A bitter, green herb used to make potions.
item_1293.lead: Shocking plant bulb is dropped by the wild lapulis vine, which is found in the Stormtouched Highlands.

item_1294.desc: A collection of various sharp objects.
item_1294.lead: Shrapnel can be found whilst killing terrorbirds and garou hunters found within the Fractured Plains.

journal.text: Dropped by enemies who inflict Bleed. Small collections of sharp little objects. Stone, metal, bone, each of these combines to create a little bit of hate in the palm of your hand. The brutal points of these bits of shrapnel can tear the skin and rend the flesh, making them perfect for crafting weapons to make things bleed.

item_1295.desc: Scraps of shrimp dressed to be eaten by fish. A Sardines favorite snack. Increases the catch chance of this fish.
item_1295.lead: Shrimp bait is a power level 2 Fishing bait crafted at the crafting table. It increases the chance of catching sardine. Players can store the bait in a tackle box, which holds up to 48 baits.

journal.text: Fishing bait made from a shrimp. Not terribly exciting, in the grand scheme of things, but still very useful for catching more fish.

item_1296.desc: A precious and rare metal used to craft enchanting jewellery.
item_1296.lead: Silver bars are primarily obtained by smelting silver ore in a furnace. Silver bars are used for making dark mage armour, the ornate maul handle, and other decorations.

item_1297.desc: A thin sheet of finest silver, can be used for demonstrating your prowess, potion making or even recycling into silver bars.
item_1297.lead: Silver leaf is a craftable item reward from various Agility courses that allows the player to make potions or create silver bars. To obtain these, players must either collect them from silver (or golden) reward packs or recycle silver bars in the jeweler's bench to make sheets of ten per bar.

journal.text: If you're getting bored of your amulet or cloak, why not liven it up with a bit of silver leaf? Be a bit of a fancy dandy: treat yourself to a little embellishment. Round it off by wearing a monocle and a ruff.

item_1298.desc: A rare, precious ore. It can be smelted into silver bars at a furnace.
item_1298.lead: Silver ore is a basic Mining material mined from silver ore nodes, which are mainly found in the Bloodblight Swamp. It can be smelted at a furnace to make silver bars.

journal.text: Silver is an excellent conductor of magic. It’s why it shows up in so many legends and myths about supernatural foes. As a precious metal, it is highly prized in the crafting of jewellery and strongly disliked by lycanthropes everywhere.

item_1299.desc: Scraps that can be searched through. Take a look inside.
item_1299.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_1299.lead: Silver salvage piles are a basic material, nine of them can be smelted in a furnace to create one silver bar.

item_1300.desc: Sharp little teeth used in weaponry.
item_1300.lead: Small animal fang is a basic item dropped by kebbits, rats, and wolves. Players can make fang arrows, evasive infusions, daggers, and potions with these fangs.

item_1301.desc: The image of a fearsome dragon. Used in crafting powerful equipment.
item_1301.lead: The smouldering draconic visage is an award obtained from the Icthlarin's Little Helper quest. To gain this item, one must trade Fuzan's head to Icthlarin. This item can be used to craft the dragonfire shield.

item_1302.desc: A sweet-smelling herb used in restorative potions.
item_1302.lead: Snapdragon is a herb that can be found by harvesting the Snapdragon plant in the Bloodblight Swamp or can be bought from Domri - The Merchant for 12 garou chits.

item_1303.desc: Snapdragon seeds. Equip and use them to scatter these into a farming plot and start growing! Best planted in Ghornfell plots.
item_1303.lead: Snapdragon seeds are a type of Ghornfell seed, used in the Farming skill. Snapdragon seeds can be obtained from harvesting wild Snapdragon.

journal.text: Unfortunately, these seeds do not grow adorable little scaly nightmares to terrorise your enemies. Fortunately, they do grow into useful little medicinal herbs with various uses in herblore. So, an alright trade-off, even if the tiny dragons would be better.

item_1304.lead: Soft animal fur is a basic item gathered from killing smaller creatures, such as wolves and dire wolves. Three soft animal furs can be made into one wool thread at a spinning wheel.

item_1305.desc: Someone may have use for this.
item_1305.lead: A soul fragment is a special material sourced mainly from defeating monsters and mining soul stones. It is also a type of currency used in Death's Exchange to purchase several item recipes, and capes - these can be found in chests within Fellhollow, dropped by undead monsters, or mined through the soul stones found in the spectral doors.

item_1306.desc: Bait that gives fish the heeby-jeebies, but draws them in anyway. Undead Bass love a jump scare. Increases the catch chance of this fish.
item_1306.lead: Spooky bait is a power level 5 Fishing bait crafted at the crafting table. It increases the chance of catching undead bass. Players can store the bait in a tackle box, which holds up to 48 baits.

journal.text: The ghostly remnants of ectoplasm can be strangely appealing to certain fish. Perhaps it is the siren call of the rivers of the underworld, calling all life to it’s ultimate destination. Perhaps it’s some sort of ancestral grief urging the fish to reconnect with those they have lost. Perhaps it’s simply that they find the thing pretty. Who can really say?

item_1307.desc: Made by smelting coal and iron ore together. A primary ingredient for steel weapons, armour and tools.
item_1307.lead: A steel bar is a component of a variety of armour and weapons. Players must use either three iron ores or one iron bar along with three coal (with a fuel pellet) in a blast furnace.

journal.text: If iron had been a marvel, steel was a revelation. Sturdier structures, more durable armor, weapons sharper and stronger than ever seen before. If the people of Brynmoor had known about steel, then perhaps the garou threat would have been over almost as soon as it began. For the people of Emberwoord, it led to superior farming tools, stronger buildings, and better hunting equipment. After all, what need did people have for weapons and armour with a dragon protecting them?

item_1308.desc: A pair of Steel crossbow limbs. Used in crafting a Steel Crossbow.
item_1308.lead: Steel crossbow limbs are used for crafting steel crossbows. They are created at a blacksmith's bench.

journal.text: Steel crossbow limbs are sturdier than their counterparts, with a greater durability that allows them to create stronger and more dangerous crossbows. Indeed, this durability seems to have put a nominal end to the unfortunate curse between cats and crossbow limb related catastrophes. As a result, in Fellhollow, cats still had a place in the home, even after they had been systematically outcast from Bramblemead. It was said that Xikotal, in particular, enjoyed the gentle purring noises that they made and would surround his lair with hundreds of the creatures so that he might be lulled into a gentle sleep.

item_1309.desc: .Scraps that can be searched through. It's the steel of the century.
item_1309.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_1309.lead: Steel salvage piles are a basic material that can be combined with three coal in a blast furnace to create one steel bar.

item_1310.desc: A basic building and crafting material.
item_1310.lead: Stone is a basic Mining material found all over Ashenfall and inside vaults. Stone can be mined or picked up from any regions. It's used in a wide variety of crafting, from building to item making. Receiving stone in the player's inventory for the first time will unlock the creation of the stone range and the kiln.

item_1311.lead: Stone blocks are Construction materials made by putting stones in a stonecutter.

item_1312.lead: Stunted kalphite wing is a basic item dropped by kalphite workers that can be processed at a grindstone into shimmerscale powder.

item_1313.lead: Swamp tar is obtained by gathering from the ground in the Whispering Swamp, and is used inside a kiln to create adhesive.

item_1314.desc: A crafting material made by spinning Swamp Weed.
item_1314.lead: Swamp thread is a basic item created at a spinning wheel using 1 swamp weed.

item_1315.desc: A hardy plant found in swamps and caves.
item_1315.lead: [[File:Swamp Weed Model.jpg|thumb|Swamp Weed next to a player for size comparison]] Swamp weed can be harvested by the swamp weed plant, which mostly spawns in and around the poisonous waters in the Bloodblight Swamp and inside the Kletterbuja Kara vault. It can be used to create swamp thread.

item_1316.desc: Swamp weed seeds. Equip and use them to scatter these into a farming plot and start growing! Best Planted in Ghornfell plots.
item_1316.lead: Swamp weed seeds are a type of Ghornfell seed, used in the Farming skill. Swamp weed seeds can be used to grow swamp weed in a farming plot. However, it is best to plant them in oak farming plot. Planting swamp weed seeds in a farming plot will yield 5 experience in Farming. Swamp weed seeds can be obtained from harvesting wild Swamp Weed.

journal.text: Sometimes you don't want to grow pretty little flowers, you want to grow something you found in the murkiest corners of the world. Swamp weed, as it's name suggests, is normally found in the deadly swamps of Ashenfall, but with these seeds you can grow them from the comfort of your garden.

item_1317.lead: Tea leaves is a basic item bought from merchants for 20 garou chits or found in chests in Umbral Sands . It can be processed into dried tea leaves at the kiln.

journal.text: Tea leaves have three uses, at least at the time of writing. The top survey answer is of course 'for making tea' - congratulations if you got that one. Then there's augury, using the tea leaves to divine the future. Finally - and this one's the pointless answer - if they are stuffed into someone's nostrils while they sleep, it will often induce the voiding of one's urine. It's true, go look it up. Information to hold back from your children, if you have any.

item_1319.desc: Mined from tin deposits. It can be smelted at a Furnace.
item_1319.lead: Tin ore is a basic Mining material mined from tin ore nodes, which can are mainly found in the Fractured Plains. It can be smelted at a furnace along with Copper to produce bronze bars.

item_1321.desc: A spicy tasting herb used in resistance potions.
item_1321.lead: Toadflax is found by harvesting the Toadflax plants in the Bloodblight Swamp and can be bought from Domri - The Merchant for 12 garou chits.

item_1322.desc: Toadflax seeds. Equip and use them to scatter these into a farming plot and start growing! Best planted in Ghornfell plots.
item_1322.lead: Toadflax seeds are a type of Ghornfell seed, used in the Farming skill. Toadflax seeds can be obtained from harvesting wild toadflax (plant).

journal.text: Although they prefer the toxic atmosphere of the Bloodlight swamps, these seeds can grow just about anywhere with the right care paid to them.

item_1323.lead: Tomatoes are a Power Level 2 raw ingredient, which means they can be cooked at a campfire or grill into grilled tomatoes starting at Cooking level 12, and not burnt into burnt tomato at level 27. They can be gathered from Tomato (Farming) from tomato seeds.

item_1324.desc: Tomato Seeds. Equip and use them to scatter these into a farming plot and start growing! Best planted in Ghornfell plots.
item_1324.lead: Tomato seeds are a type of Ghornfell seed, used in the Farming skill.

journal.text: Unlock the plant that causes the most arguments amongst the truly bored, the humble tomato. Is it a fruit? A vegetable? A plague on sandwiches everywhere? Well, now you can start these arguments wherever you like, by planting one of these beauties in a fresh farming patch.

item_1325.desc: Dropped from the restless dead. Use as a crafting material, or process at a grindstone.
item_1325.lead: Undead bones are drops from enemies in Fellhollow.

journal.text: You may think an undead bone is no different from a normal bone, and in most cases that’s true. The animating forces of necromancy normally just puppet the bones, allowing them to be possessed by a spirit or controlled by some external force. The undead of Fellhollow are different. They animated by the last remnants of their humanity, tiny bits of soul clinging on in tattered forms. They move because they need to and they shudder because they fear what happens when they stop. As such, the bones of the Fellhollow dead have strange properties that a skilled craftsman can refine and find uses for. Morbid, yes, but inventive.

item_1326.lead: The undead draconic visage is an award obtained from Death in exchange for Imaru's head, which is obtained by killing Imaru during or after the quest Withering Heights. It can be used to upgrade the anti-dragon shield into the dragoncurse shield.

item_1327.desc: Obtained from undead beasts. Can be cooked for ... interesting results.
item_1327.lead: Undead meat is a Power Level 4 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire or grill into cauterised undead steak starting at Cooking level 41, and not burnt into burnt undead steak at level 50. It is dropped by zombie cows, zombie rats, and rotridden rats in Fellhollow.

item_1328.desc: This trout has seen things. You almost feel apologetic for catching it.
item_1328.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_1328.lead: Unusual trout is a raw ingredient that can be captured by grabbing it from the pool of fish for OffalFoot in The Lake far beneath The Courtyard. The area in which to grab it is accessed through the catacombs beneath the The Cathedral.

journal.text: The trout is unusual in a few different ways. It's still breathing even out of water, which you could probably classify as more than just "unusual". But we like to stay away from hyperbole, so we'll stick with "unusual" for now. It also seems to be eyeballing you. Little sideways glances that could be interpreted as judgements. And when you do fail at something - burn a fish, perhaps - it tuts, loudly, like a librarian.

item_1329.desc: A dragonkin energy source, found only within dragonkin vaults.
item_1329.lead: A vault core can be found on pedestals in dragonkin vaults. Their primary use is to make lodestones, which serve as a teleport location that can be travelled to from any other lodestone the player has placed on the map. They are also components of several masterworks, such as the abyssal whip and dragonblight shield. Note that these respawn in their plinths every three in-game days, so their quantity is not limited.

item_1330.desc: Stone imbued with remnants of dragonkin magic. Found only in dragonkin vaults.
item_1330.lead: Vault shards are items used in crafting several items and can be obtained from vault guardians found in dragonkin vaults.

item_1331.desc: Remains of a demonic creature. A crafting material used to make demonic oil.
item_1331.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_1331.lead: Vile ashes are a processed material required for making demonic oil and giant krill bait.

journal.text: Demons do not leave bones behind on death. That would require a skeleton, a prospect that would make a demon queasy. Instead, demons are magical entities, composed of essence and energies. On death, they disperse, leaving an ashy composite. Don't be mistaken in thinking that it's similar to the ash left after a fire. Dab your tongue in Vile Ash and you'll soon understand where the "vile" comes from.

item_1332.desc: A fibrous root with unique properties.
item_1332.lead: A vine root is an item that cannot be obtained in the game.

item_1333.desc: Beautiful feather used to power the Gyrhawk Amulet, which grants additional experience for exploration.
item_1333.lead: Warped feathers is a basic Agility material that can be found from Agility courses reward packs. Warped feathers can create the gyrhawk amulet along with coarse thread. However, players will need more feathers to charge the amulet to gain Agility experience whilst running, jumping, and dodging.

journal.text: Is there a sorrier tale than that of the Ashenfall gyrhawk? It was such a beautiful bird, and it was the closest that the natural world has ever come to a daredevil. It lived to swoop through winding canyons, to plunge into forest canopies. It didn't matter if it was chasing prey: it would negotiate sharp turns and small gaps for the simple sport of it. Man-made structures were just as attractive to a{{sic

item_1334.lead: Watermelons are a consumable food item that provides 15 sustenance. They are also a Power Level 4 resource, which means they can be cooked at a campfire or grill into watermelon jerky starting at Cooking level 41, and not be burnt into burnt watermelon at level 50. They can also be used to make a scarecrow. They can be gathered from Watermelon (Farming) grown from watermelon seeds. Watermelons cannot be used as an item in a compost bin, however can be used as an item in a super compost bin.

item_1335.desc: Watermelon seeds. Equip and use them to scatter these into a farming plot and start growing! Best Planted in Fellhollow plots.
item_1335.lead: Watermelon seeds are a type of Fellhollow seed, used in the Farming skill. Watermelon seeds can be used to grow watermelon plants in a farming plot. However, it is best to plant them in a willow farming plot. Planting watermelon seeds in a farming plot will yield 5 experience in Farming.

journal.text: These tiny seeds can grow into a delightful patch of scrumptious watermelons. Use them to cultivate plants for delicious fruit salads, add garnish to garnish cocktails, or paint faces on them if you're very lonely.

item_1336.desc: A symbol of flowing waters, essential for water-based magic and other spells. Runes are retained if you happen to die.
item_1336.lead: Water runes are runes imbued with water, found in certain mob drop packs like goblin packs and garou packs. They can be crafted at a rune altar at level 11 (or higher) Runecrafting or created by siphoning water anima vents.

item_1337.lead: Weeds are a Farming item, dug from Farming patches when nothing is growing on them. Players will need a spade to harvest this item, and can place it into a compost bin to convert to compost.

journal.text: Even the plant world has its outcasts. Weeds are unloved, unwanted and yet they always find a way to turn up in the most unexpected of places. Just like my cousin Terry. Still, at least weeds have some uses.. unlike Terry.

item_1338.lead: Wheat is a power level 2 raw ingredient. It can be harvested from wheat (farming) after it has fully grown. Wheat seeds can be used in a farming plot to grow the source plant.

item_1339.desc: Some Wheat Seeds. Equip and use them to scatter these into a farming plot and start growing! Best planted in Brynmoor plots.
item_1339.lead: Wheat seeds are a type of Brynmoor seed, used in the Farming skill. Wheat seeds can be used to grow wheat in a farming plot. However, it is best to plant them in ash farming plot. Planting wheat seeds in a farming plot will yield 5 experience in Farming. Wheat seeds can be obtained from goblin packs, and the Wise Old Man will give three wheat seeds to the player when starting the Growing Pains side-quest.

journal.text: If you're trying to reduce your carbohydrate intake, then you probably want to toss these seeds into the fire. If, however, you're a fan of bread in all its many and sundry forms, then you can start your life as a wheat farmer with a handful of these seeds. Just plant them in a farming patch and start planning the name of your future bakery.

item_1340.desc: Raw magical essence, extremely useful in magical recipes and equipment. Refined by herblore masters from anima-infused bark.
item_1340.lead: Wild anima can be made with anima-infused bark in a kiln.

journal.text: Magic is made up of motes of anima, refined and collected into specific forms. Rune essence can be made to hold these motes, creating dedicated magical components for spells and enchantments. Wild anima is useful for magical construction, but cannot be converted into true spellcraft, as the motes are unaligned and prone to strange reactions.

item_1341.desc: A highly efficient fuel. Required for smelting more advanced metals.
item_1341.lead: Willow logs are obtained by chopping down willow trees. An iron logging axe (or better) is required to chop down willow trees.

item_1342.desc: Willow Tree Seeds. Plant this directly into the ground to grow your own Tree!
item_1342.lead: A willow tree seed is a type of seed, used with the Farming skill to grow a willow tree.

item_1343.desc: Dropped from withered enemies. Used as a crafting ingredient.
item_1343.lead: Withered heart is a drop from rotsworn creatures in Fellhollow, and can be converted to three ectoplasms in a kiln.

journal.text: The heart is a pump, nothing more, designed to push precious blood around the circulatory system, so that our weak and feeble frames can function. Yet, metaphysically, it is the most important organ, for it houses our emotional centre, the very essence of what makes us human. A withered heart isn't just a heart that has languished. Nor is it just a heart that is drained of blood. No, a withered heart has had all the humanity leeched from it, emptied of emotion, or connection, of self. This process is imperfect, of course, and tiny fragments of soul-matter remain, which can be refined and extracted from the heart - withdrawing the last remnants of what made the owner "them".

item_1344.desc: A strong and lightweight crafting material.
item_1344.lead: Wool cloth is created in a loom using three wool thread.

journal.text: Bolts of durable Woollen cloth, popular with mages and anyone who likes a little thermal insulation in their armour.

item_1345.desc: Spun from sheep fleece, essential for making warm garments and padded cloth.
item_1345.lead: Wool thread is a material used to craft mainly armour and some weapons. It is created at a spinning wheel by using either 3 soft animal fur or 1 fleece. Three wool threads can be made into one wool cloth at a loom.

journal.text: The fluffy coats of sheep, refined and wound down into a single thread. Useful for crafting various garments and highly prized by grandmothers everywhere. On the mainland, the most impressive collection of wool belongs to Great-Aunt Potterington, in Kandarin. Her sister, Granny Potterington, is constantly trying to claim this title for herself and has accelerated her sheep breeding program in an attempt to mass produce as much wool as possible.

item_1346.desc: An exceptionally durable and heat-resistant tree variety, yew is highly elastic, decay-resistant, and excellent for bending, making it a perfect choice for bows and high-quality furniture carving.
item_1346.lead: Yew logs are obtained by chopping down yew trees, with a adamant logging axe or better.

item_1347.desc: A milled piece of yew timber.
item_1347.lead: Yew planks are made by using yew logs on a sawmill.

journal.text: A tree is a beautiful and wayward thing. It grows in twists and contortions, curling towards light and water. Place a seed and you cannot predict which way it will grow, if at all. So, what do you do? You cut it into a precise 2x8 format and line them up next to each other. If one has an imperfection, you toss it away as waste. The yew tree's revenge is coming. And it may well take the form of cutting humans up into a precise 2x8 format. Then it will go back to growing into beautiful, wayward shapes.

item_1349.desc: A brutal weapon crafted from the spine of a terrifying Abyssal Demon.
item_1349.lead: The abyssal whip is a power level 4 one-handed masterwork melee weapon that can be created at a blacksmith's bench. The recipe can be acquired from the Kletterbuja Kara vault by interacting with a dragonkin statue clutching a blue orb, and hidden within a concealed alcove on the upper floor, near the ledge-jumping path, provided players have the abyssal spine that is dropped by an abyssal demon in the player's inventory. It can be ascended at a mystic forge with ascension cores.

journal.text: Abyssal demons are foul beasts. A single specimen can massacre a village before the warning bell can even sound. Crafting a weapon from their remains symbolises triumph against adversity or, perhaps, just hubris in its purest form. Infused with the hate of the demon, each whip crack generates unbearable pain. Victims find themselves overcome with suffering as the agony seeps into the wounds the whips leave behind. It is said that the whip even feeds on that misery, growing stronger with each strike, each life taken. The hate imbues the weapon with a desire to inflict more pain, and it grows stronger each time such a wish is granted. Or, so the legends say. Only one wild knight has ever chosen to wield the whip in vengeance against a demon for a fallen sibling. Her name is dust in the wind of history, but there are still creatures that hide in the shadows, afraid of the crack of her whip.

item_1350.desc: Arrows with tips forged from adamant.
item_1350.lead: Adamant arrows are a power level 7 ammunition that are crafted at a fletching bench, and can be used to craft adamant barbed arrow, poisoned adamant arrow, and adamant fire arrow.

journal.text: There is a constant battle between fletchers and armour smiths to one up each other. The armour smiths craft armour from stronger, sturdier and harder materials, meaning arrows must be made of equally, or greater, sturdiness of materials to pierce through them. The adamant arrow is a shining example of this eternal conflict. The metal is durable, powerful and deadly in the right hands, and pierces mithril, steel and lesser metals with almost mocking ease. Only adamant and greater quality armour stands a chance against them."

item_1351.desc: Lacerating arrows with barbed tips forged from adamant.
item_1351.lead: Adamant barbed arrows are a power level 7 ammunition that are crafted at a fletching bench.

journal.text: There are moments in life where you just decide that something must be forced to suffer. These arrows are designed just for that. When your enemy aggrieves you so much that you want to rip and tear and bleed them to death, this is the arrow for you. The Moon Garou do not use these arrows, even though they are aware of their construction. They consider it an unnecessary amount of suffering to inflict, when a well-placed shot is quicker and less dangerous for everyone else. Bandits that take up these arrows soon find themselves mistrusted even by their fellow thieves.

item_1352.desc: A crossbow bolt with an adamant tip.
item_1352.lead: Adamant bolts are a power level 7 ammunition crafted at a fletching bench.

journal.text: Sturdy bolts of one of the most durable metals. Capable of piercing most armours with relative ease. Have you considered what else those metal bars could be used for? You could create tools that would grow plants in these desolate lands. You could craft beautiful sculptures to bring joy to all who see them. But, no, you went with murder spikes instead. Though there are ruddy great dragons around the place, so I suppose it’s a fair plan.

item_1353.desc: A solid crossbow reinforced with adamant.
item_1353.lead: A adamant crossbow is a power level 7 crossbow crafted at a fletching bench.

journal.text: You’ll be pleased to learn, dear adventurer, that the first person to make this crossbow in Ashenfall is, indeed, you… or your friend if there are a few of you around. The techniques that create them are no different to the previous crossbows, but the wood is sturdier, stronger and capable of sufficiently more damage when wielded with skill. The Moon Garou are traditionalists, preferring the art of archery in hunting and combat, so why not take this opportunity to show them how much they’re missing out.

item_1354.desc: Short, sharp and to the point.
item_1354.lead: The adamant dagger is a power level 7 one-handed melee weapon.

journal.text: Moon Garou tradition gifts a young warrior with a blade when they reach adolescence. One of the elder family members takes an old weapon of theirs and melts it down, refining age, memories and experience into a new blade for the newest generation. It is a great day of pride for a young warrior to be gifted their first blade, but a bittersweet for the old warriors as they give up the dreams of future battles, passing the torch to those who come after. Adamant, being the strongest metal that the Moon Garou can access, is believed to hold the strongest memories and those lucky youngsters that gain such a blade often find themselves elevated to positions of great respect and authority.

item_1355.desc: Burning arrows with tips forged from adamant, coated in fire oil.
item_1355.lead: Adamant fire arrows are a power level 7 ammunition that are crafted at a fletching bench.

journal.text: Fire almost seems redundant beneath the scorching glare of the Umbral Sands corrupted sun, yet fire will always find a way to burn something, if you let it. The shamans of ancient Moon Garou tribes believed that fire was intelligent, and alive, in ways that defied normal understanding. Some fires were good, gentle creatures, that would warm the hearth and banish the cold in the night. But other fires were cruel things, possessed of an overwhelming desire for destruction. The danger, of course, is, like people, all fires have the potential to betray you. Which is why some hunters had the sense to make sure the fire was very far away from them, by launching it through the air at ludicrous speeds.

item_1357.desc: A strong and massive blade made of adamant.
item_1357.lead: The adamant greatsword is a power level 7 two-handed melee weapon.

journal.text: Few foes can stand against a great big slab of metal, filed down to the keenest edge. The weight of a great sword applied tremendous pressure across the edge, meaning that victims of a swing tend to find themselves falling to pieces in the face of it… quite literally. The adamant greatsword is stronger than most blades, with only a handful of other metals offering sturdier construction. It was forged first by the legendary hero, Connakt, a Moon Garou warrior of great regard. Massive was his frame, and so he required a similarly sized blade in battle. He wielded his greatsword in a single hand, terrifying all who stood before him. Connakt, it is said, travelled beyond the Umbral Sands, and indeed beyond Ashenfall, though the legends on how he did so vary greatly. They say that he travelled far away, settled down somewhere and had a family. His greatsword “Sgian ìm” was buried with him.

item_1358.desc: A strong woodcutting axe, good for trees that hit back.
item_1358.lead: An adamant logging axe is a power level 7 logging axe that can cut yew trees. Making one requires 8 adamant bars, 6 maple logs, and 4 desert thread, and requires a blacksmith's bench.

journal.text: As the anima infused them more deeply, the trees of Ashenfall sought ways to create stronger defences against their hated foes – the lumberjacks. Yew trees, hardened after surviving the cruel rays of the sun, developed bark that would shatter lesser axes. They felt invulnerable. Unbeatable. They could take the time to plan their war against the logging axes, so that they might rise up and strangle the world with their roots. Yet, the lumberjacks had a friend in the earth, and adamantite rose up to aid its allies. The metal was harder than any before it, and the yew trees didn’t stand a chance, falling to the new weapons in droves.

item_1359.desc: An adamant mace designed to crush your enemies.
item_1359.lead: The adamant mace is a power level 7 one-handed melee weapon.

journal.text: The first adamant mace was not, as you might expect, used for battle. Rather it was a rolling pin used by the ancient matriarch known only as The Crone – a name she chose for herself, thinking it quite funny. Her baking skills were so dire, that whatever she produced had the consistency of iron and was more durable than steel. So, she required a tool strong enough to fight back against her sturdy pastries. She commissioned a rolling pin of adamant metal, and she used it with great zeal to beat her baked goods into submission. Though teeth would still shatter against her scones, there was an artistry there that none could deny. So it was that more people would create adamant rolling pins, until an angry chef beat her rude husband to death with it, and the first true adamant mace was born. After that, Moon Garou would still favour an adamant rolling pin, but many a warrior would bring a mace into battle, just in case they were forced to face up against the crone’s pastries. Which happened more often than is reasonably explainable.

item_1360.desc: A sturdy pickaxe made of adamant.
item_1360.lead: Adamant pickaxe is a power level 7 pickaxe that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. It can mine the same ores as the previous tiers, dealing 84 damage to minable ores, and 168 with a critical swing.

item_1361.desc: A fast, curved, and very efficient sword.
item_1361.lead: The adamant scimitar is a power level 7 one-handed melee weapon.

journal.text: Wherever there is a sea, there are pirates, and the desert sands are a sea of sorts. A contingent of young Moon Garou once created a combination of rats, sails and a dash of magic, to create a sort of sand-ship, which they intended to use in acts of glorious buccaneering across the umbral desert. They equipped themselves with scimitars of adamant, as it most closely resembled the cutlasses they’d heard about from human stories that had been stolen during the garou wars centuries past. With eye-patches, golden teeth and an overzealous use of a particular consonant these youths set forth to become legends. Or they would, if their ship hadn’t immediately capsized and their mothers called them all back for tea.

item_1362.lead: Adamant shield is a power level 7 shield. Players will need to have scorch leather to unlock the adamant shield in the blacksmith's bench.

journal.text: You may ask yourself what better defence there is than a large sheet of metal between you and your enemy, and teh answer will surprise you. Thicker metal. OK, so that's not a surprise, I'm sorry. I was just trying to build a little dramatic tension. The adamant shield is one of the greatest defensive creations available in Umbral Sands and favoured by any Moon Garou that needs to brave the kalphite hives or the KotHaar territories. Lesser arrows ping harmlessly off them, and weaker blades have been known to shatter against the adamant's hardness. Shields are good, everyone should have one.

item_1363.desc: A durable spade made from Adamantite.
item_1363.lead: An adamant spade is a power level 7 spade unlocked the first time the player picks up an adamant bar. It is crafted at the blacksmith's bench. When used to dig a farming plot, players will use 10 stamina and progress instantly to the next plot clearing stage.

journal.text: DAMN IT MAN, CAN'T YOU SEE THAT I AM A SPADE? I give you: an adamant spade. Do you get it? You get it, right? Don't make us dig a hole and hide in shame.

item_1364.desc: A reliable blade made of adamant.
item_1364.lead: The adamant sword is a power level 7 one-handed melee weapon.

journal.text: It is said that the pen is mightier than the sword, but there are multiple examples where this is proven false. A pen cannot stop another blade. It cannot slay a monster. It can write strongly worded letters, but when have they ever worked? The Moon Garou know the power of a good sword. They took the metal of the desert, with it’s green hue and unyielding nature and they turned it against the monsters of the sands. Beasts, great and powerful, fell to these weapons, entire legions of deadly creatures cut down in the dunes. Moon Garou poets carry a sword with them, because words can only cut so deep. For a lasting impression you need a very sharp edge.

item_1365.desc: A heavy warhammer forged from adamant.
item_1365.lead: The adamant warhammer is a power level 7 two-handed melee weapon

journal.text: A little know tradition among Moon Garou blacksmiths, is to gather up all the bits of scrap metal from their workshops and create from them little figurines. They then sit beneath the shade somewhere, with various paints and turn these tiny creations into little pieces of art. That was, until, Thraag learned of the game. Thraag was a blacksmith only so much in that he liked seeing metal melt. Something about the glow, the heat and the sheer sturdiness of the cooling metal, filled him with a sense of pride he never put into his personal hygiene. Reeking like some unholy nightmare, Thraag was never invited to the gatherings of other blacksmiths, and over time the slight of being shunned festered within him, slowly mutating into something nasty. He crafted a great hammer of pure adamant, sturdier and heavier then any hammer ever crafted before and he brought said hammer to the blacksmith gathering. There are few sights quite so tragic as grown blacksmiths weeping over smashed figurines. It certainly did nothing to improve Thraag’s social standing.

item_1366.lead: The adamant watering can is a tool created at the blacksmith's bench. It is used to hydrate farming plots and has a capacity of 300 units.

journal.text: When you stop to think about it, a watering can is an odd item. It's a rain-delayer. You're holding back a little rain for times when there isn't rain. It's kept in an adamant holding-cell until that moment that it's allowed to run free, when it gets a short moment of elation before being sucked up the roots of a plant. That's weird, right? Or it just us? It's just us, isn't it. Ah darn it.

item_1367.lead: The adventurer's longbow is a power level 2 longbow which can be crafted using a fletching bench. The recipe is learned by consuming the vestige: a simple broken bow, found in a chest inside of Finn's Cave.

journal.text: The expedition to Ashenfall included skilled adventurers. If fate had been kinder, they could have gone down in legend as mighty heroes, rather than a slow, quiet,{{sic|improper serial comma

item_1368.desc: This provides partial protection from dragonbreath attacks.
item_1368.lead: The anti-dragon shield is a power level 3 masterwork shield that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench after obtaining the recipe from Vertentis Kara, the dragonkin vault in the Whispering Swamp. It is also one of the rewards for completing the Dragon Slayer quest, and is used as a material to craft the dragonblight shield, dragoncurse shield and the dragonfire shield. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.

item_1369.desc: A magical weapon carved from ash wood.
item_1369.lead: The ash battlestaff is a power level 2 magic weapon. It can be created at a crafting table using 12 ash logs, 6 rune essence, and 2 coarse thread.

item_1370.desc: A sturdy fishing rod, effective in Brynmoor.
item_1370.lead: The ash rod is a power level 2 Fishing tool crafted at the crafting table.

journal.text: Ah, the ash rod. It's been here from the First Age and will be here for many ages to come. Ever reliable, it gets the job done. Line up all the tools in the world and the ash rod will likely be named the most productive and certainly the most loved. All hail the ash rod!

item_1371.desc: A shortbow carved from ash wood.
item_1371.lead: Ash shortbow is a power level 2 Shortbow that can be crafted at a fletching bench.

item_1372.desc: A hulking greataxe made from black metal.
item_1372.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_1372.lead: The black greataxe is a power level 6 two-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. The recipe is unlocked after studying the bloodstained hilt, which can be purchased from Postie Pete's Evil Emporium for 300 infernal fragments, or acquired from chest (dowdun reach). It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.

journal.text: Black metal was most commonly used for armours, crossbows and swords. On occasion, it was used for a greataxe. The reason is not a pleasant one. They were almost exhaustively the tool of an executioner, when the crime merited a public execution. The black metal was a message: you have betrayed the Children of Shadows, and your death will come from the metal of our own.

item_1373.desc: A shield popularised by the Black Knights and made from black matal.
item_1373.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_1373.lead: The black shield is a power level 6 shield that is crafted with a blacksmith's bench. The recipe is unlocked after studying the battle-scarred black metal vestige, which can be purchased from Postie Pete's Evil Emporium for 300 infernal fragments. Unlike the black weapons, the shield cannot be found in chests in Dowdun Reach. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.

journal.text: More and more of the afflicted began talking in the voice that Rasmodel recognised: the voice from his recurring dreams. They were a chorus, moved from the land of dreams to his waking nightmare. Doubt burned in him. Was this epidemic his fault? Was it here for him? He couldn't hide his relationship to the epidemic anymore. When he walked past the afflicted, they would move from incoherent to coherent. They would sit up and speak to him. The message was the same: "submit to the Dreaming Stone". There were variations on that theme: use the Dreaming Stone; spread its energy; offer your mind to it. Lod Rasmodel was resolved. He would never submit. Perhaps therein was the trap. Perhaps it was shrewd psychology to make him destroy the stone. But destroy it he did. All it took was a single blow from his warhammer. A great and savage arc. As the crystal shattered and the shards punctured his skin, he felt peace. The voices were silenced. he knelt, bleeding and happy. And then the aftershocks came.

item_1374.desc: A sword in the style of the Black Knights, forged from black metal.
item_1374.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_1374.lead: The black sword is a one-handed power level 6 melee weapon. The recipe is unlocked after studying the shattered black blade vestige, which can be found in chests throughout Dowdun Reach or purchased from Postie Pete's Evil Emporium for 300 infernal fragments. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.

journal.text: Where the mithril crossbow is the standard issue of the ranged Black Knight, the black sword is standard for footsoldiers. 'Black', you may be aware, is not a material. It is instead a descriptor for steel that has gone through a process similar to vulcanisation. There was a time when the vulcanisation was performed by the dragon Xikotal, as a gift to the isolationist knights. With his death, the process moved towards the demonic. The resulting quality is lower, which has made the original, dragonfire 'black' metal sought after in Dowdun Reach.

item_1375.desc: A magical weapon fit for a Wizard.
item_1375.lead: Blightwood battlestaff is a power level 4 two-handed staff that can be crafted with a mystic forge.

journal.text: The stranger the wood, the more powerful the magic. It’s uncertain why this is, but it’s been true since magic was first discovered. When used as a tool for destructive magic, garou druids learned the power of blightwood. Ashien, a legendary druid among the garou, was among the first to wield such a weapon. As the story goes, they were wandering the swamps when the goddess Lougrim came to her in a vision and gave her a quest. Ashien was to journey deep into the swamps and do battle with a demon that dwelled{{sic|supposed to be dwelt

item_1376.desc: A finely crafted longbow, powerful and precise.
item_1376.lead: [[File:Blightwood Longbow (Equipped).jpg|thumb|Blightwood Longbow as seen when equipped by a player]] Blightwood longbow is a power level 4 Longbows that can be crafted at the fletching bench, once the recipe is unlocked by cutting and picking up blightwood and swamp thread.

journal.text: The wild creatures of Ashenfall have always been elusive. Bramblemead villagers would tell wild stories about the deer that got away or the sheep that shrugged off an arrow. Still, those who could wield a bow rarely left their family hungry. One Wild Knight, Frode, was so skilled with the bow that he never returned from a hunt empty-handed. His siblings among the Wild Knights would send him out hunting before every great gathering, so that they might feast heartily upon his return. For years, this was their happiest tradition. Until the day he did not return. It is said that his body was found in five separate places, spread out across the forests of Brynmoor like some gruesome compass. His quiver was empty, yet none of his arrows – marked as they were, with his symbol, an owl – would ever be found.

item_1377.desc: A finely crafted bow, fast and reliable.
item_1377.lead: The blightwood shortbow is a power level 4 Shortbow that can be crafted at a fletching bench.

journal.text: Every hunter reaches a crossroads in life when a choice becomes clear. They have honed their skills with a bow, surpassing the challenges posed by Brynmoor game. They could settle into a comfortable life in the village — hunting the same old deer, earning a regular wage and basking in a relaxing level of respect from their peers. Or, they could dare to dream bigger, to push their skills to new heights. The Wild Knights journeyed into more dangerous territories, facing off against deadly monsters warped by the anima twist. Joining them would mean abandoning the comfortable life of friends and family but earning a chance to face challenges that they would never face at home. Most choose comfort, as one might expect. But those who choose to improve would be taught how to craft a more powerful weapon, casting aside the oak bows that carry their names. They would carve a new name and identity into the limbs of their latest weapon and join the knights. Their names would be whispered. Gossip about them would transform into fireside stories — ghost tales about those still alive — the first embers of legends.

item_1378.desc: A trusty lightsource - now in blue.
item_1378.lead: The blue torch is a cosmetic variation of the torch tool item that can be wielded in the off-hand to help light up areas around the player, making it easier to see. It can be unlocked by studying extinguished blue remnants.

item_1380.desc: A crossbow made from Blurite, thought to be a myth.
item_1380.lead: The blurite crossbow is a power level 4 crossbow that can be crafted at a fletching bench. The recipe is learned after studying the azure metal contraption found in a chest in northwest Fractured Plains. It can be ascended at a mystic forge using ascension cores.

item_1382.desc: A primitive weapon made from bone, perfect for smashing other bones.
item_1382.lead: The bone club is a power level 2 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a crafting table. Its special attack is a small leap with an overhead slam, dealing moderate damage.

journal.text: Animal bones are surprisingly durable, especially those found on Ashenfall. The magic of the continent seeps into their marrow, slowly strengthening them and making them tougher. This goes some way to explaining the ferocity of ordinarily docile creatures, but it also helps when crafting tools. Cows and similar beasts were celebrated in the age of Guthix. The people of Brynmoor preferred to take an animal’s life only on the hunt or after long years of service. When an animal passed, it was thanked for its sacrifice, and the materials helped strengthen the village. A club forged of bone was a simple tool, but one that made defending the village much easier. Roving beasts were easily pushed back and the village was protected by the animal’s last gifts.

item_1383.desc: A sinister weapon, crafted from the bones of fallen creatures.
item_1383.lead: The bone dagger is a power level 2 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a crafting table. Its special attack is a small dash forward, followed by an upward slash, and can be useful as a combo extension.

journal.text: Before he learned to use the bow, Ulv survived with simple daggers of bone. He lived outside the village, cast out for his silence and strange ways. Ulv did not follow the polite nonsense of human society, nor did he seem to care for their troubles. The boy was happy just to survive and whittle small carvings of animals from fallen branches. He hunted silently, using the daggers to slay small prey such as rabbits and chickens. He ate what he needed and sold the excess at the markets for enough coin to purchase simple clothes and tools. When he was thirteen, he was beaten by bandits and left for dead. But a Wild Knight found him and brought him to safety. Recovering in the knight’s home, Ulv would be taught how to use a bow, a skill he soon mastered. When a wolf attacked Bramblemead, this outcast slew it. Villagers thanked him for his bravery and asked him what he wanted as a reward. He refused their offers and asked only for the wolf’s skull in return. He fashioned it into a mask that he chose as a new face, one he wore away from the village that had spurned him.

item_1384.desc: A basic mining tool made from tough animal bone. It is hard enough to mine copper and tin deposits.
item_1384.lead: A bone pickaxe is a power level 2 pickaxe that can be crafted at a crafting table. It can mine the same ores as the previous tiers, along with copper ore, and tin ore, dealing 15 damage to minable ores, and 30 damage with a critical swing.

item_1385.desc: This ancient bow is a relic of Elidnis: Goddess of the Moon, Rivers, Growth and Fertility.
item_1385.lead: The bow of Elidinis is a power level 7 masterwork longbow that can be crafted at a fletching bench. The recipe is received as a reward for completing the Mapping The Sands II quest. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.

journal.text: She is known by many names, both here and in the deserts entire oceans apart from one another, yet to all of them she is a source of life and creation. She is the river in the desert sands, from which all civilisation blooms, and she is the rain that washes away the cruel and merciless when the monsoon season comes. To the Moon Garou, she is the River Mother, the Moon Maiden, and their salvation. For it was she, who helped the wandering garou to step away from their primal predatory nature, and tame the sands, cultivating crops and building cities. She left the deserts centuries ago, to places unknown. Some say she wanders the stars in search of a place where her grief can be lessened. While others claim she prepares for war against a more insidious foe. A creature of fire, ash and hatred, the demon of the sun. This bow was left to one of her favourite Moon Garou, a warrior called Kyter, whom she raised as her own after he was orphaned by a cruel sandstorm. The bow was passed down his family line, parent to child, until the last of the bloodline was murdered by Fuzan. Now, the bow is yours. Use it wisely, for she will surely be annoyed if you don't.

item_1386.desc: Arrows with tips forged from bronze.
item_1386.lead: Bronze arrows are power level 3 ammunition that can be crafted at a fletching bench.

item_1387.desc: Lacerating arrows with barbed tips forged from bronze.
item_1387.lead: Bronze barbed arrows are bronze arrows with weapon barbs crafted on the arrow. Targets that are hit by a bronze barbed arrow will be inflicted with the bleed debuff. Like other barbed arrows, the icon will have a bleed icon placed on the top right of the arrow to distinguish itself from regular arrows.

journal.text: The barbed bronze arrow was the ammunition of choice for the hunting party of Lord Gawurin, the regent of Ashenfall. He and his hunting party would head out into the woods alongside a small contingent of White Knight bodyguards. The lord would hunt deer, boars and other game there, but he wasn’t the most accurate shot. This arrow was designed for bloodletting, meaning he only needed any hit to begin the prey’s downfall. A single strike would start them bleeding, slowing them down and making them easier to hunt. The hunt outcome was all but inevitable. Poor sport, some would whisper, but the lord cared only for the end result. It’s perhaps fitting, then, that Lord Gawurin would be hunted with his own arrows on the night of Falling Embers.

item_1388.lead: Bronze bolts are a power level 3 ammunition that can be fired from bronze crossbows.

journal.text: Not a lot can be said about small spears of metal launched at high speeds into your opponent. They do exactly what you think they'll do to the target, and it's rarely pretty. Guards would buy crossbow bolts in bulk from the village blacksmith, giving him a steady income. This sadly had the effect of making the village blacksmith the most burgled property around.

item_1389.lead: A bronze crossbow is a power level 3 Crossbow that can be crafted at a fletching bench.

item_1390.desc: A small blade forged from bronze, suitable for close combat.
item_1390.lead: The bronze dagger is a power level 3 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. Its special attack is a small dash forward, followed by an upward slash, and can be useful as a combo extension.

journal.text: Bronze is a common enough alloy, a combination of copper and tin. Durable, defiant, and deadly in the right hands. For Mia Larsdottir, it was a bronze dagger that pierced her heart, cutting her life short at the age of twenty-one. As the first of the Amalgamated, she had never expected to reach any of the milestones traditionally followed by her peers. She did not expect to be married and she never let herself dream of being a mother. She thought, perhaps, that she might be allowed to carve a quiet little place for herself, somewhere with room for cats. But a bronze dagger stole that dream from her. Her killer was never brought to justice, though there were rumours about who they were. Her father was the chief suspect, ashamed as he was to bring the first of the unnatural Amalgamated into the world. He denied it, of course, but he never held a funeral for her. Instead, her body was left in the forest, where nature might put her at peace.

item_1391.desc: Burning arrows with tips forged from bronze coated in fire oil.
item_1391.lead: Bronze fire arrows are bronze arrows with fire oil applied with level 45 Ranged. Targets that are hit by a bronze fire arrow will be inflicted with the burning debuff, damaging the enemy by 5% of their max health for six seconds. Like other fire arrows, the icon will have a fire icon placed on the top right of the arrow to distinguish itself from regular arrows.

journal.text: Deadly arrows made deadlier with fire. Each arrow burns with the fury reserved for the most unpleasant parts of Infernus. They sear, they singe, and they melt the flesh, turning their victim into little more than ashes floating away on the wind. In the days of the great war against the Garou, the priests of Saradomin encouraged the use of these weapons. They saw it not just as a means of eradicating the hated beastmen, but to purify the world from their taint. Lougrim was a false goddess, in their eyes, and her followers had to be cleansed from existence. Modern scholars would doubtless be confused at their monotheistic mindset, considering that the literal god of war, Bandos, walked beside them into battle. The mental gymnastics employed by the Brynmoor priesthood, could have rivalled any athlete in the Gielinor Games.

item_1392.desc: A two-handed bronze sword for those who prefer power over speed.
item_1392.lead: The bronze greatsword is a power level 3 two-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at the blacksmith's bench. Its special attack is a large circular slash that lunges the player forward in the direction they are aiming, useful for hitting large groups simultaneously and changing directions during a combo.

journal.text: The Wild Knight, Kessel, was unusual in her choice of weaponry. Where most of the order chose to wield bows, daggers, or swift blades, Kessel favoured the Bronze Greatsword. On the battlefield, she hefted it across her shoulders, never letting the hilt leave her grip. As one of the Amalgamated, Kessel’s skin glowed like burning coals, her battle scars resembling faint reddish embers. She harnessed this heat, channelling it through her sword. Her magic set the blade ablaze, a sight that struck terror into the hearts of her enemies. With great arcs of red flame, she cleaved through enemy forces, incinerating them as she severed their limbs from their bodies. On one fateful day, she would use this technique against a force of garou hunters. The battle was long, hard and brutal, and both sides faced great casualties. But it was when she sliced her blade across the young garou prince that war was inevitable.

item_1393.desc: A woodcutter's tool, forged from bronze.
item_1393.lead: The bronze logging axe is a power level 3 logging axe that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. The bronze logging axe can cut the same trees as the previous tiers, along with oak trees. Deals 20 damage when felling applicable trees, and 30 when overhead chopping to split them.

item_1394.desc: Crush your foes with this heavy, spiked bronze mace.
item_1394.lead: The bronze mace is a power level 3 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. Its special attack is a small leap with an overhead slam, dealing moderate damage.

journal.text: The bronze guard defended the alliance between the followers of Guthix and the followers of Saradomin. The metal symbolised the unity of two different materials and created something stronger. While most of the guards preferred the noble sword, a few preferred the physicality of the Bronze Mace. Each swing delivered powerful momentum straight at the enemy. The force broke bone, obliterated muscle and often sent their victims reeling, allowing a second strike before the foe could recover. There was a mountain of a man known as The Cairn, for his skill at delivering people to one, who favoured the mace over more noble weapons. He crushed anyone who defied the alliance, providing the force of justice with each swing of the mace. When he was asked to turn his fury on the priests of Guthix, it was the one time he stayed his hand.

item_1395.desc: A trusty tool for mining, made from sturdy bronze.
item_1395.lead: The bronze pickaxe is a power level 3 pickaxe that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. It can mine the same ores as the previous tiers, along with iron ore, as well as sandstone, and granite, dealing 34 damage to mineable ores, and 68 with a critical swing.

item_1396.desc: Steadily block and parry attacks with this basic, dependable bronze shield.
item_1396.lead: The bronze shield is a power level 3 shield that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench.

item_1397.desc: A basic Spade made from bronze. Used to clear farming plots.
item_1397.lead: A bronze spade is a power level 2 spade that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. When used to dig a farming plot, players will use 10 stamina and progress by 40% to the next plot clearing stage. Therefore, it will take three digs to progress one stage.

journal.text: Wood breaks, shatters and splinters, which can be very frustrating when out in the garden. Metal is more durable and longer lasting, and bronze is a very malleable metal. With one of these spades, you can assault the skin of the planet, reshaping Gielinor to suit your own grand designs.

item_1398.lead: The bronze sword is a power level 3 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. Its special attack is a forward stab, which can reach quite far forward compared to most melee attacks, making it useful for combo extensions and intercepting an opponent before they can attack.

journal.text: Legend has it that when the first sword was forged, Guthix wept. Given that Guthix commissioned warriors and soldiers and, at times, encouraged war, this is perhaps not a truthful statement. Yet, the sword is a weapon with a singular purpose: to end the life of another. Of course, this is true of all weapons, but none are as iconic as the blade. Children would play in the street, striking one another with wooden blades rather than clubs or daggers. They would pretend to be knights rather than brigands or priests. To wield a blade was a sign of bravery. To draw a sword was the hero's stance. War shatters all childhood dreams. Nothing removes the nonsense of chivalry more efficiently than seeing the life leaving the eyes of a terrified foe. A sword puts the wielder in that moment, forcing them to face that which they destroy; to understand that there are no such things as heroes:{{sic|supposed to be a semicolon

item_1399.desc: A heavy-hitting, two-handed weapon crafted from bronze.
item_1399.lead: The bronze warhammer is a power level 3 two-handed melee weapon that is crafted at the blacksmith's bench. Its special attack is a slow and heavy slam in front of the player, with a small area-of-effect shockwave that will cause a hard knockdown on most opponents and deal heavy damage.

journal.text: Doric would be the first person to praise the simple hammer. It is a large solid chunk of metal attached to a long haft, allowing the weapon to benefit from the unmistakable might of physics. Weight and speed are a terrifying combination. Dwarves, in particular, favour this weapon. They feel it speaks to their long-held desire to form metal by pounding it into shape by sheer strength alone. They apply the same logic to their enemies, beating them into a shape that the dwarves feel suits their enemies better. There were once dwarves on Ashenfall who were masters of this technique. However, when the humans began their infighting, and Guthix turned away from them, they vanished deeper into the continent in search of something extraordinary, leaving behind a shroud of mystery. They found what they sought and have never returned.

item_1400.lead: The bronze watering can is a tool created at the blacksmith's bench. It is used to hydrate farming plots, it has a capacity of 250 water and a watering rate of 25 per action.

journal.text: While the druids relied on wooden watering cans, the more pragmatic farmers turned to metal. Bronze was sturdier, lasted longer and proved to ultimately be the better tool. Crops across Ashenfall found themselves constantly existing in a state of blissful hydration, never knowing the agony of thirst.

item_1401.desc: An ornate dragonkin horn, traditionally used to challenge someone to a duel of honour. Bring it to the dragonkin altar to challenge Velgar.
item_1401.lead: A challenge horn is a quest item used in the Dragon Slayer quest. It can be created at a blacksmith's bench. The horn can be used at the top of Velgar's Rise to summon Velgar.
