item_1403.desc: The sword of a goblin chieftain, used to spread war in the name of the Big High War God.
item_1403.lead: The chieftain's blade is a power level 3 one-handed weapon, created by combining 10 bronze bars, 2 antlers, and 2 animal bones at a blacksmith's bench. The recipe is learned by consuming the vestige a corroded serrated blade, found in a chest atop the same plateau where you start the Heartstrings quest. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.

item_1404.desc: Made with two coarse threads at a crafting table. Rough but effective.
item_1404.lead: The coarse net is a power level 2 Fishing tool crafted at the crafting table. It is used to catch shrimp from net fishing spots found in Brynmoor.

journal.text: Pity the poor shrimp or lobster, approaching the final moments of its life, only to find themselves in a coarse net. The snobbish among them might look down their antennae and think 'couldn't it have been a wool net, perhaps, or linen?'. We're inclined to agree with them. They have minutes before they get cooked in a pot, yet they don't receive the simple courtesy of a comfy net. When you're on your deathbed, we'll wrap you up in a coarse net and see how you like it.

item_1405.desc: Contents: Compost: [X]/150 A wooden bucket used to carry a variety of compost. Pour its contents out over a Farming Plot to fertilize your plants!
item_1405.lead: The compost bucket is a tool created at the crafting table. Level 10 Farming is required to unlock the recipe. It can be used to take out compost and super compost from the compost bin and super compost bin, respectively, at a maximum of 150 units per bucket held in the inventory.

journal.text: The first bucket on Gielinor was created by Mrs{{sic|no full stop

item_1406.desc: A powerful Shortbow fashioned from crystal of elven origin.
item_1406.lead: The crystal bow is a power level 3 masterwork shortbow that can be obtained (as well as its crafting recipe) as a reward from the Heartstrings quest. It can then be crafted at a fletching bench. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.

journal.text: A Crystal Bow is not crafted but sung into existence. Harmonies are layered over one another to teach the weapon a story so that it might understand why it needs to be strong. Traditionally, the songs that are sung are of the plight of the elves, their loneliness without their goddess, and the many dangers they must face. The shimmering substance they're made from is traditionally a shard of the elven goddess {{RSL|Seren

item_1407.desc: A reliable and hard-wearing net made from desert thread.
item_1407.lead: The desert net is a power level 7 Fishing tool crafted at the crafting table.

journal.text: Desert waters throws up some interesting challenges for a net. There are fish that like to nestle into the sand, both below the surface and where a net would not usually reach. To counter this problem, a desert net is weighted on one side but not the other. The weighted side trawls the sandy floor, while the unweighted side catches the fish that attempt to get away. It does lead to some unwanted catches - be prepared to find a wealth of bones in the Umbral Sands - but that's testament to how effective it is.

item_1408.desc: The signature weapon of the Dorgeshuun Goblin tribe. It fires Bone bolts and is surprisingly well made!
item_1408.lead: The dorgeshuun crossbow is a power level 5 crossbow that can be crafted at a fletching bench. The recipe is obtained from the quest Even More Restless Ghosts. It can be ascended at a mystic forge using ascension cores.

journal.text: The cave goblins are a practical sort, using materials more readily available underground than any that might require potential damage to their subterranean dwellings, such as mining. This crossbow is made from bones, traditionally of creatures found beneath the surface. Zanik once used this crossbow to defeat a deadly spectre in the underworld. A being infused with some dread malign power, that threatened the denizens of {{RSL|City of Um|Um

item_1409.desc: An ancient dragonkin staff used by the mages of old.
item_1409.lead: The draconic staff is a power level 4 staff that can be crafted at a mystic forge. The recipe is unlocked after studying the parts of a sinister-looking staff, which can be found in a chest on the western wall outside of Skeklac Kara, the dragonkin vault in Ashien's Watch. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.

journal.text: Rasthin was a powerful sorceress, even among the dragonkin. She had mastered all manner of spells and was even schooled in the techniques from the previous Revision. Still, magic as an art was largely looked down upon by dragonkin society. It was considered vulgar and the obsession of children. Alchemy and science were the real way forward. In part, it’s because of the connection between magic and the hated Elder Gods, and the dragonkin feared rousing, further, their anger. But Rasthin knew the value of magic, as did the other members of her group. She created a staff, forged from glittering crystal and anima-infused iron, which allowed her to channel her magic into powerful spells. Yet, even with a weapon as powerful as this, she discarded her magic when she uncovered the power of Ashenfall – preferring, instead, to enjoy her newfound connection with elemental flame. Still, the remnants of the staff pulse with potential, and while they may never reach the might of their former power, they remain mighty magic tools, just waiting to be crafted.

item_1410.desc: The Spirit of Velgar lives on within this shield, corrupting your enemies.
item_1410.lead: The dragonblight shield is a power level 4 masterwork shield that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench after obtaining a noxious draconic visage from the Dragon Slayer reward pack by completing Dragon Slayer or from turning in Velgar's head to the Wise Old Man afterwards. One of the required materials is an anti-dragon shield and one is included in the reward pack. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.

item_1411.desc: A ferocious blade, filled with primal draconic rage.
item_1411.lead: The dragonbone dagger is a power level 4 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. The recipe can be found in Chaktan Kara, the dragonkin vault in northwest Stormtouched Highlands. It can be ascended at the mystic forge with ascension cores.

journal.text: Viika was never fond of creating dragons, they thought the process was cruel and unbecoming. When an egg was laid, Viika saw in that moment both the egg and the dragon it would become. They saw past and presence{{sic|supposed to be present

item_1412.desc: The spirit of Imaru lives on within this shield.
item_1412.lead: The dragoncurse shield is a power level 5 masterwork shield that is obtained from the Withering Heights reward pack by completing Withering Heights. It can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench after obtaining an undead draconic visage from the same pack or from turning in Imaru's head to Death afterwards, although it will require another anti-dragon shield. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.

journal.text: A shield with the visage of Imaru the devourer welded to the front. Holding the shield feels cold to the touch and instils within you a hunger for battle. Your blood pumps faster with a terrible need to rend your enemy limb from limb.

item_1413.desc: A shield forged in the wake of Fuzan's fall. Its scales still glow with a smoldering heat, as though the dragon's fury refuses to fade.
item_1413.lead: The dragonfire shield is a power level 7 masterwork shield that is obtained from the Icthlarin's Little Helper reward pack by completing Icthlarin's Little Helper. It can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench after obtaining a smouldering draconic visage from the same pack or from turning in Fuzan's head to Icthlarin afterwards, although it will require yet another anti-dragon shield. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.

journal.text: Fuzan was the youngest of Kuldra’s offspring, yet one of her most violent. As a child he was overcome with a curiosity infused with childlike cruelty. When Kuldra gifted him with the flames, stolen from the Dragonkin’s Harmonic Resonator, it did nothing to temper that childlike need to discover and destroy. The fires within him were a delight to wield and he grew more and more focused on their flickering flames, one day glancing through them to worlds of cinders that lay beyond. In the embers he heard a whisper, and as he listened it turned into a promise and a proclamation. A voice of true divinity, far surpassing the power of his mother’s dimmed spark. She was a queen of worlds far beyond this one, each of them shining beacons in the dark twilight of the heavens and Fuzan was enraptured. Through her instruction he learned to mark others with his seal, sharing some of his power with them, and in turn, some of hers. Now, with his destruction, you wield the flames yourself. A shield protecting you from her manipulation. Yet, should you stare too closely at the flames that burn within this shield, you might find yourself blinded by divine radiance.

item_1419.desc: The shield of an Undead Hoplite.
item_1419.lead: The fallen hoplite's aspis is a power level 5 shield that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench after obtaining a sundering spiked slab as a rare drop (5/100) from a skeletal hoplite. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.

journal.text: The hoplites of Emberwood named themselves after Saradomin’s forces in the holy scripture. The legendary hoplites were warriors on the world of Hallow, who were trained from farmers and artisans, rather than military families or nobility, and the Emberwood hoplites came from similar stock. They were best known for their fighting style using spears and shields, with the shield being the defining feature. These shields were designed to be worn for longer periods of time, resting against the shoulder for more comfortable carrying. The hoplites may have been raised from peasant stock, but their camaraderie made them a force to be reckoned with on the battlefield. As the withering took them, the hoplites retained the rote memory of their training and remained a deadly threat to all who faced them.

item_1420.desc: Arrows with tips carved from animal fangs.
item_1420.lead: Fang arrows are power level 2 ammunition crafted at a fletching bench.

item_1421.desc: Made with two fine threads at a crafting table. An elegant little net.
item_1421.lead: The fine net is a power level 5 Fishing tool crafted at the crafting table.

journal.text: Oooh, look at you, making a fine net. Lah-di- dah. I bet you're the kind to make a fine net and never use it. You just drape it on your side-table at dinner parties, so people can compliment it and ask where you fish. "Oh you know, here and there", you say, idly gesturing to a mounted bass on your wall (bought from a shop). But we see you, fisher-dandy. We see you very well.

item_1422.desc: A surprisingly nasty little axe. Popular with goblin warriors.
item_1422.lead: The goblin "Swingslash" is a power level 2 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a crafting table. The recipe is learned by consuming a cruel goblin blade, received as a random drop from a goblin pack; the drop chance for this vestige is 2%.

item_1423.desc: The power of this warhammer should not be taken for granite.
item_1423.lead: The granite maul is a power level 3 two-handed melee weapon craftable after the quest Granite Mauled. It is classified as a masterwork weapon. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.

journal.text: While metal may be the preferred choice of weapon makers, the Granite Maul stands as a testament to the raw power of stone. This legendary weapon, revered among hammer wielders, is nothing more than a massive, heavy stone affixed to a stick. Yet, in the hands of a skilled wielder, it becomes a force of unparalleled destruction. It was developed by ancient dwarves long ago, after one dwarf got fed up with the rock hammer he was using to fight a nest of gargoyles. The beasts were strong and numerous, and their skin was almost impenetrable to conventional weaponry; only rock hammers seemed to hurt them. In frustration, one dwarf took the biggest hunk of granite he could find and turned it into a legend. Since that moment, the weapon has been refined, using various special components to make it more wieldy in combat. The original creator having{{sic|Supposed to be "had"

item_1424.desc: A trusty lightsource - now in green.
item_1424.lead: The green torch is a cosmetic variation of the torch tool item that can be wielded in the off-hand to help light up areas around the player, making it easier to see. It can be unlocked by studying extinguished green remnants.

item_1425.desc: This staff is dedicated to Lougrim, the fallen Garou goddess of the Moon.
item_1425.lead: The grieving moonstaff is a power level 3 staff that can be crafted at a mystic forge. The recipe is unlocked after studying a mysterious crescent carving, which can be dropped by garou druids with a 2/100 drop chance. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.

journal.text: Lougrim was a moon deity, born to a cold world of soft silvers and silence. Her people lived lives of quiet contemplation, each moment spent wondering about the next. They were passive, soft spoken and sedentary, which drive Lougrim wild. When a doorway to another world appeared and a grieving god wandered through it, Lougrim took the opportunity to run. To flee to another place, and live a life that she could endure. History skips the next bit. Her closest allies have never learned what elevated her from her previous form to that of the goddess of the hunt, but whatever it is was profound enough to change her completely. She no longer resembled her silent kindred. She was quiet, yes, but in the way a tiger is moments before the kill. She is contemplative, true, but it was the stillness of a spider waiting for its prey. When she found the garou, she knew she found her real kindred. They were violent, and deadly, and they yearned for the hunt. When she took her place as their goddess, she focused and refined them, creating hunters that were capable of felling almost any prey. Yet still she kept the moon as her symbol, a reminder of her home and how far she has come since leaving it. Now her priests bear the symbol, atop their staves and as the focus on their altars. They accept and revere Kuldra as their High Queen, yet they grieve the moon goddess that made them who they are today.

item_1426.desc: With it's aerodynamic antlers, this bow is very popular with garou scouts.
item_1426.lead: The hunter stagbow is a power level 4 longbow that can be crafted at a fletching bench. The recipe is learned by consuming a string of sinew, a vestige dropped by garou hunters with a 3/100 drop chance. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.

item_1427.desc: A Scimitar forged from the Visage of Imaru.
item_1427.lead: Imaru's talon is a power level 5 scimitar, crafted at a blacksmith's bench, after receiving the serrated claw as a drop from Imaru. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.

journal.text: The essence of an undead dragon, distilled down into a blade. What could go wrong? This weapon is cold to the touch in ways far beyond chilling. Holding it feels as if you're out in the cold, with no shelter to protect you. Exposure in the palm of your hand. Worse than the cold, is the hunger. This scimitar wants to cut, to stab, to slice and to maim. It wants to see your enemies bleed so that it can feast on their suffering. Imaru may be dead, but her hunter is eternal and you feel it infecting you with each swing of the blade. Still, the power of this blade makes it almost worth it. What's a little hunger when faced with the destruction of your foes? Lament later, surely, and revel now in the carnage. Perhaps there's a little dragon in you too?

item_1428.desc: A massive granite warhammer head. Garou masons imbue their stone weapons with wild anima to make them stronger than metal.
item_1428.lead: The imbued granite maul head is one of the components used in crafting the granite maul after the quest Granite Mauled.

item_1429.desc: Strips of imbued dire wolf leather for the grips of a granite maul. Infused with primal savagery.
item_1429.lead: Imbued leather wrappings is an artefact. The leather wrappings are used in the creation of the granite maul after the quest Granite Mauled.

item_1430.desc: Arrows with tips forged from iron.
item_1430.lead: Iron arrows are power level 4 ammunition that can be crafted at a fletching bench.

item_1431.desc: Lacerating arrows with barbed tips forged from iron.
item_1431.lead: Iron barbed arrows are iron arrows with weapon barbs crafted on the arrow. Targets that are hit by a iron barbed arrow will be inflicted with the Bleed debuff, damaging the enemy by 5% of their max health for six seconds. Like other barbed arrows, the icon will have a Bleed icon placed on the top right of the arrow to distinguish itself from regular arrows. There are no additional bonuses at this time.

journal.text: The first of these weapons was not commissioned for war. Nor was it commissioned for hunting. Instead, this most deadly arrow was created for nothing more than vengeance. Against a pigeon. Lord Gawurin was the ruler of Brynmoor, as appointed by the priests of Saradomin. He wore expensive garments of the finest materials, adorned with glittering jewels and gold chain. So, he was most affronted when a single pigeon determined that such a garment was the perfect restroom choice. The pigeon's audacity was unforgivable. Day after day, Lord Gawurin's garments were defiled by this feathered fiend. His anger grew, fuelling a desire for revenge that consumed him. He commissioned an arrow, a weapon of brutal design, with a single purpose- to make the pigeon suffer. With a sinister smile, he summoned the most skilled hunter, a woman who had brought down countless foes, and ordered her to end the pigeon's reign of terror. She stood at the top of the castle, her bow steady, her aim true. The tension in the air was palpable as she prepared to unleash the arrow of vengeance upon the pigeon. The world seemed to hold its breath in anticipation. She missed.

item_1433.lead: An iron crossbow is a power level 4 crossbow that can shoot blurite, iron, and bronze bolts. It is crafted at a fletching bench.

journal.text: Iron turned the war against the garou more than some people would like to admit. They would claim superior training, tactics, and skills of their soldiers, but the truth is far simpler. Iron was strong and iron weapons were brutal. Ranged weapons proved effective against the garou leadership, bound as they were by strict codes of honour. A thane was a deadly opponent up close, but if you could pierce their internal organs before they were within a swing’s reach, then they were no more dangerous than any other beast. It is perhaps no surprise then, that there was a race to create weapons to challenge them. The people of Brynmoor had learned of a Wild Knight invention, a weapon that would allow one to deliver powerful ranged attacks, whilst still allowing the bearer to wield a shield. They took this design, studied and refined it and then upgraded it to include the power of iron weapons. Garou numbers dropped rapidly as a result, turning the war heavily against them. In their desperation, the garou turned to their goddess and she, in turn, sought allies with deadlier weapons still.

item_1434.desc: A sharp, compact weapon, perfect for quick strikes in close combat.
item_1434.lead: The iron dagger is a power level 4 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. Its special attack is a small dash forward, followed by an upward slash, and can be useful as a combo extension.

item_1435.desc: Burning arrows with tips forged from iron coated in fire oil.
item_1435.lead: Iron fire arrows are iron arrows with fire oil applied with level 45 Ranged. Targets that are hit by the iron fire arrow will be inflicted with the Burning debuff, damaging the enemy by 5% of their max health for six seconds. Like other fire arrows, the icon will have a fire icon placed on the top right of the arrow to distinguish itself from regular arrows.

journal.text: Rasthin was the master of fire. It was the gift she had stolen from the “soul of the world” as she called it. She could use the inner flame to inspire confidence or rouse people into a great fervour. The fire could reveal secrets, forcing truth from those who stood before her. But, more practical than all of that was one simple truth, that fire could burn. There were many a dragon that tried to battle Rasthin directly, believing their dragonfire could destroy her. Their bones litter Ashenfall. It was only Queen Kuldra herself who could challenge the dragonkin, and theirs was a battle that left scars in the lands for centuries. These arrows borrow a piece of Rasthin’s power. Able to inspire only by the fear they kindle in the wielder’s enemies. Yet, kindle they do, for those who face these flames will surely feel echoes of the fury wrought by the dragonkin lord of fire.

item_1436.desc: A massive, two-handed axe, capable of delivering devastating blows.
item_1436.lead: The iron greataxe is a power level 4 two-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench.

item_1437.desc: A well-balanced, large, imposing sword for skilled warriors.
item_1437.lead: The iron greatsword is a power level 4 two-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at the blacksmith's bench. Its special attack is a large circular slash that lunges the player forward in the direction they are aiming, useful for hitting large groups simultaneously and changing directions during a combo.

item_1438.desc: A durable tool for chopping trees, ideal for budding lumberjacks.
item_1438.lead: The iron logging axe is a power level 4 logging axe that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. The iron logging axe is able to cut the same kinds of trees as the previous tiers, along with blightwood roots and bloodwood sap. Deals 30 damage when felling applicable trees, and 45 when overhead chopping to split them.

item_1439.desc: Crush your foes with this heavy, spiked iron mace.
item_1439.lead: The iron mace is a power level 4 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. Its special attack is a small leap with an overhead slam, dealing moderate damage.

item_1440.desc: Essential for mining hard, valuable rocks, this iron pickaxe is a miner's best friend.
item_1440.lead: An iron pickaxe is a power level 4 pickaxe that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. It can mine the same ores as the previous tiers, along with gold ore and dragon teeth, dealing 50 damage to minable ores, and 100 with a critical swing.

item_1441.desc: A pair of gardening Secateurs that boost your harvesting yield while equipped.
item_1441.lead: Iron secateurs are a farming tool that boosts harvest yields, with the recipe unlocked at 42 Farming. Players can expect to receive a 25% yield increase when harvesting fully grown plants whilst wielding the secateurs and clicking the left-click option on the harvestable crop. This effect does not apply when the Uproot spell is used, even when the secateurs are equipped.

journal.text: The best way to get leaves to stay healthy is to instil within them a healthy sense of fear. By pruning away the leaves that have allowed themselves to fall to weakness, frailty and disease, you show the other leaves what happens if they don't behave. I find that whispering their failures to the plant, as I slice away parts of its extremities, emboldens the plant with a desire to thrive.

item_1442.desc: A reliable, durable shield crafted from iron; perfect for tanking big hits.
item_1442.lead: The iron shield is a power level 4 shield that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench.

item_1443.desc: A well-crafted iron blade for skilled combatants.
item_1443.lead: The iron sword is a power level 4 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. Its special attack is a forward stab, which can reach quite far forward compared to most melee attacks, making it useful for combo extensions and intercepting an opponent before they can attack.

item_1444.desc: A brutal two-handed weapon, capable of smashing through enemy defences.
item_1444.lead: The iron warhammer is a power level 4 two-handed melee weapon crafted at a blacksmith's bench. Its special attack is a slow and heavy slam in front of the player, with a small area-of-effect shockwave that will cause a hard knockdown on most opponents and deal heavy damage.

item_1445.desc: This dagger is thin and has a wavy edge to better slide through gaps in armour.
item_1445.lead: The keris is a power level 7 dagger. The recipe is learned from the corroded curved blade, found in the vault in southwest Umbral Sands, in the chest after the kalphite queen boss fight. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.

journal.text: The Moon Garou believe this weapon was given to them by a goddess of the river, who took the desperate garou and raised them up to become masters of the desert sands. The weapon was created as a tool against one of the deadliest denizens of the dunes – the kalphites. The blade tip can find its way through the chinks in the Kalphite exoskeleton, piercing through the chitinous armour and damaging the much squishier flesh beneath. It was turned many a battle against the Kalphites from a garou bloodbath, to a garou victory banquet – though they tend to find the Kalphite meat a little less appetising then they’d like. Moon Garou champions are gifted the Keris dagger after achieving a great victory. It is a symbol of their bravery and marks them as skilled warriors to all the other tribes. In olden times, a bearer of the Keris would be treated with great respect. They would be given food, lodging and anything else they needed to further their victories. Nowadays, however, the Keris is seen more as a tool of survival against the insectoid foe.

item_1446.desc: A slightly more refined and durable shield made from wood and tanned animal hide.
item_1446.lead: A leather shield is a power level 2 shield that can be crafted at a crafting table.

item_1447.desc: A magical weapon carved from maple wood.
item_1447.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_1447.lead: Maple battlestaff is a power level 6 two-handed staff that can be crafted with a mystic forge.

item_1448.desc: A supple longbow carved from maple wood.
item_1448.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_1448.lead: The maple longbow is a power level 6 longbow that can be crafted from a fletching bench.

journal.text: A supple wood, is the maple. When cut into long, reed-like lengths, it can be formed into a worthy longbow. The process also releases syrup - a treat for a day's fletching. Not enough to make a maple toastie, mind, but enough to leave a sweet taste in the mouth. Bramblemead was often the venue for archery competitions, and the maple longbows would be out in force. Etched into the trophy, you would find many Rasmodels. They were a noble bloodline on Ashenfall, and would often add to their reputation by earning combat trophies.

item_1449.desc: A bad-ass rod, effective in Dowdun Reach.
item_1449.lead: The maple rod is a power level 6 Fishing tool crafted at the blacksmith's bench.

journal.text: This is it. You've made it now. The pinnacle of Dowdun Reach fishing: ownership of a maple rod. Don't let it go to your head. The hook will get stuck in your nostril. The humble angler doesn't draw attention to the maple rod. They don't wax it or buy it a nice kebbit-fur sheath. They don't name it something like Deborah or kiss it before they go to bed. No, the humble angler strides into the middle of other anglers and says "levels?". They hear the fishing levels of others and nod in appreciation. Be the humble angler.

item_1450.desc: A limber shortbow carved from maple wood
item_1450.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_1450.lead: Maple shortbows are a power level 6 bow that has higher stats than the willow shortbow. Players can create the maple shortbow at a fletching bench.

journal.text: Putrilius, the cthonian demon, will tell you that any living thing can be possessed. If needs must, a cthonian can be a cockroach or spider, for a time. In one desperate moment, after the Dreaming Stone was shattered, Putrilius was forced to possess a maple tree. It wasn't an experience she enjoyed. Most curiously, she found themselves aligning to the maple's inner cadence. Everything slowed. Putrilius barely registered a thought in two years. What woke Putrilius was a logging axe. Their maple body was toppled and then fletched into an armature. For a moment, as Putrilius's life faded from the wood, she was a shortbow. It was the closest she had come to dying. With a cognitive spark, she moved from the bow to a passing hound before all her lifeforce ebbed away.

item_1451.desc: A magical staff fashioned for a master of the mystic arts. It radiates with power.
item_1451.lead: Master's staff is a power level 7 two-handed staff that can be crafted at a mystic forge.

journal.text: Before the master wand, there was a staff of such power that the mages of the wizard’s tower decided it was too dangerous to keep. They placed the staff in teleportation circle, scrambled the coordinates and hurled it through the Abyss to settle far away from Misthalin. In truth, it should have ended in the depths of the sea, sinking down and down into the darkness, but something caught it instead. A powerful elven mage had found their way to Ashenfall, and they had already indulged in powers darker than what their kin traditionally allowed. They felt the staff hurtling through the Abyss and used their unnatural sorcery to pull it to them, so that they might benefit from its power. This elf and his retinue found their way to the Umbral Sands, where they challenged one of the Moon Garou’s mages to a magical duel, over some perceived slight or other. The battle was magnificent, power that shook the dunes and cast a great sandstorm into the skies. The garou was defeated, but not before her spells shattered the master’s staff. In his arrogance he cast the remains aside and continued his journey into Ashenfall. Moon Garou would find the remnants of the staff and found a way to recreate it. Weaker than the original, true, but still possessing a power that would make lesser mages tremble.

item_1453.desc: Lacerating arrows with barbed tips forged from mithril.
item_1453.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_1453.lead: Mithril barbed arrows are a power level 6 ammunition that are crafted at a fletching bench.

journal.text: Demons dealt with wounds and ailments on their own. There was no such thing as a demon surgeon or sick bay. If wounds were fatal then the demon would die; if wounds were survivable, then survive they did. This was an observation of Summoner Flament, who passed it on to Alric, who idly mentioned it to Lord Rasmodel in one of their weekly meetings. As with most information, Lord Rasmodel examined it for opportunities. If demons sought no help from their wounds - no remedies, no medical assistance - then his knights would carry weapons that took advantage of that fact. Arrows were poisoned, since no demon carried antipoison. And arrows were barbed, as demons would pull them roughly from their hides, rather than remove them carefully. It was a small advantage, but Lord Rasmodel took it. As he would often say, "stack opportunities, one on top of the other, and soon you will have an impregnable tower".

item_1454.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_1454.lead: Mithril bolts are a power level 6 ammunition crafted at a fletching bench.

journal.text: Demons are hardy creatures. The Black Knights had a habit of calling them 'Rackers', as they'd often require a whole bolt rack to bring down.

item_1455.desc: A 1-Handed crossbow composed mainly of mithril.
item_1455.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_1455.lead: A mithril crossbow is a power level 6 crossbow that can shoot mithril, steel, blurite, iron, and bronze bolts. It is crafted at a fletching bench.

journal.text: A mithril crossbow is the standard issue for any modern Black Knight. If you showed capability, then you might be promoted to Black Knight Sniper, and that came with the Black Sniper Crossbow. But for the average Black Knight, the crossbow was a long-kept friend. The crossbow's main purpose was to stop demons in their tracks. The Zamorakian magi claimed to keep their demon hordes under control, but demons tested that claim. The crossbow had other uses. Remove the bolt, rest the crossbow on the floor stock-upwards, and you had a stool. Sit on the floor and it was a headrest. You could also waste time shooting ravens. Shooting the red, glowing ravens was an immediate dismissal, however. Alric demanded they were protected, for reasons that he never expanded on.

item_1456.desc: A concealable weapon, perfect for backstabbing your enemies.
item_1456.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_1456.lead: The mithril dagger is a power level 6 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench.

journal.text: Doric likes to remind Vannaka that you wouldn't find a dwarf making daggers. As Doric says, "it's a very human thing, a dagger. A dwarf never hides their weapon: we're polite enough to show what you're up against. An' you won't find us attacking from the back or sides. No sir, we bonk you from the front."

item_1457.desc: Burning arrows with tips forged from mithril, coated in fire oil.
item_1457.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_1457.lead: Mithril fire arrows are a power level 6 ammunition that are crafted at a fletching bench.

journal.text: The Fogger's Gala was one of the few dates that a Black Knight could look forward to. An annual tradition, it would take place on the mistiest day of the year. As soon as low clouds started rolling in, word spread among the knights that it was Gala day. It was an informal event on the battlements of the keep. There were quivers that represented each of the night's events, and the knights would name their arrows and place them into the quivers of those they wanted to participate in. Arrows were drawn randomly to determine the order. Sergeant Blister was on hand with betting. He brought his blackboard, which he seemed to have on-hand when needed, and a week's wages were placed on friends and adversaries. The events all revolved around bows and crossbows. The fog made it almost impossible to see anything, so the Gala was a test of both memory and accuracy. One event required the archer to hit hay bales with fire arrows. The hay bales were invisible, so they only had location names to go by - the hut by the waterfall, Skrexis's bed - which meant firing Hail Mary's in the vague direction of their quarry, hoping that it would ignite in the night. Other events included Pin the Arrow on the Goblin (as you can probably imagine, a noisy goblin ran about in the fog), Farthest Arrow and Alric's Curtains.

item_1458.desc: A two-handed battleaxe forged from mithril.
item_1458.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_1458.lead: The mithril greataxe is a power level 6 two-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench.

journal.text: In the early years of Dowdun Reach, the concept of a mithril greataxe would have been unthinkable. A big, showy weapon that used large quantities of mithril would have been seen as a betrayal. The Children of Shadows, holding a monopoly on mithril, wanted to present it as a rare metal. At best, the richest on Ashenfall might have a brooch or tiara that sparkled with mithril. Nowadays, Doric can have two greataxes whipped up for you before dinner. Much has changed.

item_1459.desc: A sturdy two-handed sword, with strength to match its size.
item_1459.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_1459.lead: The mithril greatsword is a power level 6 two-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench.

journal.text: "You see a mithril greatsword, I see a mithril dagger," Vannaka would say. He would then pick two up from Doric's forge, one in each hand, and try not to register effort. It was a routine, a little play, between Vannaka and Doric. This time, however, the joke was on Vannaka. Doric had made his mam's rock cakes, and folded some mithril round them - one for each hilt. Vannaka wobbled. "Cripes," he said.

item_1460.desc: A tool for chopping trees. Make sure to hit them with the sharp side.
item_1460.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_1460.lead: The mithril logging axe is a power level 6 logging axe that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. The mithril logging axe is able to cut the same kinds of trees as the previous tiers, along with maple trees. Deals 68 damage when felling applicable trees, and 102 when overhead chopping to split them.

item_1461.desc: Crush your foes with this heavy, spiked mithril mace.
item_1461.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_1461.lead: The mithril mace is a power level 6 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench.

journal.text: The standard term is mace, but Vannaka prefers bludgeon. "It's one of those sound words, like stomp and grunt, right? When I hit someone with it, it bludges. Bludge, bludge, bludge." "You're thinking of onomatopoeia," Dionysius said, helpfully. "Nah, but good try. I'm thinking of breakfast," said Vannaka.

item_1462.desc: A tool for mining. Few rocks can withstand its strength.
item_1462.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_1462.lead: A mithril pickaxe is a power level 6 pickaxe that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. It can mine the same ores as the previous tiers along with limestone, dealing 82 damage to minable ores, and 164 with a critical swing.

item_1463.desc: A curved sword of Eastern influence, forged from mithril.
item_1463.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_1463.lead: The mithril scimitar is a power level 6 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench.

journal.text: The scimitar form is not commonplace on Ashenfall. Unlike the mainland (where you can't walk five metres in the Kharidian Desert without getting slashed by one), the scimitar is a rarity. Only an offshoot of the Garou, found in some of the harshest deserts of Ashenfall, are known to wield it. That is likely to change, of course, as more adventurers make landfall. It makes you wonder what the island will look like in five, ten years' time as the cultures intertwine.

item_1464.desc: A sturdy shield crafted from mithril. Perfect for holding your ground.
item_1464.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_1464.lead: Mithril shield is a power level 6 shield that is crafted with a blacksmith's bench.

item_1465.desc: A well-forged mithril blade for trained combatants.
item_1465.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_1465.lead: The mithril sword is a power level 6 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench.

journal.text: Mithril may not be the strongest metal on Gielinor, but it's perhaps the most begulling. It's metal that benefits most from looking at it up close. Each sword has unique imperfections. It's a quality that makes it the most popular choice for ceremonial swords. Go back in time and watch a knighting ceremony in Dowdun Reach, or bestowal of honours in Bramblemead. You will see your share of mithril swords.

item_1466.desc: An imposing two-handed weapon, capable of crushing any enemy.
item_1466.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_1466.lead: The mithril warhammer is a power level 6 two-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench.

journal.text: The mithril warhammer was once the weapon most associated with Lord Rasmodel of Dowdun Reach. He was rarely seen without it. In the mornings, when he was most in pain, it would be a prop, something to lean on while the night's watch recounted the events of the early hours. In the afternoons, it was a beautiful warning, a threat of what might happen if you disobeyed him. Lord Rasmodel wasn't one for naming his weapons. He found the custom a little juvenile. But when his thoughts were elsewhere, you might see him pat the head of the warhammer. There was kinship there, even if he wouldn't admit it.

item_1467.desc: Made with two mystic threads at a crafting table. A stunningly well crafted net.
item_1467.lead: The mystic net is a power level 6 Fishing tool crafted at the crafting table.

journal.text: Brassica on a Bullock, that net is garish. You're not going to lose that, are you? I bet that your eyes lock onto it every time you open your inventory. First thing you see. Boom - MYSTIC NET. It has the same effect on marine life, of course. They're merrily swimming about, doing whatever lobster and shrimp do, and then boom - MYSTIC NET. Not much they can do, is there? They're transfixed, drawn in by the brightest of blue colours, like moths to a mirror ball. Which explains why the mystic net is rather formidable as a net. Not the most fashionable, mind.

item_1468.desc: Necromantic essence still emanates from this staff.
item_1468.lead: The necromancer's staff is a power level 5 staff that can be crafted at a mystic forge. The recipe can be obtained by entering a spectral door and interacting with a dragonkin effigy in Vekchenven Kara, the dragonkin vault in central Fellhollow. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.

item_1469.desc: A magical weapon carved from oak wood.
item_1469.lead: Oak battlestaff is a power level 3 two-handed staff that can be crafted with a mystic forge.

item_1470.desc: A powerful longbow carved from oak wood.
item_1470.lead: The oak longbow is a power level 3 bow that can be crafted at the fletching bench.

item_1471.desc: A favourite fishing rod, effective in Ghornfell.
item_1471.lead: The oak rod is a power level 3 Fishing tool crafted at the blacksmith's bench.

journal.text: Oak rod is much like its anagram: it's an A-OK rod. Not brilliant, not terrible. It's a rod that you will you look back on fondly when you wield a mighty maple rod. "Ah, I remember when I used to use an oak rod," you will say, as you bite the head off a live catfish and stand astride a pile of infernal eels. For now, appreciate your time with it. You will miss it once you have left it behind.

item_1472.desc: An agile shortbow carved from oak wood.
item_1472.lead: The oak shortbow is a power level 2 shortbow that can be crafted at a fletching bench.

item_1473.desc: A carved piece of wood decorated with metal ornaments; sturdy enough to swing a heavy granite head. Made of blightwood found in Bloodblight Swamp.
item_1473.lead: The ornate maul handle is an artefact. The ornate maul handle is one of the components used in making the granite maul after the quest Granite Mauled.

item_1474.desc: This ancient and powerful weapon lets the wielder channel its sovereign authority into mind-controlling powers.
item_1474.lead: The pharaoh's sceptre is a power level 7 staff that can be crafted at a mystic forge. The recipe is learned from the Icthlarian fetish, the reward from the quest Contact!. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.

journal.text: The Moon Garou tried the whole Pharaoh concept exactly once. Unused to non-violent systems of government, they gathered together as a people and pulled stones from a bag to decide who was the luckiest of all of them, and therefore who deserved to rule. It was, as you can imagine, not a smart system of governance. The winner was a garou called Hakanaten, and he did not want the job. He had always been an outsider, far more interested with the goings on of the nearby Kalphite hives then he was with the goings on of the city. Still, he had been chosen by an assumption of destiny and was set upon a throne with crown and sceptre in hand. He hated it. He made decisions as best he could, but could never please everyone. If he tried to help one person, it angered another. If he cast judgement on a lawbreaker, he was deemed cruel by some and weak by others. No matter what he tried, he only found himself more and more isolated from his kin. In the end a revolt saw him deposed and the throne destroyed. He was cast into the hive he so adored, where he was expected not to live for long. Yet, he had studied the hive and he could mimic their behaviours better than some of his own people’s. He helped them dig tunnels. He joined them on hunts. He lived a life far happier among the hive then he ever did at home. The sceptre, that had been cast down with him, carries with it a measure of his fondness for the insects. It is said that anyone who wields it, can call on the hive for aid, in memory of an unlucky monarch.

item_1475.desc: Arrows with tips forged from adamant, coated in Weapon Poison.
item_1475.lead: Poisoned adamant arrows are a power level 7 ammunition that are crafted at a fletching bench.

journal.text: While adamant arrows might be considered deadly enough, there are still those that would push it further. The Moon Garou hunters found that if they dipped their arrows in deadly snake venom, then their enemies would fall faster and with less danger to the hunting party. Unsavoury bandit types found them useful as well, for far less practical a purpose. When they would raid caravans, they would strike the guards, drivers and occupants, with poisoned arrows, so that even if their victims could escape across the dunes, they would not live long enough to warn other caravans of their fate.

item_1476.desc: Arrows with tips forged from bronze coated in Weapon Poison.
item_1476.lead: Poisoned bronze arrows are bronze arrows that are coated with weapon poison. Targets that are hit by a poisoned bronze arrow will be inflicted with the Poison debuff, damaging the enemy by 5% of their max health for six seconds. Like other poisoned arrows, the icon will have a Poison icon placed on the top right of the arrow to distinguish itself from regular arrows.

journal.text: The Wild Knights were not above poison, any edge in a battle was worth having. Poison meant that you could take down a dangerous beast, even if your initial shot wasn’t a mortal one. The druids among the order felt little concern over its use either, after all nature is filled with wielders of poison and so the Wild Knight archers were simply emulating nature’s tools.

item_1477.desc: Arrows with tips carved from animal fangs coated in weapon poison.
item_1477.lead: Poisoned fang arrows are fang arrows that are coated with weapon poison. Targets that are hit by a poisoned fang arrow will be inflicted with the Poison debuff, damaging the enemy by 5% of their max health for six seconds. Like other poisoned arrows, the icon will have a Poison icon placed on the top right of the arrow to distinguish itself from regular arrows.

journal.text: The Children of Shadows loved using these. The very notion of bone and poison combined as a weapon; it touched some deep dark part of themselves and filled them with a malicious sort of glee. Alas such weapons proved relatively useless in any secret campaigns against the Saradominists of Bramblemead. Certainly, they could assassinate a baker if they needed to, but against a knight it would just ping harmlessly off their armour. Still, they made for good talking points at the secretive meetings, making enjoyably sinister table-decorations that paired well with the wine and cheeses.

item_1478.desc: Arrows with tips forged from iron coated in Weapon Poison.
item_1478.lead: Poisoned iron arrows are iron arrows that are coated with weapon poison. Targets that are hit by a poisoned iron arrow will be inflicted with the Poison debuff, damaging the enemy by 5% of their max health for six seconds. Like other poisoned arrows, the icon will have a Poison icon placed on the top right of the arrow to distinguish itself from regular arrows.

journal.text: Lougrim abhorred the use of poison on arrows, she felt it cheapened the hunt. The mages could wield it in their spells, but a hunter should produce smooth, quick kills, creating as little suffering as possible. Most garou, in turn, would at first refuse to use poisons on their arrows. They followed her teachings, and they hunted swiftly and cleanly. After Lougrim’s fall it became clear just how foolish it was to seek such a merciful path, their new High Queen had made it clear that they should use all tools at their disposal.

item_1479.desc: Arrows with tips forged from mithril, coated in Weapon Poison.
item_1479.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_1479.lead: Poisoned mithril arrows are a power level 6 ammunition that are crafted at a fletching bench.

journal.text: The Rasmodels were notorious for their use of poison. When they lived to the south, in Temple Woods and Bramblemead, it was often said that you should cover your cup, mouth and ears around a Rasmodel. One of the family was finally caught red-handed (or green-handed, considering the poison used), and the rumour moved to certainty. They were banished to Dowdun. The reputation followed them, and mostly became a gift rather than curse. No-one in Dowdun Reach wanted to cross the Rasmodels for fear of waking up in spasms. We say that it was 'mostly' a gift, because of an event between a young Lord Rasmodel and his cousin. Lord Rasmodel claimed that he could shoot an apple from the top of his cousin's head, and promptly did so. He handed one of the resulting apple-halves to his cousin who ate it, and promptly keeled over and died. It turned out that the arrow used to the cleave the apple was poisoned. Lord Rasmodel claimed that he had been using his father's hunting arrows, and one of them must have been tainted. It seemed entirely plausible. But there was still doubt. And that doubt grew into a reputation: a reputation that outmatched his own family's. Even at the age of eight, the inhabitants of Dowdun Reach gave Lord Rasmodel a wide berth.

item_1480.desc: Arrows with tips forged from steel coated in Weapon Poison.
item_1480.lead: Poisoned steel arrows are power level 5 ammunition crafted on the fletching bench.

journal.text: What's better than a sharpened piece of wood with a super strong metal made into even sharper points, firing at your enemies with unreasonable speed? Why, the very same thing, but coated with a deadly toxic poison! I'd say your enemies would complain about you doing this, but they're too dead to fill in the form. So you're good.

item_1481.desc: A trusty lightsource - now in purple.
item_1481.lead: The purple torch is a cosmetic variation of the torch tool item that can be wielded in the off-hand to help light up areas around the player, making it easier to see. It can be unlocked by studying extinguished purple remnants.

item_1482.desc: A trusty lightsource - now in red.
item_1482.lead: The red torch is a cosmetic variation of the torch tool item that can be wielded in the off-hand to help light up areas around the player, making it easier to see. It can be unlocked by studying extinguished red remnants.

item_1483.lead: The scarab staff is an interactable staff found in the Manafem Plains Pyramid that has a safe 25-metre radius for players to walk within. Players can wield it to ward off scarabs to avoid getting damaged 2–3 health per second. However, players cannot bring the staff out of the pyramid. Wielding the staff will not allow the player to jump, so players will need to place it strategically to avoid getting damaged by the nearby scarabs.

item_1484.desc: A crossbow made from black metal. Similar to those used by Black Knight snipers.
item_1484.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_1484.lead: The shadow crossbow is a power level 6 crossbow that can be crafted at a fletching bench. The recipe is unlocked after studying the sinister mechanism, which can be found in chests throughout Dowdun Reach or purchased from Postie Pete's Evil Emporium for 300 infernal fragments. It can be ascended at a mystic forge using ascension cores.

journal.text: Climb the turrets of Dowdun Reach in its prime, and you would have found the Black Knight Snipers. These were the elite marksmen of the Black Knights, tasked with looking outward when the rest of the order would look inward. They would scan the skyline for threat - for the beating wings of a dragon. There was no greater trophy for the Black Snipers. One{{sic|supposed to be "On"

item_1485.desc: This Greatsword exists between the realm of the living and the dead.
item_1485.lead: The shadow sword is a power level 5 greatsword created using a blacksmith's bench. The recipe is learned by consuming the shard of smoky glass, dropped from a zogre. It is required to complete Doric's Quest to receive the zombie axe. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.

journal.text: It might be better to refer to this sword as a smoke sword, given its wispy nature, but there is no denying that this is an ephemeral blade aligned with the world of the dead. It feels cold to the touch and sometimes, when you least expect it, you are almost certain you can hear whispering coming from the blade.

item_1486.desc: This Greatsword exists between the realm of the living and the dead.
item_1486.lead: The shadow sword is a power level 5 greatsword created using a blacksmith's bench. The recipe is learned by consuming the shard of smoky glass, dropped from a zogre. It is required to complete Doric's Quest to receive the zombie axe. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.

journal.text: It might be better to refer to this sword as a smoke sword, given its wispy nature, but there is no denying that this is an ephemeral blade aligned with the world of the dead. It feels cold to the touch and sometimes, when you least expect it, you are almost certain you can hear whispering coming from the blade.

item_1487.desc: A deadly weapon with a disturbingly accurate name.
item_1487.lead: Skullsplitter is a power level 3 one-handed weapon that can be crafted using a blacksmith's bench. The recipe is learned by consuming the vestige remnants of a shattered skull, received randomly as a drop from killing garou berserkers at a 1/50 drop rate. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.

item_1488.desc: A Mage's Weapon crafted from wither-rotted hollow bark. It has strange magical properties.
item_1488.lead: Splitbark staff is a power level 5 two-handed staff that can be crafted with a mystic forge. Players can unlock this after receiving hollow bark in their inventory for the first time.

item_1489.desc: A mystical weapon humming with power, wielded by mighty Saradominist Wizards ages past.
item_1489.lead: The staff of light is a power level 4 masterwork staff that can be crafted at a mystic forge. The recipe can be obtained by completing the quest Highlighting the Problem. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.

item_1490.desc: Arrows with tips forged from Steel.
item_1490.lead: Steel arrows are a power level 5 ammunition that are crafted at a fletching bench.

journal.text: Traditional wisdom says that to kill a zombie, you must destroy the brain. This is disappointingly untrue in Fellhollow, the animating force of Imaru’s hunger needs no thought to drive it forward. No, a far better plan is to destroy the bones and muscles with sharp metal-tipped spikes launched at the creatures with as much force as you can manage. Steel arrows perform this task very nicely.

item_1491.desc: Lacerating arrows with barbed tips forged from Steel.
item_1491.lead: Steel barbed arrows are power level 5 ammunition that can be created on the fletching bench.

journal.text: Sometimes it's not enough to just kill your enemy. There are times when you really want them to suffer as well. Steel arrows are nasty enough, but covering them in deadly barbs that will rend the flesh and empty the liquid lifeforce of a person onto the forest floor? That's just overkill.

item_1493.lead: A steel crossbow is a power level 5 crossbow that can shoot steel, blurite, iron, and bronze bolts. It is crafted at a fletching bench.

journal.text: There were no garou in Fellhollow for the people to deal with, so in the early days of the settlement people created steel crossbows primarily for hunting game. The dragons that guarded the people were gentle creatures, but possessed of an enormity so great that they required a great deal of food to keep going. Hunting, therefore, became a very popular activity, with many competitions and events crafted to provide meals for the draconic caretakers. When the withering began to spread and the dead began to rise, steel bolts proved just as effective at piercing a zombie’s skull, as it{{sic|should be "they"

item_1494.desc: A fine dagger made from high-quality Steel.
item_1494.lead: The steel dagger is a power level 5 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. Its special attack is a small dash forward, followed by an upward slash, and can be useful as a combo extension.

item_1495.desc: Burning arrows with tips forged from Steel coated in fire oil.
item_1495.lead: Steel fire arrows are only accessible in the cache and are not present in the game.

journal.text: Some people just want to watch the world burn! Some people want to watch the world burn, but have thought through the logistics of fire and so decided to set the world aflame from a distance. These arrows are popular among the latter category.

item_1496.desc: A two handed Battleaxe forged from Steel.
item_1496.lead: The steel greataxe is a power level 5 two-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. Its special attack is a large circular slash that lunges the player forward in the direction they are aiming, useful for hitting large groups simultaneously and changing directions during a combo.

journal.text: Power corrupts, and what's more powerful than an enormous axe comprised of metal stronger than any seen before? Such was the logic of Olga Skulltaker (not her real name), the self-styled bandit queen of Fellhollow. As a child, Olga had always enjoyed listening to her grandfather's stories from the mainland. Tales of mighty warriors defeating terrifying foes. Purehearted heroes challenging evil knights to great battles across pointlessly high bridges and the like. Her parents always laughed and called her "their little hero" but the truth was she was far more interested in the villain. When she was old enough to wield a weapon, she trained with the biggest axes she could carry, and her sparing partners feared facing off against her because she always took things too far. Once, this even cost another student their fingers. As an adult, she found herself among the Children of Shadows. She had hoped they would be dangerous, wicked people, like herself, but instead they spent their time reciting terrible poetry and talking about evil, without ever doing it. So she took her axe, changed her name, and found the highest bridge she could, and attacked anyone that tried to cross it.

item_1497.desc: A two handed Steel sword made famous by Highland Warriors.
item_1497.lead: The steel greatsword is a power level 5 two-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. Its special attack is a large circular slash that lunges the player forward in the direction they are aiming, useful for hitting large groups simultaneously and changing directions during a combo.

journal.text: It was the followers of Armadyl who enjoyed the greatsword so much, in defiance of the bows that were the more traditional choice. They said it reminded them of the legend of the godsword and would lament not knowing the secrets of forging one, as it would be quite useful against the Godeater, Kuldra and her call for humanity's death. Sadly for the villagers, the art of godsword creation was never revealed, so they turned to steel instead. While significantly less flashy, and almost certainly not going to terrify any deities, a steel sword will do significant damage to anything not divinely attuned.

item_1498.desc: A woodcutter's tool, forged from Steel.
item_1498.lead: The steel logging axe is a power level 5 logging axe that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. The steel logging axe is able to cut the same kinds of trees as the previous tiers, along with thorny irit roots. Deals 40 damage when felling applicable trees, and 60 when overhead chopping to split them.

item_1499.desc: A brutal crush weapon forged from high quality Steel.
item_1499.lead: The steel mace is a power level 5 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. Its special attack is a small leap with an overhead slam, dealing moderate damage and guard breaking quicker than other one-handed special attacks.

journal.text: The priests of Emberwood village were not as militant as their fellows back in Brynmoor. They saw little need for weapons, when a dragon watched over their flock. Still, they carried steel maces by their side to symbolize their office, each one ornately engraved with the symbol of their chosen deity. Although the Saradominist priests had first insisted that different faiths could only turn on one another, they found an odd sort of kinship in their fellows, and would regularly enjoy debates on the merits and flaws of each other's faiths.

item_1500.desc: A Miner's tool, forged from steel.
item_1500.lead: A steel pickaxe is a power level 5 pickaxe that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. It can mine the same ores as the previous tiers, along with soul stone, dealing 66 damage to minable ores, and 132 with a critical swing.

item_1501.desc: A vicious, curved sword of Eastern origins forged from Steel.
item_1501.lead: The steel scimitar is a power level 5 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. Its special attack is a small leap with an overhead slam, dealing moderate damage and guard breaking quicker than other special attacks. Despite being a sword-class weapon, the steel scimitar shares the special attack of mace weapons and the attack speed of the abyssal whip, while sporting its own unique attack animations. [[File:Steel Sword Equipped.jpg|thumb|a Steel Scimitar as seen when equipped by a player]]

journal.text: It is said that the origins of the scimitar come from {{RSL|Al Kharid

item_1502.desc: A reliable, durable shield crafted from Steel, perfect for taking big hits.
item_1502.lead: The steel shield is a power level 5 shield that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench.

journal.text: There are few things as good at shielding you from harm, as a great slab of metal between you and your foe. The steel shield is more durable than its iron kin, capable of resisting greater and more deadly blows. It was popular among Fellhollow locals, who would play a game that indicated an intelligence shortage among the population. The game consisted of one player being equipped with a crossbow and other players would hide around the area carrying steel shields. The crossbow wielder would then hunt the other players and try and fire a bolt into their shields, marking them as out of the game. Unsurprisingly the injuries caused by this game were large and common place. Even the death of some of the players wouldn’t cause the activity to be banned. “It’s tradition”, “it’s just good fun”, “hardly anyone gets hurt”, these were the arguments made even as parents grieved the loss of their child from the game.

item_1503.desc: A robust Spade made from Steel. Used to clear farming plots.
item_1503.lead: A steel spade is a power level 5 spade that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. When used to dig a farming plot, players will use 10 stamina and progress by 60% to the next plot clearing stage. Therefore, it will take two digs to progress one stage.

journal.text: Fallen from too many tall buildings, only to be punished for your misstep by the cruel and malicious ground? Well, now is your chance to get your revenge. The smug soil doesn't think you can touch it, but you can prove it wrong by stabbing it through its smug topsoil smirk with a nice steel spade. Oh, sure, it's great for gardening, but really this is a tool for sweet, sweet revenge.

item_1504.desc: For fighting monsters and swearing oaths.
item_1504.lead: The steel sword is a power level 5 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. Its special attack is a forward stab, which can reach quite far forward compared to most melee attacks, making it useful for combo extensions and intercepting an opponent before they can attack.

journal.text: Atilius Rasmodel was a proud and powerful knight. Her skill with the sword was without compare and her bravery seemingly infinite against the dangers in Fellhollow. She was chosen by Imaru as one of her guards, not that a dragon needed such a thing, and she was responsible for the defense of the dragons when they fell into the weeks-long torpors they were known to suffer. She called herself the Dragon Knight. Even though such a title was unofficial and self-proclaimed, it soon stuck among the village people and they would bow and nod in appreciation of her skill as they passed her. When Kuldra descended on the region, demanding humanity's destruction, Atilius climbed on the back of Xikotal's back, hoping to drive her steel blade through the Godeater's heart. She died beside the dragon she had sworn to protect, free of all remorse, in the line of duty.

item_1505.desc: A massive weapon made from Steel. Great for hammering really big nails.
item_1505.lead: The steel sword is a power level 5 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. Its special attack is a slow and heavy slam in front of the player, with a small area-of-effect shockwave that will cause a hard knockdown on most opponents and deal heavy damage.

journal.text: Lionel wasn't good at much in life, but he could swing a hammer, and he could swing it hard. As one of the Amalgamated, born with hair of metal and skin of stone, Lionel worried that he would be hated as the Almalgamated in Brynmoor had been, but Fellhollow proved to be a kinder place. Instead of being feared and shunned, his unnatural strength became a source of pride among his family and friends. Locals would challenge him to heft heavier and heavier things, cheering and lavishing him with praise as he did so. Life had been good. He was happy. So, of course, it all had to end. When the dead began to rise, arrows and blades seemed less effective than before, but crushing faces still got the job done. His family and friends escaped to the Silverthorn Keep and Lionel waited at the guardhouse, standing as a wall against the tide of the undead. Countless zombies and skeletons fell to his hammer, reduced to little more than powder in a few careful swings. He could have stemmed the tide if that were all, but when the zogre descended upon him, even Lionel's warhammer eventually broke against the strain.

item_1506.lead: The steel watering can is a tool created at the blacksmith's bench. It is used to hydrate farming plots and has a capacity of 300 units.

journal.text: With the discovery of steel, most people found new and wonderful ways to bring death. They crafted sharper swords, stronger shields, axes that could slice through a foe like a hot knife through butter. Yet, some people saw this new material as a chance to bring life. Steel watering cans were sturdier and more durable. Able to bring much-needed moisture to dehydrated gardens, more than before.

item_1507.desc: Arrows with tips of splintered stone.
item_1507.lead: Stone arrows are power level 1 ammunition crafted at a fletching bench.

item_1508.desc: A primitive weapon made from stone, perfect for early adventurers.
item_1508.lead: The stone club is a power level 1 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a crafting table. This weapon is the first weapon a player learns to make at the start of their adventure. Its special attack is a small leap with an overhead slam, dealing moderate damage.

item_1509.desc: A rudimentary blade, handy in close combat.
item_1509.lead: The stone dagger is a power level one-handed weapon that can be crafted at a crafting table. Its special attack is a small dash forward, followed by an upward slash, and can be useful as a combo extension.

item_1510.desc: A crude but functional axe for chopping trees.
item_1510.lead: The stone logging axe is a power level 1 logging axe that can be crafted at a crafting table. The stone logging axe is only able to cut ash trees. The axe deals 15 damage when felling applicable trees, and 23 when overhead chopping to split them.

item_1511.desc: A primitive pickaxe capable of mining stone and rune essence.
item_1511.lead: The stone pickaxe is a power level 1 pickaxe that the player can craft at the start of the game, at a crafting table. It can mine stone, rune essence. This pickaxe deals 10 damage to mineable ores, and 20 damage with a critical swing.

item_1512.desc: A powerful battlestaff, once owned and used by Arcmage Alric.
item_1512.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_1512.lead: The subjugation staff is a power level 6 staff that can be crafted with a mystic forge. The recipe is unlocked after studying the demonic metal rod vestige, which can be found in chests throughout Dowdun Reach or purchased from Postie Pete's Evil Emporium for 300 infernal fragments. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.

item_1513.desc: A hefting greataxe, wielded by the powerful garou thanes.
item_1513.lead: Thane's authority is a power level 4 two-handed melee weapon created using a blacksmith's bench. The recipe is learned by consuming a brutal bladehead, received randomly as a drop from killing garou thanes and the Garou King, at a 1/20 drop chance. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.

item_1514.desc: This sword is now thrice-owned: by you, the Black Knight Titan and Lord Rasmodel.
item_1514.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
item_1514.lead: Titan’s wrath is a power level 6 greatsword received from the quest Black Knight's Fortress and found in the Black Knight's Fortress reward pack or created using a blacksmith's bench. The recipe is learned by acquiring the broken Titan's Wrath by defeating the Black Knight Titan. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.

journal.text: Lord Rasmodel has been put to rest at last. He rarely knew quiet. His family pushed and cajoled him to further the Rasmodel name. Then he was beset by nightmares, as two malevolent beings grappled over his mind. When the Dreaming Stone shattered, they all took him. He was their spoils. We can only hope that, when death came, there was quietus. He felt it for a moment as the Dreaming Stone fell, and - perhaps - he feels it on the journey over the Noumenon. The part of him that was a titan - that part remains. You hold it in your hands. Unleash its wrath.

item_1515.desc: A jagged shield of obsidian, shaped to deflect and punish in equal measure. Its edges are as dangerous as the blows it stops.
item_1515.lead: The toktz-ket-xil is a power level 7 shield that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench after studying the unyielding obsidian construct vestige, a 1/20 drop from Tok-Xils. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.

journal.text: A shield of obsidian, forged and reforged countless times in the heart of the Elder Kiln. Aeons of experience defending against anything that might seek to do its bearer harm, this shield now stands as one of the sturdiest defences on the planet. Yet, within this shield, are myriad cracks and fractures, imperceptible to the human eye, yet strained across the entire structure, down to its core. A last cry of the desperate KotHaar that wielded it, as their will was subverted by the dragon Fuzan and turned to cruelty. If you were to gaze upon those fractures with the eyes of the KotHaar you would see a warning to all. Beware the fire, fear the sun, she whispers through the luminance from worlds of kindling ash.

item_1518.lead: Torch is a tool item that can be wielded in the off-hand to help light up areas around the player, making it easier to see. A player can still block while wielding it, but it will only account for the blocking of the weapon in the player's main hand, and so the torch may be positioned awkwardly. Whilst wielding the torch, the durability will dwindle by 1pt/second, which will take 1800 seconds (30 minutes) before it fully degrades. When creating a new character, a torch will be spawned within the inventory.

item_1519.desc: A massive warhammer of obsidian hue. Each swing carries the weight of something ancient.
item_1519.lead: TzHaar-ket-om is a power level 7 two-handed warhammer that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. The recipe is unlocked after studying the bludgeoning obsidian construct, which can be dropped by KotHaar-Ket in Umbral Sands. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.

journal.text: The KotHaar are practical creatures, not known for flights of fancy nor leaps of imagination. So, it makes sense that they would create a weapon like this. The Tzhaar-Ket-Hom is a large cylinder of obsidian, whose purpose is to be whacked against something with as much force as one can muster. The impact delivers enough kinetic energy to split rock, shatter bone and do tremendous damage to ones internal organs. Elegant this weapon is not, but you cannot argue with its efficiency.

item_1520.desc: Once the bow of a silent hunter. Deals additional damage to unaware targets.
item_1520.lead: Ulv's longbow is a power level 5 longbow that can be obtained (as well as its crafting recipe) as a reward from the Mirror, Mirror quest. It can then be crafted from a fletching bench. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.

journal.text: Ulv was always the silent hunter, in more ways than one. While it was true that no word ever left his lips, his footsteps, breath and, most importantly, his arrows were all equally devoid of sound. The Wild Knights would jokingly call him the Silent Killer - though over time, the crueller among them called him Silent But Deadly - knowing he lacked the ability to argue back. The boy took these insults with quiet grace, never biting back, never reacting. He was used to such small cruelties, having faced them all his life. He had carved the bow himself and once walked Ravanna through the process. The two of them had a true a friendship as could ever be hoped for. No linger romantic tensions. No transaction or debt. No honour chained them together. They were friends simply because they were. Because two lonely people had found each other and a comfort in the other's eccentricities. The wolf and the bat, platonic soulmates to the end. For one of his birthdays, Ravanna enchanted the bow with a simple spell. She took animal bones, skulls and hides and wove necromantic magic through them, wrapping them around the limb and grip of the bow, imbuing them with just enough of the Underworld to strip them of their sound and a little of their substance. Like ghosts, the arrows would sail silently through the air, dropping targets that never knew what hit them. It would have been the perfect birthday gift. If only Ulv had lived long enough to receive it. The garou can be brutal in their assaults, considering notions like mercy to be the domain of the weak and cowardly. Ulv was simply in the wrong place at the wrong time. He was ambushed by a patrol of young garou looking for the bloodmark that would grant them adulthood. There were six of them; Ulv reduced their number to four before claws tore his through, silencing him forever. When Ravanna found his body, she went mad. An anger unlike any other, a rage more powerful than any storm, waged a war of light and the dark inside her. The darkness won. Using the souls of the slain garou, Ravanna's necromantic curse tore through the Highlands, twisting the clouds into screaming things filled with a mere sliver of her rage. AS the ghosts of the dead garou crashed about within them, the clouds unleashed lightning and thunder upon the populace below, destroying countless settlements in an instant and countless more over the centuries that followed.

item_1521.desc: This bow still fires with undeadly precision.
item_1521.lead: The undead ranger's bow is a power level 5 shortbow that can be crafted at a fletching bench. The recipe is learned from a dragonkin effigy in Skekven Kara, the dragonkin vault in eastern Fellhollow. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.

journal.text: There was a villager in Emberwood called Holtz, who was a master with the bow. He could shoot rats from across a field and never scored less than a bullseye whenever he aimed for an archery target. Yet he had no desire for warfare, and no matter the words of encouragement from the captain, he would never join the guard. For him, archery was a passion, an art, never to be used against another person. A stance quickly forgotten by his shambling corpse.

item_1522.desc: A strangely spooky spade. Used to clear farming plots.
item_1522.lead: The undead spade is a power level 5 spade unlocked by studying the rotten farming tool vestige and craftable at a blacksmith's bench. It shares the same stats as a steel spade, and consumes 10 stamina with every digging attempt.

journal.text: In Fellhollow the dead refuse to stay buried. All save one. Jenniva Milgrim was a fan of her rest, she liked nothing more than to ensconce herself within her blankets and disappear into a nice dream. Mornings became lost to her and soon evenings joined her campaign and she would spend most of her existence in the myriad worlds of her subconscious. Then, one cruel day, she died. A victim of one of the first waves of the risen dead. She died, then awoke again as one of the rampaging horde. Except she did not rampage like the others. She did not cross the lands in search of souls to claim, or flesh to consume. Instead she sought comfort once again in blankets and cushions, but found that sleep was denied her, as dreams are the province of the living. There was precious little capability for thought in what remained of her brain, but a singular idea took hold. Since one buried the dead, perhaps that was where the dead could dream? Six feet under the soil, in blissful sleep. So it was, that Jenniva became the first of the dead to bury themselves, using this very tool to do so. It is said, that if you can find her grave, buried deep in the woods, you can still hear her snoring.

item_1523.desc: A bow used by a Wild Knight scout. Maintaining balance, one arrow at a time.
item_1523.lead: The wild scout's shortbow is a power level 3 shortbow that can be crafted at a fletching bench. The recipe is learned from a dragonkin effigy in Takla Kara, the dragonkin vault in central Fractured Plains. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.

journal.text: There was magic once, in this bow, though it has mostly faded now.
